items.title: 城市自然观察展览海报
items.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="exhibition title" default="城市自然观察室"} 创建一张具有手工剪影拼贴美感的竖版展览海报，融合岩石标本纹理、黑色剪纸手部元素、植物细节以及规整的博物馆信息系统。

画布：竖向海报，3:4 比例，米白色纸张背景，带有细微颗粒感，丝网印刷质感，略带不完美的套色效果，配色采用柔和的蓝灰色、板岩色、苔藓绿、炭黑色和白色。

布局：中央贯穿一条不规则的浅蓝灰色竖向撕纸形状。将主标题作为巨大的白色中文字体堆叠在中央条带内，从上至下排列，采用粗体压缩几何风格。周围均衡地排布标本和手部元素，留出充足的负空间。

主要视觉元素：使用 4 只黑色剪影手：左上方手捏着一块小蓝石，左下方手捧着一块大绿石，右上方手捏着一块深色石头，右下方手拿着一个放大镜。使用 14 个可见的石头/拼贴碎片：左上方手附近有一块蓝色纹理石，下方有一块浅灰色三角形纸质石，左侧中部有一条蓝色弯曲条带，左下中部有一块大型绿色椭圆石，左下边缘有一块浅灰色撕裂碎片，左下角附近有一块深灰色小石，右上方有一块带有微小白色植物剪影的蓝色多边形石，右上方手下方有一块悬挂的深色石头，右侧中部有一块绿色石头，其右下方有一条窄蓝灰色条带，右侧中部有一块黑色椭圆石，一块水平的深灰色长方形标本条，右下角附近一块灰色岩石，以及右下角一块深蓝色撕裂块。添加 3 个精致的植物装饰：右上角蓝色石头内有一个白色植物剪影，大绿石旁有一枝精细的白/蓝色植物枝条，左下角附近有几根黑色蕨类植物茎。

排版与文字：左上方添加小型竖向品牌标识，包含一个简单的山形 Logo 和中文名称 {argument name="venue name" default="新美馆探索基地"}，以及微小的英文文本 "XINMEI MUSEUM EXPLORATION BASE"。右上角添加竖向蓝色文字 "春季展览" 及小型英文 "SPRING EXHIBITION"。中右侧添加一个细长的竖向列表："石块 / 标本 / 观察 / 手作 / 记录"。左侧添加一行简短的竖向诗意文字："春天从一块石头开始，观察一座城市的呼吸。" 右侧添加一个小标签："策展 / 新美馆探索基地"。

底部信息栏：创建一个干净的白色页脚，由细浅蓝色分割线隔开。左侧包含开放日标签，日期 {argument name="event date" default="05.17 — 05.18"} 使用大号衬线数字，并标注 SAT. 和 SUN.，时间 {argument name="event time" default="10:00 — 17:00"}，场地地址 {argument name="venue address" default="新美馆探索基地 深圳市南山区怡海大道128号"}，参与说明，以及最右侧的二维码。最底部添加一条蓝色条带，配以白色小字，注明公众开放、免费参与及预约入场。

视觉风格：当代艺术博物馆海报，触感手工纸拼贴，剪影镂空，拓片纹理，标本观察主题，严谨的信息层级，优雅而不抽象。避免写实主义、渐变、光泽效果或多余的装饰杂乱。

items.prompt: 使用提供的参考图像，将其修复并放大为超高清的 8K 照片级真实感图像。100% 保留原始特征、姿势、取景、视角和构图，不得有任何改变：狗保持在镜头中心位置，嘴里衔着相同的花朵，背景依然是相同的庭院和房屋。去除严重的模糊和像素化，恢复自然的微观细节，如清晰的眼睛、逼真的鼻部纹理、独立的胡须、柔软的毛发、花瓣、草地、房屋边缘和树木细节。使最终结果呈现出高质量的电影级摄影质感，具备自然日光、高对比度、丰富且真实的色彩、清晰的对焦，且无人工重建痕迹。请勿更换主体、添加新物体、改变表情，也不要将其风格化为插画或 CGI。增强强度：{argument name="enhancement strength" default="超高清 8K 电影级修复"}。细节优先级：{argument name="detail priority" default="清晰的眼睛、逼真的毛孔、胡须、毛发和花朵纹理"}。色彩分级：{argument name="color grade" default="自然晴朗的高对比度照片级真实感"}。

items.title: 海报写实高级
items.prompt: 创作一张屡获殊荣的收藏版 {argument name="subject" default="Cristiano Ronaldo"} 海报，通过顶尖平面设计语言探索 {argument name="concept" default="执着"} 这一无形概念。构图不应呈现出完全完成的状态，而应类似于达到完美前夕的最终校样。处于 {argument name="team era" default="皇家马德里"} 时期的 Cristiano Ronaldo 安静地坐在前景中，身着剪裁考究的全白足球服，带有细腻的高级质感。他的姿态传达出的是全神贯注，而非攻击性。他标志性的马德里时期发型打理得一丝不苟，每一处面部特征都以非凡的中画幅写实感呈现。在他周围，展现着不断打磨的痕迹：多代编辑网格以微米级的精度重叠，早期的排版版本在新的结构下隐约可见。字体仿佛经过了无数次毫米级的微调。对齐参考线、套准系统、打印注释、透明描图覆盖层、校样修改、构造几何图形以及出版参考信息和谐共存，丝毫不显杂乱。这张海报旨在传达：伟大源于成千上万次无形的改进。采用高级棉纸、盲文压印、局部 UV 上光、精致烫金、胶印写实感、奢华的编辑排版间距、考究的视觉层级以及博物馆级的制作质量。配色方案：骨白色、石墨黑、克制的法拉利红、拉丝钛金属色。最终作品应呈现出如同获得 D&AD 黑铅笔奖的编辑海报质感，记录下追求完美的心理过程。

items.title: 恶魔胶片电影感暗黑教堂
items.prompt:
目标：创建一张方形并排对比图，展示同一概念的两种暗黑奇幻风格生成结果：一位身穿白衣的哥特修女在废弃大教堂内手持黑色贝斯吉他，顶部带有黑色标题栏。

画布：方形 1:1 图像，精确拆分为 2 个相等的垂直面板，中间由一条细白线分隔。在顶部全宽处添加一个黑色标题带。

顶部文字：在标题带中放置 2 个精确的白色无衬线标签：左侧标签“{argument name="left model label" default="GPT Image 2"}”居中于左侧面板上方，右侧标签“{argument name="right model label" default="Seedream 5.0 pro"}”居中于右侧面板上方。使用大号简洁的白色字体，不包含其他排版。

左侧面板：简洁的电影级英雄镜头。画面中心为 1 位年轻苍白的哥特修女，留着长长的铂金色头发，戴着白色连帽面纱，表情严肃，身穿层叠的白色长袍，系着深色腰带，肩部有微妙的盔甲状装饰。她全身站立，面向前方，斜挎着 1 把光亮的黑色电贝斯吉他。她身后是 1 座巨大的黑色石十字架，悬挂或安装在废弃大教堂的高处。大教堂狭窄、灰暗、破败，布满藤蔓、断裂的拱门、灰尘、薄雾，以及从高窗射入的冷光。她周围有 6 个清晰可见的蹲伏外星人/恶魔剪影：左侧前/中景附近 2 个，右侧中景附近 2 个，底部前景边缘部分可见 2 个。氛围克制、平实、胶片扫描感、单色灰调、构图整洁、具有强烈的中心对称性。

右侧面板：同一场景更具戏剧性的动作恐怖版本。画面中心为 1 位年轻苍白的哥特修女，留着长长的铂金色头发，戴着白色连帽面纱，身穿白色长袍，系着深色腰带，斜挎着 1 把黑色电贝斯吉他。她身后是 1 座巨大的黑色石十字架，被从破损大教堂窗户射入的强烈耶稣光逆光照亮。废弃的大教堂更宽阔、更深邃、更混乱，布满扭曲的有机藤蔓、拱形墙壁、瓦砾、烟雾，以及高对比度的青灰色灯光。包含 14 个清晰可见的恶魔/外星人形象：左侧 5 个，右侧 5 个，背景中心 2 个，底部角落 2 个局部前景生物。它们应呈现为逼近修女的威胁性群体。氛围充满恐惧、动态、电影感，具有更强的轮廓光和体积光束。

视觉风格：暗黑奇幻哥特写实主义，超精细但不油腻，采用黑色、炭色、骨白色、银灰色和淡淡蓝绿色的冷色调调色板。修女的白色服装必须始终是两个面板中最亮的主体。运用宏大的大教堂比例、湿润的石地板纹理、尘埃颗粒和恐怖氛围。

约束：保持图像为对比双联画，而非两个独立文件。包含精确的 2 个面板、2 个顶部标签、总计 2 位修女、总计 2 把贝斯吉他、总计 2 座大型十字架。无水印、无额外说明、无徽标、无其他文字。

items.title: 女孩室内

items.title: 建筑梦幻城市
items.prompt:
[主体] 参考图片 1 和图片 2

[姿势与表情]
放松地坐在古老的砖砌围栏上，一条腿垂下，另一条腿弯曲在围栏上。双手举过头顶轻触头发，闭眼微笑，营造出梦幻而怀旧的氛围。

[服装]
穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="一件轻盈飘逸的白色无袖上衣，领口和肩带处饰有精致的蕾丝荷叶边"}。正面有细丝带细节，搭配浅蓝色宽松牛仔裤。深棕色厚底皮鞋，配白色短袜。

[发型与妆容]
长波浪卷发柔顺地垂在肩上。夜灯在发丝上投下微妙的光泽。清透的底妆，五官轮廓分明，湿润的裸珊瑚色唇妆，展现出都市感与自然魅力。

[光影]
来自正面和侧面的环境城市灯光柔和地照亮了面部。来自 {argument name="location" default="斗兽场"} 内部强烈而温暖的金色夜灯填满了拱门，作为戏剧性的背光，营造出清晰的深度对比。

[质感与氛围]
粗糙的砖砌围栏、斗兽场古老的石材纹理与深邃夜空形成对比。金色的人造灯光与蓝色牛仔裤相得益彰，营造出迷人、浪漫且经典的罗马之夜拍摄氛围。

[相机设置]
24mm 广角镜头，光圈 f/1.8，ISO 800，快门速度 1/60s，采用略微仰拍的角度。焦点清晰地对准围栏上的主体，背景中宏伟的建筑呈现柔和的虚化效果。

[背景]
罗马斗兽场的夜景。拱门内温暖的黄色灯光展现了建筑之美。围栏下方是黑暗的道路和金属安全围栏，远处可见游客细小的剪影。

[签名] 右下角有一个小的 Threads 标志，上方用白色草书写着名称 "{argument name="signature" default="CHAse"}"。4.5 比例

items.title: 3D女性
items.promptZh:
在现代中国高铁车厢内创建一个 9:16 照片真实的垂直手机视频，就好像一位坐着的乘客从胸部高度随意地记录过道一样。相机部分被黑暗的座椅靠背边缘和前景中模糊的乘客肩膀挡住；温和的滚动快门柔和度、手机压缩感、自动对焦失误小以及传感器噪音小。主要拍摄对象：一位29岁左右的明显成年东亚女性，成熟美丽的脸庞和令人难忘的眼睛，高挑自然拉长的比例，逼真的皮肤和双手，自然地把一个小巧的银色随身包举到座位上方的行李架上。她不是在摆姿势，而是在摆姿势。她的表情是对着包迅速集中半笑，脸上的四分之三轮廓清晰可辨。造型：短款木炭色罗纹开衫搭配合身的象牙色背心，高腰深色格子迷你裙，下面搭配安全短裤，透明黑色紧身裤，黑色及膝长靴，纤细耳环，简约手表，深色长发在脑后梳成几缕松散的发丝。造型大众化但又时尚前卫，腰线和腿部线条清晰。火车的几何形状必须可信：带头枕套的成对座椅、窗条、头顶行李架深度、过道视角、行李、小顶灯、一些失焦的普通乘客，没有破碎的火车布局。自然光与酷炫的马车 LED 灯混合在一起。将图像保留为压缩的社交电话剪辑，而不是社论广告。避免未成年暗示、校服阅读、偷窥取景、孤立的身体部位裁剪、裸露、内衣、露骨姿势、假客舱几何形状、职业装漂移、长外套隐藏轮廓、变形的手、塑料人工智能皮肤、不可读的脸、徽标、可读文本、水印。

肖像构建：明确成人主体、成熟气场、摄影模式。通过服装剪裁、剪裁、面料纹理、精美配饰、转瞬即逝的表情或动作、主动光线、相机行为、深度分离和负空间来表达吸引力，而不是生硬或孤立的身体描述。保持造型有品位、衣着饱满、内敛、比例自然。及时打磨护栏：五官成熟自然，不稚气；身体比例真实、协调；手、手指、四肢、姿势和服装物理学在解剖学上是可信的。将视觉焦点放在面部吸引力、姿势、服装质地、灯光、气氛和相机真实感上，而不是孤立的身体部位。风格稳定性：保留真实的手机照片纹理、轻微的噪点/压缩、不完美的裁剪、自然的皮肤纹理、可信的自动对焦和非工作室照明。避免塑料皮肤、过度抛光的时尚编辑照明、假 HDR 和 CG 般的完美。整体安全/稳定：高端、有品位、内敛的视觉表现；没有裸体，没有明确的性姿势，没有孤立的胸部/臀部/身体部位特写，没有未成年暗示，没有可读的真实徽标，没有乱码文本，没有水印。避免类似 CGI 的渲染、塑料皮肤、娃娃脸和夸张的解剖结构，除非明确要求使用风格化媒体。使用成熟的美学语言、真实的比例、连贯的场景逻辑和可信的相机伪像。
items.prompt:
Create one vertical 9:16 photoreal phone-video still inside a modern Chinese high-speed train carriage, as if a seated passenger casually recorded the aisle from chest height. The camera is partly blocked by a dark seat-back edge and a blurred passenger shoulder in the foreground; mild rolling-shutter softness, phone compression, small autofocus miss, and fine sensor noise. Main subject: a clearly adult East Asian woman around 29, mature beautiful face and memorable eyes, tall natural elongated proportions, realistic skin and hands, caught naturally while lifting a compact silver carry-on bag into the overhead luggage rack above her seat. She is not posing; her expression is a quick concentrated half-smile toward the bag, face readable in three-quarter profile. Styling: cropped charcoal ribbed cardigan over a fitted ivory tank, high-waist dark plaid mini skirt with secure shorts underneath, sheer black tights, long black knee-high boots, slim earrings, simple watch, long dark hair clipped back with a few loose strands. The styling is public-safe but fashion-forward, with a clear waist line and leg line. Train geometry must be believable: paired seats with headrest covers, window strip, overhead rack depth, aisle perspective, luggage, small ceiling lights, a few ordinary passengers out of focus, no broken train layout. Natural daylight mixed with cool carriage LEDs. Keep the image like a compressed social phone clip, not an editorial ad. Avoid underage cues, school uniform reading, voyeuristic framing, isolated body-part crop, nudity, lingerie, explicit pose, fake cabin geometry, businesswear drift, long coat hiding silhouette, deformed hands, plastic AI skin, unreadable face, logos, readable text, watermark.

Portrait construction: clearly establish an adult subject, mature aura, and photographic mode. Express attractiveness through garment cut, tailoring, fabric texture, fine accessories, a fleeting expression or action, motivated light, camera behavior, depth separation, and negative space rather than blunt or isolated body descriptions. Keep the styling tasteful, fully clothed, restrained, and naturally proportioned. Prompt polish guardrail: mature natural facial features, not childlike; body proportions are realistic and coordinated; hands, fingers, limbs, posture, and clothing physics are anatomically believable. Keep the visual focus on face appeal, posture, clothing texture, lighting, atmosphere, and camera realism rather than isolated body parts. items.prompt: 一幅细节丰富的竖构图壁画，呈现出陈旧的东亚宗教壁画风格，绘于风化的丝绸或灰泥之上，带有明显的裂纹、磨损、褪色的颜料和斑驳的金箔质感。画面中心，一位宛如菩萨的天女优雅地悬浮于巨大的粉色莲花宝座之上，身后巨大的圆形金色光环占据了构图的中上部。她头戴精致的珠宝头饰，佩戴层叠的项链与臂钏，身着朱砂红、奶油色、青色和柔和绿色的飘逸长袍，长长的丝带如云雾般环绕周身，线条优美。她的右臂抬起，纤手轻持一朵粉莲，左手向外伸展，做出温柔的供奉姿态。周围环绕着 3 位较小的侍女：左下方一位站在云端弹奏琵琶，下方中央一位跪姿或悬浮着呈上莲花托盘，右下方一位轻立于云端，双手合十以示虔诚。背景是深青金石色的天穹，点缀着奶油色和玉色的写意云纹、隐约的飞鸟、盛开的莲花，以及左上角和右上角的 2 座华丽寺庙阁楼。在画面中左侧和中右侧边缘添加悬挂的装饰图案，并用花卉边框包裹整个图像。整体氛围神圣、优雅且古朴，线条错综复杂，织物纹理细腻，色调柔和且带有大地气息，以蓝金配色为主导，宛如珍贵的博物馆壁画或宗教挂轴。

items.title: 车海报写实高级
items.prompt: 创作一张 4:5 比例的超高分辨率竖版社交媒体海报，达到 8K 打印质量的清晰度。以参考图中的 {argument name="car model" default="BMW 汽车"} 作为主体，并沿用参考图的背景结构与构图，将其转化为 BMW 主题设计。将所有黑色调替换为纯平的 {argument name="background color" default="高饱和度 BMW 蓝"} 背景。保持与参考图一致的布局、间距、视觉平衡和海报构图。背景应采用平滑的渐变效果，从顶部的浅电光蓝过渡到深海军蓝。添加细微的颗粒质感（2% 至 3%）和淡淡的矩形叠加层（2% 至 4% 不透明度）。保持画面简洁、具有图形感、高级且非写实。在车底添加柔和的接触阴影。使用参考图中的同一辆 BMW，仅更改 {argument name="paint finish" default="哑光冰冻蓝"} 或深金属海军蓝涂装。保留参考图中的原始车身形状、轮毂、姿态和设计细节。以完全匹配参考图角度的后 45 度视角展示汽车。使用略微抬高的摄像机角度。将汽车放置在偏右中心的位置。包含可见的碳纤维车顶、激进的后扩散器、清晰受控的反光以及细致的刹车细节。保持与参考图完全相同的构图：顶部：品牌标识；中部：巨型字体；中心：汽车与文字重叠；底部：编辑板块与规格参数。排版：主标题：“BMW”，采用超紧凑粗体无衬线字体，垂直拉伸，与参考海报一致。颜色为深海军蓝或近黑色。静态文字，无变形。作为结构背景。副标题：“BMW M4 G82”，采用细体字，字间距较宽。Logo 区域：BMW 圆标居中置于上方。编辑板块：标题：“BMW — Where Driving Becomes Instinct”；正文侧重于：驾驶者连接、操控、性能、精准。使用与参考图相同的盒式编辑布局。背景淡出文字：“M4”，大比例，3% 至 5% 不透明度，位于文本框后方。左下角：“M4 G82”；右下角规格：405 kW / 550 PS，3.4 s，307 km/h。灯光应为干净的摄影棚灯光，带有锐利但受控的高光。色彩分级应使用深蓝色、高对比度、纯净的黑色。相机镜头：50mm，略微抬高的后 45 度角。氛围：性能、精准、驾驶者专注。添加右下角水印：harboriis，带有小 x 和 Instagram 图标。

items.title: 鸟插画极简复古城市
items.prompt: 一幅具有纹理和颓废风格的图形插画，以澳大利亚国旗为背景，采用厚重的笔触、油漆飞溅效果以及复古的旧纸张纹理呈现。前景底部是澳大利亚悉尼清晰的黑色剪影天际线。剪影左侧突出展示了悉尼歌剧院和悉尼海港大桥，并伴有各类城市摩天大楼和悉尼塔。国旗左上角的米字旗和南十字星清晰可见，并与旗帜上做旧的油漆纹理完美融合。高对比度，艺术感，爱国主题。创作一幅极简主义的东京剪影天际线，包含东京晴空塔、东京塔、摩天轮，以及最左侧的一座鸟居。背景中央可见白雪皑皑的富士山。整个天际线后方是一轮巨大的、充满活力的红色太阳，以大胆且富有纹理的日式水墨笔触（sumi-e）呈现。背景为做旧的复古米色羊皮纸纹理，带有艺术性的油漆飞溅和粗糙的边缘。整体美学融合了现代城市景观与传统的日式颓废艺术，高对比度，红色与奶油色背景下的黑色剪影。

items.title: 动态海报设计指令集
items.prompt: 输入 A 为 {argument name="subject" default="subject"}。你是一位顶级海报设计师、艺术总监及印刷制作专家。第一阶段：双重海报合成。从下方的池中随机选择两种“海报运动”和两种“图形系统”，并将它们融合为统一的海报视觉标识。海报运动：[瑞士国际主义风格、苏联构成主义、1960 年代迷幻摇滚海报、日本城市流行广告、包豪斯展览海报、新艺术运动石版画、粗野主义排版海报、1980 年代赛博朋克传单、意大利未来主义宣言、极简主义博物馆海报、法国新浪潮电影海报、朋克复印传单、孟菲斯设计、复古旅行海报、当代时尚广告]。图形系统：[超大网格排版、撕纸拼贴、喷绘渐变场、孔版印刷半调、丝网印刷错位、复印机失真、编辑杂志排版、模块化字体块、对角线构成主义几何、霓虹灯层叠、手写装饰、档案印章系统、折页手册逻辑、票根构图、广告牌裁剪]。第二阶段：视觉渲染 16:9 单张图像。将输入 A 转化为成品海报设计。

items.title: AI 杂志产品样机
items.prompt: 一本紧凑的 AI 驱动型杂志，直立展示在现代工作空间中。封面呈现了先进的人工智能概念、全息元素、数字神经网络以及未来感十足的品牌设计。优雅的杂志排版、优质的亮面质感、电影级光影、逼真的阴影、专业的产品摄影、高度细节化、照片级真实感、杂志样机、8K 分辨率

items.title: 车胶片沙漠雪
items.prompt:
[主体] 参考图片 1 和图片 2。

[姿势与表情]
坐在广阔沙质沙漠中央的一辆黑色四轮摩托车（ATV）上，面向前方。双手轻握车把，头部微微向右倾斜，带着含蓄而自信的微笑。

[服装]
身穿简约的黑色背心和紧身黑色打底裤或骑行短裤。这是一种适合沙漠活动的运动风且火辣的旅行造型。

[发型与妆容细节]
长发随风自然垂落在肩部和背部。妆容采用自然的底妆，在强烈的沙漠阳光下显得健康，并搭配清透的裸色唇妆。

[光影与方向]
强烈的正午阳光从主体后方高处照射。顶部留有淡淡的光晕，使肤色和沙丘的曲线熠熠生辉，同时在摩托车和主体下方投下深而短的阴影。正面无直射光。

[质感与氛围]
干燥的米色沙质纹理与 ATV 硬朗光滑的黑色塑料和金属材质形成鲜明对比。整体以单色和中性色调（白色、米色、棕色、黑色）为主，营造出一种狂野、自由的异域风情。

[胶片与相机设置]
使用 f/5.6、1/1600s、ISO 100 以及 {argument name="focal length" default="24mm"} 广角镜头拍摄。从略低于视平线的位置取景，以容纳动态的 ATV 和雄伟的山脉。深景深确保了从前景的轮胎印到远处的山脉轮廓都清晰可见。

[背景元素]
布满轮胎印的广阔、宁静的沙质沙漠。主体后方是巨大的土石山脉，部分山峰隐约覆盖着积雪。淡灰蓝色的天空点缀着薄云，极大地增强了空间感。

[签名] 右下角带有小型的 Threads 标志，并以白色草书写有“CHAse”。

items.title: 精灵动漫插画赛博朋克未来
items.prompt: 一张极具戏剧性的动漫风格赛博朋克女巫插画，她站在深夜未来都市高处的阴暗屋顶上，视角略微俯视。主角是一位皮肤白皙、留着冰蓝色短波波头、长着精灵尖耳、眼神狡黠自信的年轻女巫。她右手高举一根黑色魔杖，杖尖悬挂的球形饰物散发着淡淡的紫红色光芒。她戴着一顶巨大的黑色尖顶女巫帽，内衬为紫色，上面布满了缝补的补丁、警告标签、带子以及白色图案，包括醒目的“404”字样和骷髅徽章。她身穿黑紫色科技感服装：带有许多带子和标签的超大连帽夹克、胸前印有“404”的黑色短款上衣、多层腰带、短裤、单腿渔网袜、黑色系带战斗靴、颈圈以及金属配饰。多条悬挂的带子和标签上清晰可见“WITCH 404”、“404”以及故障艺术风格的标记。在她身下及身侧，屋顶地面投射出一个巨大的紫色发光魔法阵，融合了黑客界面美学，阵中充满了神秘圆环、符文、中央骷髅标志以及散落的霓虹系统文本（如错误代码片段），营造出巫术与数字腐蚀交织的氛围。从魔法阵中浮现出一个巨大的装甲召唤物：一个黑色的未来派恶魔骑士或机器人使魔，身披锯齿状反光盔甲，戴着狭长的紫色发光面罩，单手持重型武器，身体部分正在消散为紫色的能量碎片与烟雾。背景展现了一座广阔的雨中大都市，高楼林立，屋顶工业感十足，布满了窗户、阳台、电缆、招牌和雾气。附近建筑的墙上有一个巨大的垂直涂鸦风格招牌，上面有 3 个清晰可见的元素：“404”、“Witch”和“ERROR NOT FOUND”，以及一个较小的“E404”。屋顶和空中散布着额外的紫色霓虹故障文字和符号。整体采用黑色、靛蓝和深紫色的暗色调，搭配鲜明的洋红色与紫色高光，具有电影级的对比度、反光的湿润表面、丰富的细节以及高端精致的插画风格。氛围神秘、前卫、时尚且危险，完美融合了都市奇幻、黑客美学与魔法召唤元素。

items.title: 极简风《人间失格》封面
items.prompt:
一款极简主义文学书籍封面，采用精致的东亚编辑风格，竖构图，背景为温暖的米白色纸张，带有细腻的颗粒印刷质感。画面垂直分割为 2 个大型抽象区域：左上半部分为粗糙的灰色撕纸形状，左下角为深黑色的色块。从黑色区域中浮现出 1 个醒目的白色戏剧面具轮廓，仅留 1 条黑色眼缝，大比例裁剪并向上倾斜，暗示着疏离感与隐藏的身份。在灰色与白色区域交汇的底部中心，放置 1 个身着深色长外套的微小孤独人影，站在狭窄的三角形边缘上，面朝前方，强调孤独与脆弱感。从顶部中心附近，垂下 1 根带有轻微波浪感的细红线，在中间位置连接 1 个柔和的红色圆形印章状圆盘，与下方的人影对齐。在右侧中心设置 1 个醒目的黑色粗体竖排中文书法标题：{argument name="title text" default="人间失格"}。旁边添加 1 行竖排的日文读音：“にんげんしっかく”。在最右侧边缘，添加 1 行竖排的黑色细体引文：“—— 我的不幸，恰恰在于我缺乏拒绝的能力 ——”。在左上角，添加 1 行小号黑色字体的竖排作者与译者信息：“【日】太宰治｜著 杨伟｜译”。下方添加 1 句简短的两行中文：“生而为人
我很抱歉”。在右下角，添加 1 个红色小号竖排标签：“太宰治
代表作”。下方添加 1 个 3 行的小型黑色出版信息块：“人间失格”，“太宰治”，“だざい おさむ”。在左下角，添加 1 个小号黑色字体出版方信息块：“上海译文出版社
2024”，下方带有一条短横线。运用克制的留白、不对称平衡、原始纸张拼贴边缘、水墨与水粉质感，色调为柔和的炭黑、灰色与褪色的朱砂红，呈现优雅的文学忧郁感，打造高端现代中文小说封面设计。

items.title: 龙壁纸极简城市温暖优雅
items.prompt: 创作一张竖版励志艺术壁纸，风格为宁静的《纪念碑谷》式等轴测构图，采用柔和治愈的马卡龙色调，并留出大量朦胧的负空间。场景是一座由淡桃色、薰衣草紫、奶油色和粉蓝色石材构成的错觉建筑城市：高耸狭窄的塔楼、拱门、桥梁、阶梯、护墙和浮动平台围绕着中心深邃的垂直深渊排列。画面中仅包含一个站在上方桥梁上的微小孤独人影，身穿紫色斗篷或长裙，头戴白饰，正凝视着深渊。在右中位置添加一个显眼的建筑立面，设有一个发光的圆形入口，宛如温暖的橙粉色日食，将光线投射进深邃的竖井中。在左下平台和右侧平台上各添加一棵方形花盆中的小型光秃装饰树。建筑应包含多个超现实阶梯，包括左下中心的一条长对角线楼梯和攀爬右上塔楼的阶梯；最高的塔楼拥有绿松石色的圆顶和一座小尖塔。左上方使用一个苍白的太阳圆盘，营造出大气雾气、柔和光晕、细腻阴影和极简线条感。在左上方放置大型竖排中文语录，采用纤细优雅的灰色笔触：{argument name="quote text" default="当你凝视深渊时，深渊也在凝视你。"}。在其下方，添加一行浅灰色的英文翻译：{argument name="English translation" default="When you gaze into the abyss, the abyss gazes into you."}。添加小型编辑海报细节：左上角文字 {argument name="volume label" default="VOL.01"} 下方配有一条微小的水平线，右上角文字 {argument name="year" default="2026"} 下方配有四个垂直排列的小圆点，左侧添加一个包含“depth”和“gaze”的关键词块，左下角放置一个极简圆形 Logo，上方标注“LOOK DEEP”和“BE SEEN”，右下角放置三个水平排列的小圆点。保持整体构图空灵、精致、深邃且具有高级感，语录占据左侧三分之一，超现实城市在中心和右侧升起。

items.title: 极简人物
items.promptZh:
《火影忍者》中五位英俊的晓成员站在广阔的黑白排版背景的中心，高角度宽阔的俯视构图，松散的舞台编队，具有清晰的戏剧深度层次。前景主角：宇智波鼬身着标志性的红云纹黑斗篷，一头乌黑长发，沉着冷静作为视觉主播；在他身后的是佩恩（Deva Path），穿着同样的晓斗篷，橙色的头发和穿孔，星垣鬼鲛穿着鲨鱼般的轮廓，背上鲛肌，迪达拉扎着金发马尾辫，有着粘土艺术家的态度，宇智波带土戴着飞鸟风格的橙色螺旋面具，穿着晓斗篷，有着令人不安的冷酷存在。优质日本商业动漫主视觉和视觉小说封面质量。

服装强调共同的晓黑色斗篷，带有深红色云图案、高领、分层面料、宽袖、腰带和高对比度装饰；斗篷下摆通过透视向外扩展。有些人拿着苦无、卷轴或武器，在移动后立即冻结姿势，在下一场战斗之前暂停。没有明显的笑容；平静、克制、略显疏远或威胁的目光靠近镜头。

白砖地面与巨大的黑色英文字母融合在一起，接近正午的硬定向自然光，清晰的人物阴影，强烈的图形对比度。动漫动画着色、干净锐利的线条、轻微的动画风格的透视夸张、微妙地偏离中心的实机构图，而不是完美的商业对称。所有角色均清晰成人、衣着整齐、风格化的动漫插图。

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:
电影般的高端杂志封面风格海报，以【柔术回旋的名人】为绝对主题，以优雅动感的姿势拍摄逼真的人体cosplay时尚摄影，以垂直2:3的比例构图。将角色转变为具有奢华时装模特光环的可信真人，带着亲密而内敛的凹版首次亮相氛围。完美保留了角色标志性的五官、眼神和辨识度，让他们感觉像是一个真实存在的真人。真实的人体皮肤纹理，细腻的次表面散射、细微的毛孔、柔软的桃绒绒和自然的皮肤光泽。精致的锁骨和领口，优雅的肩颈比例，尽显精致自然的女性魅力。逼真的日本缪斯风格的面部结构、柔焦但锐利的眼睛、带有自然聚光的光滑玻璃般的眼睛、精致的面部轮廓和真正的摄影级皮肤细节。

发型应该将角色的标志性头发重新诠释为逼真的奢华沙龙品质造型，而不是廉价的角色扮演假发。保留原来的发型轮廓和颜色，同时使其适应现实的重力和发丝重量。自然松散的发丝，层次分明的发丝，层次分明的造型，还有微微梦幻的体积感。强烈的背光增强了头发的光泽和轮廓。

服装应忠实再现角色的原始服装，同时将其转化为奢华的高级时装美学。使用优质面料和精致的细节，精确保留角色的标志性调色板、图案和设计语言。服装应完美贴合身体，具有自然皱纹和真实的材质反射，完全避免任何廉价塑料角色扮演的外观。

姿势和面部表情应该类似于高级时尚杂志封面的特写到中景姿势。自然优雅的肢体语言，温柔的眼神，带着微妙的亲密感。姿势应准确反映人物的性格和情感气场。

环境和氛围应与角色的原始世界、身份和个性相匹配，并具有豪华的电影背景。浅景深，柔和的大气雾霾，梦幻般的电影氛围。青色、青色或月光色调等冷色调环境照明与照亮皮肤的暖色调灯光相结合，并通过精致的边缘照明增强效果，营造出精致且充满情感的氛围。

灯光和纹理应类似于电影商业摄影，强调皮肤、织物和头发的真实纹理。高对比度、豪华级修饰、超高细节和电影调色。柔和而富有雕塑感的灯光营造出印刷奢华时尚杂志的优质品质。

构图和排版应遵循经典的豪华杂志封面布局。包括具有强烈的角色身份和神秘感的日文主标题、罗马化或英文角色名称、优雅的英文标语、圆形邮票或标志、虚构的杂志品牌、微妙的条形码元素、定价详细信息和真实的杂志印刷设计元素。版式应将日语汉字、平假名、罗马字和英文文本以优雅的间距和层次结构混合在一起，与角色自然地融合在一起，创造出可信的真实杂志封面效果。

整体美感与氛围梦幻、奢华、亲密又内敛、神秘又优雅、电影般、时尚、含蓄又精致，具有高端时尚杂志封面的视觉品质、浅景深、超写实的人体皮肤渲染、商业摄影级的写实感。
items.prompt:
A cinematic high-end magazine cover style poster featuring 【Jujutsu Kaisen no Meijin】 as the absolute main subject, captured as realistic human cosplay fashion photography in an elegant dynamic pose, composed in a vertical 2:3 ratio. Transform the character into a believable real human with the aura of a luxury fashion model, carrying an intimate yet restrained gravure debut atmosphere. Perfectly preserve the character’s iconic facial features, gaze, and recognizability, making them feel like a real person who truly exists. Realistic human skin texture with delicate subsurface scattering, subtle pores, soft peach fuzz, and natural skin sheen. Refined collarbones and neckline, elegant shoulder-to-neck proportions, and sophisticated natural feminine charm. A realistic Japanese muse-inspired facial structure, soft-focus yet sharp eyes, glossy glass-like eyes with natural catchlights, refined facial contours, and true photographic-level skin detail.

The hairstyle should reinterpret the character’s iconic hair into a realistic luxury salon-quality styling rather than a cheap cosplay wig. Preserve the original hairstyle silhouette and color while adapting it to realistic gravity and strand weight. Natural loose strands, layered hair texture, structured styling, and a slightly dreamy sense of volume. Strong backlighting enhances the shine and silhouette of the hair.

The outfit should faithfully recreate the character’s original costume while translating it into a luxurious haute couture aesthetic. Precisely preserve the character’s signature color palette, patterns, and design language using premium fabrics and refined detailing. The clothing should perfectly fit the body with natural wrinkles and authentic material reflections, completely avoiding any cheap plastic cosplay appearance.

The pose and facial expression should resemble a close-up to medium-shot high-fashion magazine cover pose. Natural and elegant body language with a gentle gaze that carries a subtle sense of intimacy. The pose should accurately reflect the character’s personality and emotional aura.

The environment and atmosphere should match the character’s original universe, identity, and personality with a luxurious cinematic setting. Shallow depth of field, soft atmospheric haze, dreamy cinematic mood. Cool-toned ambient lighting such as cyan, teal, or moonlight tones combined with warm key lighting illuminating the skin, enhanced by refined rim lighting to create a sophisticated and emotionally charged atmosphere.

Lighting and texture should resemble cinematic commercial photography, emphasizing the realistic texture of skin, fabric, and hair. High contrast, luxury-grade retouching, ultra-high detail, and cinematic color grading. Soft yet sculptural lighting that creates the premium quality of a printed luxury fashion magazine.

The composition and typography should follow a classic luxury magazine cover layout. Include a Japanese main title with a strong sense of character identity and mystery, the romanized or English character name, elegant English taglines, circular stamps or emblems, fictional magazine branding, subtle barcode elements, pricing details, and authentic magazine-print design elements. Typography should mix Japanese kanji, hiragana, romaji, and English text with elegant spacing and layered composition, naturally integrated with the character to create a believable real magazine cover effect.

The overall aesthetic and atmosphere should feel dreamlike, luxurious, intimate yet restrained, mysterious and elegant, cinematic, fashionable, subtly sensual yet sophisticated, with the visual quality of a high-end fashion magazine cover, shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic human skin rendering, and commercial photography-level realism.

items.title: Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Medium s…
items.promptZh:
垂直长宽比为 3:4。从头顶到大腿中部的中景取景。
在一个安静的雨夜，一位 20 岁出头的年轻东亚女性坐在偏右的低矮风化石壁上。她拿着一把完全透明的乙烯基雨伞，占据了画面的上三分之一，上面覆盖着独特的、闪闪发光的雨滴，在光线下闪闪发光；透过透明材料和微妙的光折射，她的形体仍然清晰可见。

她的皮肤呈浅象牙米色，质感自然，脸颊和鼻尖有淡淡的红晕，肩膀和锁骨有柔和的高光。香槟米色和粉棕色色调的妆容，精致的长睫毛，自然微妙的眼底轮廓，半透明的粉米色嘴唇。她微微侧着头，平静而从容地注视着镜头，双眸中闪烁着清澈明亮的光芒。她的中长发呈浅奶茶灰棕色，薄薄的透明刘海，修饰脸型，发尾处有松散的向内卷发，边缘稍稍湿润。

她穿着一件浅米色吊带背心，上面有蕾丝和小花卉图案，胸部靠近深乳沟处有一条细丝带细节，搭配一条配套的长裙，裙子有深侧垂褶和开衩。轻盈的罗纹开衫宽松地从肩上滑落，形成自然柔软的褶皱。姿势：右手轻轻握住伞柄靠近胸前，左手轻靠在身后的壁架上支撑；右腿向前弯曲伸直，左腿自然垂于壁架一侧，姿势轻松稳定。

环境：夜间安静的小花园露台。前景：低矮的雨水湿润灌木；中景：盆栽针叶树、粗糙的石墙、左下角的发光小灯笼；背景：柔和模糊的湿铺路，远处的建筑物入口，所有标牌都完全难以辨认。

灯光：柔和、柔和的正面闪光灯从稍偏左的位置，均匀地照亮她的脸、肩膀和腿，没有刺眼的眩光；右上角的温暖琥珀色路灯投射出微妙的边缘光，并在潮湿的石头、人行道和雨滴上产生金色的反射。背景色调是深沉柔和的绿色和近乎黑色，使气氛保持黑暗和大气。

风格：逼真的夜间时尚肖像，重点关注脸部、手部和雨滴细节；浅景深柔和地模糊了背景。视角自然，广角无畸变。保留精细细节：单独的发丝、潮湿的表面反射、伞状透明度、带有细微毛孔的真实皮肤纹理。微妙的怀旧数码照片颗粒，冷暖光线平衡。 2:3

负面的不自然的面部或凝视，过度平滑的塑料般的皮肤，过度修饰，多余/缺失/融合的手指，肢体变形，手或腿的姿势不正确，衣服成束或扭曲，透视不正确，阴影冲突，过度曝光，清晰的文字，徽标，水印，不切实际的伞不透明度。
items.prompt:
Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Medium shot framing from crown of head to mid-thigh.
A young East Asian woman in her early 20s sits slightly right of center on a low weathered stone ledge on a quiet rainy night. She holds a fully transparent vinyl umbrella that occupies the upper third of the frame, covered in distinct, sparkling raindrops that glisten in the light; her form remains clearly visible through the clear material with subtle light refraction.

Her skin is light ivory-beige with natural texture, faint rosy flush on cheeks and nose tip, soft highlights on shoulders and collarbones. Makeup in champagne beige and pink-brown tones, delicate long lashes, natural subtle under-eye definition, translucent pink-beige lips. She tilts her head slightly, gazing calmly and composedly at the camera with clear, bright catchlights in her eyes. Her medium-long hair is light milky tea ash brown, with thin see-through bangs, face-framing layers, and loose inward curls at the ends, lightly dampened at the edges.

She wears a light beige camisole top with lace and tiny floral patterns, a thin ribbon detail at the chest, near the deep cleavage, paired with a matching long skirt with a deep side drape and slit. A lightweight ribbed cardigan slips loosely off her shoulders, forming natural soft folds. Pose: right hand holds the umbrella handle gently near her chest, left hand rests lightly on the ledge behind her for support; right leg bends and extends forward, left leg hangs naturally down the side of the ledge, posture relaxed and stable.

Setting: small quiet garden terrace at night. Foreground: low rain-wet shrubs; midground: potted conifers, rough stone wall, a small glowing lantern on the lower left; background: softly blurred wet paved path, distant building entrance, all signage rendered completely illegible.

Lighting: soft, gentle frontal flash from slightly left, illuminating her face, shoulders and legs evenly without harsh glare; warm amber streetlight from upper right casts subtle rim light and creates golden reflections on wet stone, pavement, and raindrops. Background tones are deep muted greens and near-blacks, keeping the atmosphere dark and atmospheric.

Style: photorealistic nighttime fashion portrait, sharp focus on her face, hands, and raindrop details; shallow depth of field softly blurs the background. Natural perspective, no wide-angle distortion. Retain fine details: individual hair strands, wet surface reflections, umbrella transparency, realistic skin texture with subtle pores. Subtle nostalgic digital photo grain, warm-cold light balance. 2:3

Negative unnatural face or gaze, over-smoothed plastic-like skin, excessive retouching, extra/missing/fused fingers, deformed limbs, awkward hand or leg positioning, clothing bunching or distortion, incorrect perspective, conflicting shadows, overexposure, legible text, logos, watermarks, unrealistic umbrella opacity.

items.title: 赛博朋克女性
items.prompt:
[BRAND NAME = CHANGE TO YOUR BRAND]. 
Act as a Social Media Art Director and Digital Collage Artist specializing in bold, youth-oriented brand content for Instagram and digital campaigns. PHASE 1: CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK Create a dynamic digital collage that merges fashion photography with graphic design chaos. This is controlled rebellion – a composition that feels spontaneous and energetic while maintaining brand coherence. The aesthetic is anti-polished: torn edges, layered textures, hand-drawn elements, and bold color blocking that screams confidence and movement. PHASE 2: MODEL & PHOTOGRAPHY - Subject: One model (diverse casting, age 18-30) in a dynamic, confident pose - Pose Energy: 80% attitude, 20% natural – sitting, jumping, mid-motion, or power stance (avoid static standing) - Outfit: Street style/athleisure that aligns with [BRAND NAME] aesthetic – casual but styled - Hero Product: Feature 1 signature [BRAND NAME] product prominently (sneakers, bag, apparel) – this is the visual anchor - Photography Style: Editorial fashion cutout – model extracted from background with clean edges - Camera Angle: Slight low angle to empower subject (hero perspective) - Crop: Full body or 3/4 body showing hero product clearly - Background Removal: Model cut out cleanly for layering over collage elements PHASE 3: COLOR BLOCKING FOUNDATION - Primary Color Blob: Large organic shape (40-60% of composition) in bold, saturated brand color behind/around model - Shape Style: Irregular, hand-painted aesthetic – think Photoshop brush strokes or torn paper texture (NOT perfect geometric shapes) - Color Selection (Autonomous): Choose 1 hero color from [BRAND NAME] palette: - Texture: Visible brush strokes, grain, or subtle noise (15-25% opacity) – avoid flat digital fills - Placement: Blob positioned to frame model without obscuring key product details PHASE 4: GRAPHIC ELEMENTS LAYER Add 3-5 abstract graphic elements scattered across composition: - Element Types: - Color Palette: Use 2-3 accent colors total (main blob color + 1-2 contrasting tones from brand palette) - Placement: Asymmetric scatter – top-left and bottom-right zones primarily (avoid center crowding) - Scale: Mix small (5% of canvas) and medium (15% of canvas) elements – nothing overpowering - Aesthetic: Analog/handmade feel – imperfect circles, rough edges, visible texture PHASE 5: TYPOGRAPHY INTEGRATION - Brand Logo: Clean [BRAND NAME] logo placed in upper-left or upper-right quadrant (10-15% of width) - Slogan/Tagline: If [BRAND NAME] has an iconic slogan, integrate it using: - Supporting Copy: Optional 1-line descriptor (e.g., "A MOMENT OF YOUR STYLE") in smaller uppercase sans-serif - Type Treatment: Mix of aligned and slightly rotated text (2-5° angles) for dynamic energy - Hierarchy: Logo largest → Slogan medium → Copy smallest PHASE 6: TEXTURE & BACKGROUND - Base Layer: Off-white or light gray textured background (NOT pure white) - Texture Options (Autonomous selection): - Color: RGB 245-250 (near-white with warmth) – maintains brightness while adding depth - Treatment: Texture should be felt, not seen – enhances tactility without competing with foreground PHASE 7: COMPOSITION RULES - Layout: Asymmetric balance – model off-center, graphic elements counter-balance - Breathing Room: 15-20% negative space (textured background visible) to prevent claustrophobia - Layering Order: Background texture → Color blob → Graphic elements → Model (cutout) → Typography top layer - Focal Point: Model + hero product = primary focus (60% visual weight), graphics support (40%) - Movement: Diagonal lines and angled elements create directional flow (top-left to bottom-right or vice versa) PHASE 8: BRAND INTELLIGENCE (AUTONOMOUS) Autonomously adapt composition based on [BRAND NAME] personality: - Streetwear/Sportswear (Nike, Adidas, Supreme): - Luxury Streetwear (Balenciaga, Off-White, Gucci): - Beauty/Lifestyle (Glossier, Fenty, Skims): - Tech/Modern (Apple, Tesla, Beats): PHASE 9: SOCIAL MEDIA FOOTER (OPTIONAL) - Bottom Strip: Clean white or light gray bar at bottom 8-10% of frame - Content: Social media handles (Instagram, Facebook, Twitter) in small sans-serif - Layout: Three-column grid with platform icons or text handles - Aesthetic: Minimal and professional – contrast with chaotic collage above TECHNICAL SPECS: - Aspect Ratio: 4:5 (Instagram feed) or 1:1 (square social post) - Resolution: 2400x3000px minimum (high-quality for zoom and detail) - Color Mode: sRGB, vibrant saturation (Instagram-optimized) - File Aesthetic: Digital collage that mimics analog craft (Photoshop + hand-drawn hybrid) - Model Photography: 85mm lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field on original shoot (before cutout) - Style Reference: Nike social campaigns, Spotify wrapped graphics, Gen Z Instagram aesthetics, Hypebeast x streetwear collabs - Mood: Confident, energetic, youthful, authentic chaos, anti-corporate polish

items.title: A hyper-realistic smartphone photography style image,
items.titleZh: 超现实的智能手机摄影风格图像，
items.prompt:
A hyper-realistic smartphone photography style image, vertical 3:4 composition, combining high-end fashion editorial photography with authentic everyday lifestyle documentation. A fictional adult Japanese woman is captured at the exact moment when a friend casually raises a smartphone and photographs her just before she bends down to pick up a lightweight cardigan placed on the floor. The image captures the instant before the movement begins, with her upper body naturally twisting. She is not posing and is unaware of being photographed. It should feel like a private everyday moment accidentally preserved in a phone gallery, not a commercial fashion advertisement or studio portrait.

The visual focus is not a character portrait, but the construction of the fitted greige multi-layer cutout top from the neckline to the abdomen, the tension of the fabric, and the delicate shadows created where the textile meets the skin.

Warm and quiet indoor atmosphere, like a casual moment while getting ready to go out. Low-saturation color palette, soft neutral tones, natural smartphone snapshot feeling. Avoid catalog photography, luxury studio styling, or staged fashion posing.

The model is a fictional adult Japanese woman over 25 years old, with no resemblance to any real person or celebrity. She has a healthy, naturally proportioned feminine figure with a realistic hourglass silhouette. She has naturally full, rounded breasts with an approximately I-cup visual effect, while maintaining realistic human proportions without exaggeration. Her feminine curves are naturally expressed through the fit of the clothing, fabric tension, and realistic body structure rather than a deliberately emphasized pose.

Her face, eyes, nose, and mouth are almost completely outside the frame. No chin is visible. No eye contact with the camera. Only the base of her neck and a small amount of hair extending beyond the frame are visible.

She has long dark brown hair. Most of the hair remains outside the composition, with only a few strands naturally falling beside the left side of her neck and shoulder. The hairstyle should not look overly arranged. A few loose strands should appear slightly displaced by movement.

The framing captures only the area from the base of the neck down to slightly below the navel and the upper hip area. Arms, legs, and head remain outside the frame. The torso axis tilts diagonally from upper left to lower right by approximately 25 degrees. One shoulder is slightly pulled backward, while the opposite waist moves closer to the camera. Because she is shifting her weight during movement, the transition from chest to abdomen creates a natural asymmetrical S-shaped curve. The abdomen should not be excessively arched.

The skin has a warm light beige tone with subtle yellow and pink undertones. Natural variations in skin color and fine skin texture remain visible across the chest, side waist, and abdomen. The skin has a soft matte appearance without oily shine. The cutout edges and knitted straps create delicate continuous shadows on the skin, allowing the three-dimensional form to appear naturally through realistic light and fabric interaction.

She wears a low-saturation light greige, warm taupe, and soft beige-gray fitted sleeveless cropped top. The garment features a wide band-style high neckline and a close-fitting silhouette. The fabric is a thin matte stretch jersey similar to a rayon-polyester blend, with subtle micro-knit texture.

The top tightly follows the natural body shape and features a continuous multi-layer cutout structure extending from the neckline to the abdomen. The cutouts are not simple horizontal lines. They are elongated leaf-shaped and almond-shaped openings, slightly wider in the center and sharper toward both ends. The upper chest area contains relatively larger cutouts, while the openings gradually become smaller, narrower, and shorter toward the abdomen. The left and right sides are naturally stretched differently according to the body twist, creating realistic asymmetry.

The visible skin area should be maximized while still maintaining a believable wearable garment structure. The fabric remains opaque and properly covers necessary areas, avoiding accidental exposure.

The cutout structure includes a small horizontal slit below the collarbone, multiple larger leaf-shaped openings across the upper chest area, and several narrow elongated openings across the abdomen. The outer sides of the openings gradually widen, while the central tips connect directly into the knitted lace structure. The garment should not be perfectly symmetrical. The side affected by body rotation appears slightly compressed, while the side closer to the camera appears slightly extended.

A matching soft tubular strap, approximately 8–12mm wide, connects the edges of the cutouts through the center of the garment. Instead of a simple corset-style shoelace design, the structure forms repeated X-shaped crossings and elongated diamond patterns vertically. Each intersection creates small knots and vertical woven details. The upper section has larger woven patterns, gradually becoming finer toward the abdomen. The straps have realistic tension, with subtle irregularities in spacing and angles.

The fabric behavior should be realistic. Around the chest area, the stretch fabric pulls naturally in both directions, causing the leaf-shaped openings to expand slightly along the body curve. The central woven straps carry gentle tension and create continuous soft shadows underneath. The abdomen area has slightly reduced tension with subtle horizontal and diagonal wrinkles. The side fabric naturally wraps around the body, with a small part of the hem floating a few millimeters away from the skin.

Only a very thin gold chain necklace is worn. It is partially visible around the left side of the neck and collarbone area, with part of it disappearing behind the cutout structure. No large pendant, earrings, watch, or other accessories.

The background is an ordinary indoor living space with white to warm gray walls. Slight wall texture, soft shadows, and small everyday details remain visible. The person occupies approximately most of the frame, with only small areas of background visible around the edges. Background objects such as a woven basket, paper bag, or small household item may appear subtly, but they should not attract attention.

Use a smartphone standard wide-angle camera, similar to an iPhone 16 Pro or iPhone 17 Pro native camera. Vertical handheld photography, equivalent to approximately 26mm lens. The camera is about 40–55cm from the subject, positioned around chest height or slightly higher, slightly from the left front angle. Focus on the central woven structure of the garment while keeping the chest-to-abdomen area naturally sharp. Do not create strong background blur.

Soft natural window light enters from the upper left, mixed with a weak warm indoor light source. The lighting is diffused and gentle, with medium-low contrast. Thin shadows appear beneath the woven straps and cutout edges. The neck area becomes slightly darker due to hair shadow. Avoid strong flash, hard spotlight, or studio lighting.

The image should have realistic smartphone photo characteristics: low saturation, slightly warm white balance, subtle JPEG compression, mild highlight clipping, very weak brightness noise in darker areas, and natural handheld imperfections. Avoid excessive HDR, cinematic color grading, strong vignette, or heavy film effects.

Add realistic imperfections: slight clockwise camera tilt of around 3 degrees, subtle asymmetry in the cutouts, woven details, shoulder height, and garment hem position. One or two strands of hair may overlap the clothing naturally. The fabric should retain small wrinkles caused by tension. The image edges may show slight wide-angle lens distortion. The hair tips may contain a tiny amount of motion blur.

Composition: vertical 3:4 frame. Place the neck area slightly toward the upper left and the abdomen area toward the lower right. The central woven structure creates a diagonal visual line through the frame. Keep the face, arms, and legs completely outside the composition. The visual focus should remain on the boundary between fabric and skin, the garment construction, and the realistic movement of the body.

items.title: 世界杯体育专题海报
items.prompt: 创作一张采用现代 {argument name="event" default="FIFA World Cup"} 宣传风格的高端体育专题海报。构图主体为一名职业足球运动员，全身照，自信地站在画面中央，双臂张开呈胜利姿势，目光微仰，神情坚定。球员身后是一个巨大的白色粗体球衣号码，占据了背景的大部分空间，营造出醒目的层次感。背景为纯色国家队配色，带有细腻的纹理质感 ({argument name="color" default="葡萄牙红"})。球员站在巨型号码前，具有真实的阴影和完美的深度分离效果。在左上角以简洁的未来感几何字体放置球员姓氏，右上角放置国家队队徽。左下角显示超大号粗体球衣号码，后跟一个句号。右下角添加紧凑的专题信息，包括赛事名称、国家队、球员位置、队长标识（如适用）以及由细垂直线分隔的时尚条形码图形。保持极简、奢华的专题美学，确保完美的对齐、充裕的留白、清晰的排版和高端的体育品牌感。使用超写实光影、锐利的球衣细节、可见的织物纹理、自然的肤色、真实的阴影、高对比度和电影级调色。风格：现代专题、体育品牌、高端海报、极简平面设计、清晰排版、几何布局、醒目超大数字、超写实、照片级真实感、商业级品质、8K、HDR、杂志封面美学。

items.prompt: 创作一张具有电影质感的写实街头摄影作品，画面展示了一个悬挂在古老木质店铺或民居门口的传统日式夏季风铃。这个小巧透明的玻璃风铃上绘有蓝色花卉装饰，下方垂着一条细长的矩形纸条，上面印有蓝色海浪图案。背景是深色陈旧木框下的米色纹理灰泥墙，右上角附近有一盏黑色金属吊灯。通过左侧的门洞，展示出一条光影柔和、宁静的日本小巷，巷内有木质建筑和绿树，光线明亮，景深较浅。在图像的中心和下半部分叠加一个巨大的粗体白色书法汉字，内容为 {argument name="calligraphy character" default="风"}，汉字仿佛绘制在玻璃上，部分环绕着风铃；笔触厚实、清晰且呈现出明亮的白色。采用自然夏季光线，纹理逼真，色调温暖柔和，宽幅横向构图，纪实摄影风格，高细节，营造出宁静怀旧的氛围，画面中无人，无额外文字。

items.title: 风景极简产品山雪
items.prompt: 创建一张垂直堆叠的对比图，包含 2 个水平部分：顶部是 1 个小型珐琅冰箱贴的极简主义摄影棚产品照，置于浅蓝色纹理背景中央，留有大量负空间；磁贴呈微型高山风景纪念品形状，带有闪亮的金色金属轮廓、凸起的珐琅细节、积雪的蓝灰色山峰、起伏的绿色丘陵、深色的常青树，以及前景中一簇簇细小的黄色、紫色和蓝色野花，投射出柔和逼真的阴影。底部是 {argument name="location" default="高山草甸山谷"} 在蓝天白云下的明亮逼真风景照：广阔起伏的绿色丘陵、远处带有积雪的山脉、深色的松树林，以及前景中开满黄色、紫色和蓝色花朵的野花草甸。在靠近下方中心的位置，加入 4 名骑马者穿过草甸，在广阔的风景中显得比例较小。使顶部的磁贴呈现出下方风景的精简纪念品版本，并保留相同的关键视觉元素：山脉、绿色丘陵、针叶树、野花和开阔的天空。采用简洁的编辑构图、逼真的光影、清晰的细节、柔和的阴影以及宁静的旅行记忆美学。无可见文字，无标签，无水印。

items.title: 鸟极简封面山雪优雅
items.prompt: 设计一款精致的极简拼贴风格中文文学书籍封面，背景为带有细微颗粒感和淡淡陈旧感的暖白色纹理纸张。构图高挑优雅，右侧居中位置设有一个醒目的竖排中文标题，采用做旧的黑色书法字体，内容为“你当像鸟飞往你的山”，分为两列排版，右列为“你当像鸟”，左列为“飞往你的山”。顶部中央附近有一只精致的靛蓝色飞鸟，一条纤细的蓝色虚线飞行轨迹呈对角线向下延伸，穿过标题并指向右下方，营造出一种升腾与自由的意境。左下方放置一个巨大的三角形山峦形状，如同撕纸拼贴或楔形绘画，山峰呈白色积雪状，向下渐变为深群青色和海军蓝纹理。在山峦右侧边缘融入一条淡淡的竖排英文书籍正文，仿佛山峦是由印刷书页拼凑而成。在蓝色山峦内部，以白色衬线字体排版原始英文标题：第一行“Educated”，下方为“A Memoir”。左上方添加一小块竖排黑色中文引文，排成 6 行，下方加一条长破折号，接着是两行柔和蓝色衬线字体的作者名“Tara Westover”，随后再加一条破折号。右下边缘添加细长的竖排版权信息，包括作者的中文名，后跟蓝色的英文名“Tara Westover”，下方为黑色的译者和出版社信息。保持布局宽敞，利用强烈的留白、不对称平衡感，呈现出诗意的当代出版美学。仅使用 3 种主色：黑色、米白色和靛蓝色。整体氛围应体现出知识分子气息、克制、现代且具有获奖作品的质感，适用于由 {argument name="author name" default="Tara Westover"} 创作的 {argument name="book title" default="Educated"} 高端版本。

items.prompt: 创建一个 9:16 的竖版奢华营销海报，用于展示一款虚构的跨界产品，即 {argument name="brand one" default="HERMÈS PARIS"} 与 {argument name="brand two" default="拼多多"} 之间极具颠覆性的联名手袋广告。构图采用强烈的对撞拼贴风格，画面中央有一道垂直贯穿的撕纸裂缝，将两种冲突的美学一分为二：左侧为精致的高端奢华品牌风格，采用爱马仕橙、奶油色纸张及优雅的编辑式极简主义；右侧为充满侵略性的中国电商促销风格，以黑色和金属红箔为基调，配以醒目的促销图形、五彩纸屑、撕裂的贴纸以及极具爆发力的折扣字体。在顶部中央，显著放置两个品牌，并配以醒目的中文联名大标题；左侧标志区呈现经典奢侈品牌风格，使用衬线字体和马车徽标，右侧标志区则采用醒目的红色中式品牌风格。下方添加巨大的中文主标题：{argument name="headline text" default="颠覆性联名款"}，以及一个带边框的副标题：{argument name="subheadline text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}。画面中心是一只 Birkin 风格的奢华手袋，正面朝向且尺寸巨大，完美居中但被画面中央的撕裂缝一分为二：左半部分为橙色荔枝纹皮革配金色五金，右半部分为褶皱金属银色皮革配银色五金，两半无缝融合为一只超现实主义手袋。手袋周围或上方应包含 5 个清晰可见的配饰/产品元素：左侧悬挂 1 个橙色钥匙扣，右侧悬挂 1 个带锁的金属银色挂带，1 个中央旋转锁扣及挂锁，左下角放置 1 个带深色丝带的橙色爱马仕风格礼盒，以及左下角附近 1 个带有小徽标的米色防尘袋。手袋左后方是纹理奶油纸上的油画感橙色笔触；手袋右后方是带有火花般高光和飘落纸屑的压碎感红色金属包装纸表面。在右半部分，添加 8 个充满侵略性的促销文字爆点和贴纸，像购物节海报一样呈对角线层叠排列：1 个巨大的白色中文标语“百亿补贴 全网最低”，2 个“限时秒杀!!”，3 个写着“补贴价 ¥999?!”的撕裂价格贴纸，4 个“万件疯抢”，5 个“百亿补贴 官方直补”，6 个“直降到底”，7 个底部重复“补贴价 ¥999?!”的大型撕裂横幅，以及 8 个小字“建议零售价 ¥1000000+”。在左侧边缘，添加一列纤细的垂直编辑式文字，包含 4 个分组文本块，采用奢华布局：1 “限量发售 / 全球瞩目 / 2024 LIMITED EDITION”，2 “HERMÈS PARIS MADE IN FRANCE”，3 “CRAFTED FOR ELEGANCE”，4 “DESIGNED TO DEFY THE ORDINARY”。底部创建一个黑色的 App 风格信息栏，从左至右包含 3 个功能块：1 个带有“拼多多”字样的红色品牌图标，以及一个包含“百亿补贴铂金包”的搜索栏式胶囊按钮，2 个带有闪电图标及“百亿补贴 官方补贴 所以低价”文字的区域，3 个带有盾牌图标及“正品保障 假一赔十 3期免息”文字的区域。在最底部添加一行细小的中文最终标语。使用超精细的商业产品摄影、高级平面设计、锐利的灯光、压印纹理、箔片反光、纸张撕裂效果和强烈的景深。整体氛围必须如同顶级艺术总监强行将传统奢华广告与混乱的折扣促销海报融合在一起，产生极端的视觉张力、讽刺感和高冲击力的对比。

items.title: 建筑海报像素复古优雅
items.prompt:
目标：为虚构的“电子表格文明系列”创作一张超现实主义复古编辑海报，主题为 {argument name="headline concept" default="BUILDING PYRAMIDS IN EXCEL"}，将古代纪念碑式建筑与过时的办公软件焦虑相结合。

画布：竖版海报，2:3 比例，陈旧的米色纸张背景，带有污渍、灰尘、划痕、模糊的技术绘图标记、细小的套准十字线以及柔和的深褐色调。使用做旧的印刷杂志质感，如同档案科学手册与粗野主义拼贴艺术的结合。

布局：大型排版占据左上象限。一座巨大的阶梯金字塔占据中心和下半部分，采用仰视视角，底部有碎石。右上象限包含一个巨大的扁平橙色时钟图形。小的电子表格、图表和页边笔记像技术注释一样漂浮在金字塔周围。

主体：一座巨大的灰色石制阶梯金字塔，正面垂直裂开。破裂的开口处露出由深色金属板、电缆、管道、服务器、电线和工业机械组成的密集机械内部。混凝土块和碎片向外散落。在金字塔顶部，一个巨大的倾倒的灰白色桶或圆柱形容器正向金字塔右侧倾泻出一大股棕色的沙子或泥土。在桶上放置一个极简的橙色几何标志。

排版与可见文字：左上角的小字写着“// spreadsheet civilization series”以及一个小期刊号“03”。主标题采用高挑优雅的衬线字体堆叠：“BUILDING”然后是“PYRAMIDS”然后是“IN”，下方是超大加粗压缩的橙色块状字母“EXCEL”。在标题下方添加一段小文字：“我们用单元格和行构建我们的纪念碑，像堆砌石头一样堆叠公式，坚信它会永存。”在附近添加“fig. 3 — ambition.exe”。左下角小页脚文字：“v.95”、“build 4.59”、“© 1995–forever”。右下角小页脚文字：“sheet 1 of ∞”、“SUM(ambition)”、“#VALUE!”。在时钟附近，包含橙色的“4:59”以及微小的说明文字“almost done. again.”。在左侧添加一条垂直页边笔记，写着“measure twice, pivot table once.”。

需包含的离散元素：1 座中心破裂的金字塔；1 个倾倒并倾泻沙子的桶；1 个位于右上角的橙色时钟，带有数字 12、3、6、9，黑色指针指向大约 4:59；1 个位于右侧的像素化黑色沙漏图标；1 个位于金字塔下部中心附近的 Microsoft Excel 风格错误对话框；4 个漂浮的电子表格片段。这 4 个电子表格片段分别是：左上角的片段，标有 A、B、C、D 列和十进制数值行；左中部的片段，标有 A、B、C 列和 1–5 行；右中部的片段，标有 F、G 列和标有“Total”及百分比的行；右下角的片段，标有 K、L、M 列以及 Avg、Max、Min 等标签。

错误对话框细节：使对话框看起来像旧版 Windows 95 Microsoft Excel 警告框，带有蓝色标题栏，写着“Microsoft Excel”，一个黄色警告三角形，消息内容为“Not enough memory. Delete rows?”，以及一个居中的“OK”按钮。

视觉风格：模拟拼贴，写实的石头和碎石与扁平的矢量 UI 元素混合，柔和的米色-灰色-黑色调色板，带有焦橙色点缀，高颗粒感，轻微的油墨套印不准，柔和的阴影，磨损的纸张质感，细细的绘图线条以及背景中模糊的圆形图表。

items.title: 建筑3D海报城市
items.prompt: 一张适用于智能手机的竖版天气海报，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="成都"}，设计风格为梦幻般、超精细的微缩立体模型城市景观，背景为明亮的蓝天。在顶部中心位置，放置醒目的白色粗体中文城市名称，带有柔和的 3D 深度感和轻微的投影效果。在名称正下方，居中放置一个由圆润造型构成的蓬松白色云朵图标。图标下方，添加一行较小的白色文本显示 {argument name="date text" default="2026-04-22 星期三"}，接着是一行较大的白色粗体温度文本 {argument name="temperature text" default="28° / 18°"}，最后再添加一行居中的白色天气状况文本 {argument name="condition text" default="多云"}。保持所有文本垂直堆叠、间距均匀，并整齐地居中于图像上半部分。在下半部分，打造一个融合了中国传统水乡建筑与现代天际线的迷人城市：平静的绿松石色运河环绕着小岛，前景有 2 座小型拱形石桥，左侧岛屿上有一座凉亭，右侧中心附近有一座高大的多层宝塔，错落有致的灰瓦传统民居和店面，摆放着遮阳伞的户外茶桌，茂密的柳树、灌木、花卉以及水面上几艘小船。远景处展示现代化的天际线，包含许多玻璃摩天大楼和 1 座显眼的针状观光塔。在天空中散布恰好 5 朵柔和的积云（包含中央天气图标区域），并添加几只小鸟增添生机。采用温暖的晨光、电影级的空气透视感、浅景深、移轴微缩摄影美学、高度逼真的材质、水面细腻的倒影，以及精致且充满奇趣的旅游海报氛围。保持构图简洁，上方留出充足的天空空间，微缩城市集中在底部，呈现出高端天气应用首屏图像的效果。

items.title: 车写实UI
items.prompt: 创建一张 32:9 的超宽屏照片级逼真赛车游戏截图，视角为 Indy 风格椭圆形赛道比赛中的驾驶员座舱，赛道为 {argument name="race track" default="the Indianapolis 500 speedway"}。摄像机位于黑色开轮式赛车内部的低位，展示了 Halo/驾驶舱边缘、带有微型数字遥测数据的方向盘、部分可见的前轮胎，以及两侧各一个、共 2 个矩形侧后视镜，反射出后方的赛道。前方有 2 辆开轮式竞争对手赛车：左侧为一辆黑蓝色赛车，右侧为一辆黄橙色赛车，均从后方视角呈现，带有巨大的后轮和尾翼，正并排驶入一个平缓的左转倾斜弯道。利用沥青路面、防护网和拥挤看台上的动态模糊营造强烈的速度感，同时保持赛车和驾驶舱主体清晰。赛道为大型椭圆形，配有白色混凝土墙、高大的安全围栏、两侧满座的观众席，远处左中位置设有计分塔/标杆。明亮的午间阳光，蓝天白云，电影级 HDR 真实感，光泽碳纤维，细节丰富的轮胎橡胶，沉浸式 AAA 级赛车模拟器风格。在驾驶舱侧面添加小型白色赞助商风格文字，内容为 {argument name="cockpit sponsor text" default="NEWGARDEN"}，但避免在其他地方出现明显的易读标识。无 UI 覆盖，无水印，无额外车辆，无文字说明。

items.title: 黑白报纸风小说海报
items.prompt: 参考上传图片的黑白暗黑报纸风，把我提供的文章内容重新排版成中文故事海报。黑色磨损纸张背景，白色粗粝字体，旧报纸、杂志拼贴、手写涂抹和划痕质感，不规则分栏排版，重点句使用超大标题或撕纸框突出。文字尽量清晰准确，整体克制、有情绪、有故事感。图片比例 4:5，适合发推；内容放不下可分成多张，每张单独生成，不要拼图，不要水印和多余英文。

items.title: 电影感女性
items.prompt:
Create a vertical 3:4 timed smartphone portrait of an adult-coded young woman, visually around 20 to 25 years old, wearing a black-and-white gothic nurse and bunny-ear cosplay outfit. She is seated or leaning forward beneath a phone fixed above her on a stand. This is not a mirror selfie: the phone and stand remain outside the frame, leaving both of her hands free. Position the camera approximately 40 to 50 degrees above eye level, nearly centered in front of her and looking downward. Use the gentle perspective of a close 24 to 28 mm full-frame-equivalent smartphone lens, making the head, eyes, hands and plush ears appear prominent while the torso and waist gradually recede toward the lower frame.

Frame the scene from the oversized ears down to the waist area. Place her face in the upper central region without perfect alignment or mechanical symmetry. Her head tilts subtly toward the viewer's right, and her face lifts toward the camera. Both eyes look directly into the lens. Raise both hands beside her cheeks and temples, bend the wrists gently inward and curve the fingers into a cat-paw face-framing gesture. The thumbs point toward the jaw and cheeks while the other fingers create arched frames around the face. The hand on the viewer's left sits slightly lower and the hand on the viewer's right sits slightly higher. Both elbows open outward. Maintain believable five-finger anatomy, natural joints, convincing wrist angles and small gaps between the fingers. Give her moderately long almond-shaped nails painted translucent nude pink or creamy beige.

Her expression is quiet, soft and knowingly playful. The lips remain gently closed or separated by an extremely narrow gap, with the corners raised into a restrained small smile and no visible teeth. Her gaze should not appear vacant; she is consciously engaging with the camera, combining sweetness with a mild mischievous quality. Preserve the original softly rounded short-oval facial contour, naturally tapered but not sharply pointed chin, eye spacing, large eyes, narrow nose bridge, small nose tip, soft lip shape and slight natural asymmetry. Do not force an extreme V-shaped jaw, excessively raise the nose bridge or enlarge the lips.

Use refined makeup inspired by Japanese jirai-kei, ryousangata and anime cosplay aesthetics without assigning a celebrity, ethnicity, nationality or identity. Apply a bright ivory complexion with a neutral-cool base that shifts into soft peach-pink under the warm indoor light. Add gray-brown circle lenses with translucent softly defined iris edges. Blend rose pink and pale mauve through the eye sockets, deepening the outer corners slightly. Draw thin black upper eyeliner with subtly lowered outer corners. Add pink shading beneath the eyes and tiny silver-white glitter around the inner corners and aegyo-sal. Keep the lashes fine and separated rather than thick and heavy. Add soft pink blush under the eyes and on the nose tip. Finish the lips with a moist semi-translucent berry-pink gradient gloss and restrained wet highlights.

Her hair is dense deep black with extremely subtle dark-brown reflections under the frontal light. Thick blunt bangs cover the eyebrows, with slight natural separation along the lower edge. Long straight sections form low twin-tail or low twin-section structures on both sides, falling along the cheeks and over the chest, with ends curving gently inward. The hair should appear smooth, dense and semi-matte, deliberately styled for cosplay while retaining a few flyaways, crossing strands, uneven bang divisions and slightly mismatched ends. Avoid greasy shine or a perfectly molded plastic-wig appearance.

Place a white nurse cap at the center of the crown, displaying a prominent black cross or plus-shaped graphic, with a small amount of black lace visible behind it. Attach a pair of oversized white plush rabbit ears. The ear on the viewer's left extends outward and then hangs downward through the upper-left and left edges of the frame. The ear on the viewer's right rises over the head, arches toward the upper-right and continues beyond the frame. Do not make the ears identical. They should be thick, fluffy and soft with slightly irregular fibers. Add one black satin bow to each side of the hair, with a longer ribbon tail on the viewer's right.

Dress her in a cropped white high-neck top that combines nurse-uniform, gothic-maid and bunny-cosplay elements. Around the neck, include fine white ruffles, black piping, black sheer ruffle trim and a narrow black band. Hang a black cross-shaped pendant at the center with tiny silver-toned connector highlights. Run vertical black lace details along the torso and place black cross appliqués and short rectangular accents across the chest and abdomen. Finish the cropped hem with a translucent black pleated or tulle ruffle. Cover the shoulders with white short sleeve pieces, leaving one section of upper arm exposed between the short sleeve and detached sleeve on the viewer's left. Let both hands emerge from oversized white flared cuffs edged with narrow black lace.

The white material should resemble soft matte lightweight uniform cloth or a cotton blend. Let the wide sleeves form natural folds and stacked creases as the arms are raised. Keep the bodice neatly fitted but not tight. The chest remains fully covered by the high-neck garment and creates only a soft natural fabric contour, with no cleavage and no exaggerated bust. Expose only a limited strip of slim waist and lower abdomen beneath the cropped hem, mainly at the bottom center. The abdomen is naturally smooth with a gentle curve created by leaning forward, without pronounced muscles, ribs or hollow definition. Keep the lower garment almost entirely outside the frame, allowing only a small hint of black-and-white waistband, ruffle or skirt edge along the bottom. Do not invent a fully visible skirt, stockings, buttocks or legs.

Visible skin consists of the full face, both hands and fingers, small portions of the wrists, one exposed upper-arm section on the viewer's lower-left side, and a limited strip of waist and lower abdomen. Only an extremely narrow area of neck appears above the central collar. Use bright ivory skin with a neutral-cool base and creamy peach transitions under the warm-white light. The facial skin should appear finely textured and soft, as though it would feel slightly cool, smooth and gently hydrated, while subtle natural variation remains beneath the eyes, beside the nose and around the lips. Apply slightly less diffusion to the hands so faint knuckle and palm-edge texture remains. The exposed upper arm and abdomen should look warm, smooth and soft to the touch, with believable tonal variation rather than waxy, rubbery or completely textureless skin.

Set the portrait in a warm, slightly crowded private bedroom, small studio or cosplay preparation corner. Behind her on the left, include a wooden shelf or tabletop with stacked off-white ceramic bowls, cups or vessels. Add a brown textile, brush-like decoration or fringed soft object behind the left side. Near the upper-left edge, show part of a green cartoon print or decorative artwork. Let a small section of black lace pattern remain visible behind the nurse cap. Introduce silver tubular chair rails, shelving or furniture diagonally along the lower-left and lower edges. Behind her on the right, include an orange cartoon animal or pumpkin-colored cardboard decoration. Near the bottom, show parts of a patterned textile or cushion containing yellow, orange and green. Preserve a few household objects partially obscured by the subject, sleeves and rabbit ears. Do not reorganize the setting into a plain studio, luxury hotel or minimalist bedroom.

Illuminate the scene with warm indoor ambient light combined with soft warm-white frontal fill positioned close to or slightly above the camera axis. Make the face and hands the brightest areas, while the white garment and plush ears remain slightly less luminous but retain fabric and fiber detail. Let the heavy bangs cast a shallow soft shadow over the forehead. Preserve gentle natural shadows around the nostrils, lower lip, jaw, spaces between the fingers and interiors of the sleeves. Let the under-eye glitter produce tiny point reflections, place soft square or circular catchlights inside the irises, and give the glossy lips and nails moist restrained highlights. The plush ears should show soft diffuse reflection rather than harsh glare. Do not add hard rim light, dramatic backlight, cold blue nighttime lighting or polished cinematic studio illumination.

Render the portrait with believable smartphone computational processing: slightly soft, low in contrast and mildly warm, with moderate beauty diffusion on the skin while retaining recognizable detail in the eyes, lashes, hair strands, lace, fingers and nail edges. Preserve a small amount of mobile sensor noise, light JPEG compression, inconsistent background sharpness, flyaway hairs, fabric folds and edge interference. Keep the face, hands and front hair clear while allowing the more distant wooden shelf, ceramics, textiles and cartoon decorations to soften slightly but remain recognizable. Avoid ultra-clean advertising sharpness, aggressive HDR, exaggerated pore detail or flawless commercial studio polish.

She had just adjusted the nurse cap, satin bows and plush rabbit ears and had already started the timer. Design a 4:5 sports art poster for 'ATHELETE_NAME' using realistic, soft, thick painted motion fields, player’s leap translated into directional brush energy, a vertical ascension composition, and an emotional goal of disciplined transcendence and cold precision. 

CONCEPT: player is not just depicted—he is constructed out of force. His iconic jump is visualized as a surge of realistic paint strokes based on PLAYER’s team jersey colors, rising like a controlled explosion, turning athletic elevation into a visual language of upward pressure, discipline, and momentum. The poster captures the instant where physical power becomes abstract motion. 

SUBJECT: player rendered as a dominant semi-abstract figure emerging from layered, soft, freshly painted strokes rather than a fully literal photograph. His body is partially defined—recognizable facial structure and torso clarity—but limbs dissolve into sweeping, thick paint gestures, especially around the legs and arms, emphasizing lift and motion. The figure is angled upward, as if still climbing, occupying the central vertical axis but never fully contained. 

COMPOSITION: A vertical ascension layout where the bottom third is dense with heavy, soft, realistic brush strokes, gradually opening into lighter, more fluid white space toward the top. The eye path starts at thick, grounded painted textures and travels upward through flowing lines and fragmented form into player’s mid-air presence. Negative space at the top acts as a zone of calm highlight contrast against the dense painted energy below. The background behaves like a freshly painted atmosphere, not a flat field, with directional strokes reinforcing upward motion.

TYPOGRAPHY: Headline: 'RISE WITHOUT LIMIT' set in a condensed athletic sans-serif brushed text, vertically stretched on the left side, and partially masked by soft paint strokes, as if emerging through layers. The baseline subtly curves upward, following the motion of the brushwork. 
Subhead: 'Discipline becomes flight.' in a restrained grotesk, placed lower in the composition where the paint is densest, anchoring the concept. Accent microtext appears as thin, almost hand-marked annotations integrated into the brushwork, echoing motion paths rather than sitting as static text. 

LIGHTING: Painterly lighting logic rather than photographic realism—high-contrast highlights use the lightest jersey color or white painted strokes to simulate directional light, while darker jersey tones create shadow depth. The figure’s defined areas receive subtle, controlled highlights to maintain legibility within abstraction. 

COLORS: Dominant palette based on PLAYER’s current or most iconic team jersey colors. Use the primary jersey color as the anchor, the secondary jersey color as the main motion accent, and white or the lightest jersey tone for highlights and negative-space contrast. Shadows should lean into the darkest available jersey color or a deepened version of the primary team color. Supporting tones may include softened, desaturated transitions derived from the jersey palette only. The overall palette must feel customized to the player’s team identity while preserving clarity, control, and intensity. 

STYLE: Abstract expressionist sports art fused with disciplined athletic branding; realistic painterly motion meets precision performance. The style feels like a gallery-worthy sports portrait, balancing soft, thick brush energy with controlled composition. 

FINISH: Visible realistic brush textures with layered paint depth, soft thick impasto effect in dense areas, and smoother, freshly diluted strokes in upper regions. No digital gloss—finish leans tactile and artistic, with gentle edge feathering where paint dissolves into negative space. No unnecessary overlays or artificial effects.

items.title: 一张可爱、治愈风格的手绘贴纸页，背景为纯白色。整体构图为整洁…
items.prompt:
一张可爱、治愈风格的手绘贴纸页，背景为纯白色。整体构图为整洁的 3x3 网格，共 9 个独立贴纸单元，以均匀间距排列，不显示可见网格线，并保留充足的留白空间。

每个单元格中都包含一个风格统一的极简祖国人卡通角色：极简的抽象一下主要特征。角色的表情极简；
每个单元格中的角色都呈现不同的动作或姿态，并搭配一句简短的手写中文短语（例如：打卡、摸鱼、开会、加班、好困、无语、好饿、吃啥、没钱、迟到、下班、加油、画饼、拒绝、开摆），通过对话气泡、小牌子或手势互动来表现内容。

配色方面：每个单元格使用一种主导色，颜色从 红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、紫 中选择，色调柔和但饱和度较高，且仅应用于文字、对话框或少量小装饰元素。黑色线稿保持不变。不要使用渐变，全部为纯色平涂。

角色和文字位于每个单元格的中央或略微偏中心的位置，整体保留充足的呼吸感和留白。阴影要么完全没有，要么极其轻微。文字风格类似于小孩子随手写的字，俏皮可爱但仍然清晰易读。线条略微圆润。

整体风格：可爱（kawaii）、治愈、极简、手绘、Q版、扁平插画、贴纸包、表情包合集。

负面提示词（Negative Prompt）：
写实、3D、复杂背景、渐变、厚重阴影、可见网格边框、标准印刷字体、细致五官、凌乱排版、文字错误。

items.title: 建筑极简海报优雅
items.prompt: 创作一张极简主义电影质感的中国字体海报，背景为陈旧的暖米色纸张，画面中心为巨大的深朱红色中文标题文字 {argument name="headline text" default="故宫"}。这两个巨大的字符应像宏伟的宫殿建筑一样占据画面主体，其笔画呈现为红色的故宫宫墙。在字符顶端边缘添加传统的金黄色琉璃瓦屋顶和华丽的檐角，并包含小巧的装饰性屋脊兽。字符矗立在广阔空旷的石质庭院远端，底部配有浅色大理石栏杆和对称的露台。在画面正前方的中心位置，放置一个身穿深色外套的微小孤独身影，以突显比例感。采用低视角、正面、对称的构图，上方米色天空留出大量负空间，运用柔和的历史色调、细腻的胶片颗粒感、磨损的纸张纹理、红色漆面的轻微风化效果，以及受中国文化遗产和故宫启发的优雅海报设计美学。无需额外文字、Logo 或边框。

items.title: 杨梅科学解剖海报
items.prompt: 一张超精细的科学植物学海报，采用纯黑背景，画面中央为一个巨大的杨梅果实横截面，运用戏剧性的摄影棚灯光，呈现超微距食品摄影的真实感，表面湿润有光泽，色调为浓郁的深红至酒红色。果实呈现为半切的解剖标本，占据画面大部分空间；左半部分展示了覆盖着无数紧密排列的珠状突起的完整外皮，右半部分揭示了半透明的红色果肉，呈纤维状多汁纹理向中心腔体内的褐色大果核放射。左上方有优雅的象牙白色中文字体，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="杨梅·解剖"}，下方副标题为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="酸与甜的野性平衡"}。果实周围有 6 个中文标注区域，每个区域均配有纤细的象牙白色引导线和小圆点，指向精确的果实结构。区域 1 位于左上方，标注为“结构 01 果皮突起”，配有 4 行说明文字。区域 2 位于右上方，标注为“结构 02 多汁果肉”，配有 4 行说明文字。区域 3 位于中右侧，标注为“结构 03 种子”，配有 4 行说明文字。区域 4 位于左下方，标注为“结构 04 果肉细胞”，配有 4 行说明文字。区域 5 位于下中央，标注为“结构 05 果核（内果皮）”，配有 3 行说明文字。区域 6 位于右下方，标注为“结构 06 维管束”，配有 3 行说明文字。文字风格为精致、略带书法感的衬线中文字体，黑底白字，类似于博物馆展品说明牌或高端编辑信息图。构图对称且自然，负空间极少，质感奢华、具有教育意义、触感真实、细节丰富、对比度高，无多余物体，无边框，无水印。

items.title: 复古女性
items.prompt:
Create a photorealistic 2×2 character-editorial collage in an approximately 3:4 vertical format. Every panel must feature the same clearly adult woman, visually around 22 to 28 years old, with consistent facial structure, makeup, hair color, maid costume and headwear. Do not merge the four images into one continuous scene.

She has a compact oval face, a narrow jaw and prominently doll-like eye proportions. Her makeup combines Japanese gothic-lolita portraiture, doll-inspired editorials and Korean social-media beauty styling: a pale semi-matte base, fine natural brows, gray-green or cool-gray enlarging contacts, elongated black eyeliner, clearly separated upper and lower lashes, soft pink shading beneath the eyes, a few tiny freckle-like or beauty-mark dots, a gentle nose-tip highlight and muted gray-pink nude lips. Her lips remain slightly parted without a smile. In the upper-left close-up, she opens her eyes wide and looks directly into the lens. In the other panels, her eyelids are more relaxed or her gaze shifts slightly sideways. The overall expression should feel quiet, detached and self-possessed, like an ornate doll that has developed a will of its own.

Her hair is deep chestnut brown, reflecting warm chocolate-brown satin highlights under direct flash. It is long enough to reach the chest or waist and paired with a neat, softly airy blunt fringe. Preserve two curved face-framing sections, slightly inward-bending ends and loose natural arcs. Include a few flyaway hairs, the natural spread of hair in the reclining panel and small variations in fringe placement between photographs. Avoid a rigid wig texture or perfectly uniform styling.

She wears a vintage Japanese-inspired maid dress in deep navy and creamy white. The bodice has a square neckline, a white apron panel, short navy puff sleeves, white eyelet-lace cuffs and dark satin bow details. The skirt is short and flared, with a layered white ruffled apron and lace petticoat. The lace appears light, thin and mildly translucent, with fine visible texture. The navy fabric is thicker and holds a structured bell-shaped silhouette. Add smoky-black sheer thigh-high stockings and glossy black platform Mary Jane heels. Her wide black-and-white maid headband is built from sculptural creamy ruffles, dark satin ribbons and large black bows on both sides.

Visible skin includes the full face, neck, a small amount of collarbone, upper arms, forearms, hands and small areas of upper-thigh skin between the skirt and stockings. Her complexion is light neutral ivory with a subtle cool-pink undertone. Hard flash makes the skin appear creamy and bright, while shadowed areas shift toward soft gray-beige. The surface looks carefully made-up but still visually suggests a soft, fine, slightly cool and faintly powdery touch. Preserve natural joint color variation, subtle pores and small creases around the fingers, knees and arms. Avoid plastic or silicone-like skin.

The upper-left panel is a close bust portrait photographed near eye level. She looks directly into the camera and lightly touches the area beneath one eye or the cheek with a finger. Part of a black handgun-shaped theatrical prop enters from the side of the frame. Use premium ivory and midnight-blue fabrics, subtle gold thread embroidery, realistic skin texture, handwritten-style annotations, small arrows pointing to fabric details, and a prominent title area styled like a character name header. Clean design sheet, visually rich but readable.

items.title: 霓虹女性
items.prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGE INSTRUCTION: Use the uploaded product photo as the exact source of truth for the product's appearance, color, finish, branding, and form factor. Do not invent or alter any product detail. Reproduce it with photorealistic precision.
---
Create a photorealistic premium [PRODUCT CATEGORY] campaign poster in a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio. Design it as a clean global OOH, digital, and social campaign layout with strict grid alignment, premium white space, and precise typography. The campaign idea is "[CAMPAIGN TAGLINE]," but do not render that phrase as visible text.

Use a strict 12-column poster grid with 6% outer margins. Keep all text aligned to this grid. The image has four layers: background shape, giant background typography, subject/product photography, and clean graphic text overlays.

BACKGROUND: Pure matte white canvas. Place one large rounded-rectangle block behind the subject, occupying roughly 70% of the poster height and 76% of the width, centered slightly above the middle. The block uses a controlled [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] gradient, glowing gently from top-left to bottom-right. Behind the subject and product, place giant cropped typography reading "[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]" in ultra-bold geometric sans-serif letters. The word is a background layer only: huge, partially cropped by the frame edges, wide letter spacing, darker [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] than the rectangle, subtle embossed depth, soft shadow, and low enough contrast that it does not fight the product.

SUBJECT AND PRODUCT: [DESCRIBE MODEL OR SUBJECT — e.g., "a female model with a clean editorial look, neutral confident expression, natural slightly wind-touched hair, muted off-white outfit, and [ACCENT COLOR] jacket"]. Shoot from a slightly low hero angle. Body angled for depth, face turned toward the viewer with direct eye contact. One hand extends toward the camera holding the product from the uploaded reference image. The product is the dominant foreground object, slightly tilted to reveal [KEY PRODUCT DETAIL — e.g., "the triple camera system, brushed titanium edges, and centered brand logo"]. Keep the product sharp with realistic surface reflections, material texture, faint micro-details, and soft bloom around premium features. Keep the model's face readable behind it.

LIGHTING: Soft studio key light from front-left, warm rim light from the right, and subtle [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] bounce from the background block. Skin remains natural and non-airbrushed with realistic catchlights. Product edges have clean [MATERIAL FINISH — e.g., "metallic / matte / glossy"] highlights. Shadows are soft and controlled.

TYPOGRAPHY OVERLAY: All text must be flat, crisp, perfectly aligned graphic typography — not painted onto the scene. Render exactly these text elements once, with no extra text:

Top left, small black logo: [BRAND LOGO NAME/MARK]

Top right, thin sans-serif: "[BRAND SUB-TAGLINE — e.g., 'Built for Apple Intelligence.']"

Mid left, glassmorphism pill: "[PRODUCT NAME — e.g., 'iPhone 17 Pro']"

Large background type: "[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]"

Bottom right body copy, small clean sans-serif:
"[PRODUCT NAME]. [POWER STATEMENT — one sentence.]
[FEATURE 1]. [FEATURE 2].
[CLOSING LINE — e.g., 'Designed for what's next.']"

BOTTOM FEATURE STRIP: Place four equal-width glass-white rounded cards along the bottom, aligned to the grid, same height, same spacing, same baseline alignment. Each card has one minimal line icon above the heading. Render exactly:
Card 1: "[FEATURE HEADING 1]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 1]"
Card 2: "[FEATURE HEADING 2]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 2]"
Card 3: "[FEATURE HEADING 3]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 3]"
Card 4: "[FEATURE HEADING 4]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 4]"

GRAPHIC DETAILS: Two or three small sparkle icons only, subtle grain, soft glassmorphism, controlled [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR]-white-[ACCENT COLOR] palette, no neon, no oversaturation.

你是一位专业的室内设计 Mood Board 创作者。基于提供的 {argument name="space type" default="bedroom"} 设计照片，生成一张高端的 3:4 竖版 Mood Board。整体视觉效果应参考专业设计提案，展示 {argument name="style name" default="Modern Mid-century"} 的美学特征，营造 [Mood Keywords] 的氛围，并符合 [Branding Tone] 的设计表达。
空间类型：{argument name="space type" default="bedroom"}
布局要求：
上部：一张高分辨率、照片级的 {argument name="space type" default="bedroom"} 室内渲染图。它必须在结构、家具、材料、色彩和灯光上与用户的照片保持一致，但需针对专业提案进行优化。重点关注：[Key Furniture Elements]、[Material Keywords]、[Color Palette]、[Lighting Style]。
下部：展示严格对应上方设计的材料和家具样本，包括：材料样本、织物样本、色卡、饰面样本，以及相关的木材/石材/金属/玻璃/皮革样本。所有内容必须反映方案的核心材料和色彩逻辑。
右下角：一个设计说明 / 配色方案信息框，显示：主色、辅色、点缀色、核心材料、饰面描述和风格关键词。

专业公司级布局；极简、干净、克制且有序；清晰的视觉层级和留白控制；材料/颜色标签清晰且现代；整体氛围与 {argument name="style name" default="Modern Mid-century"} 相符；渲染质量：4K 超高清，超精细，照片级渲染。3:4 竖版构图。
标签要求：
每个样本必须有一个清晰的标签，按 [Label Language] 的材料/颜色/饰面名称组织，风格简洁、专业且对齐整齐。

items.title: 食物信息图写实
items.prompt:
以“{argument name="food name" default="大蒜"} 的一生”为主题的科普信息图。

画面必须呈现“单个完整的食物主体”（例如：一个土豆 / 一串香蕉 / 一个大蒜），通过横向切片展示同一食物在不同时间阶段的变化，而非多个不同个体的拼贴。

食物主体保持结构连续性和形状一致，在不同切片区域呈现出不同成熟度（如同将时间切开）。

图片采用 3:4 竖屏比例，主体居中并横向延展，均匀分为 4-6 个片段：

从左至右：未成熟 → 成熟 → 过熟 → 变质

每个片段反映真实变化：

颜色变化（如：绿 → 黄 → 黑等）
质地变化（如：饱满 → 变软 → 萎缩 → 腐烂）
特征变化（如：发芽、出水、发霉等）

每个阶段配有文字说明：

阶段名称
外观特征
内部变化（糖分/淀粉/水分变化）
食用建议（推荐/适合烹饪/不可食用）

设计风格：

极简浅色背景（米色）
高度写实的摄影风格
清晰的分隔线（时间切片感）
中文科普排版，小红书风格
适当使用 等图标

顶部标题：“{argument name="food name" default="大蒜"} 的一生”

核心要求：必须呈现为“同一食物随时间变化的切片”，而非独立个体的拼贴。

她的头发是深棕黑色，在室内温暖的灯光下反射出柔和的棕色。它采用低发髻或低聚发髻，略显宽松，耳朵、脸颊和下巴周围有自然的面部框架线。头发顶部出现微妙的温暖亮点，松散的发丝保持现实的日常柔软度和轻微的凌乱感。

她穿着一件黑色合身露肩长袖上衣，领口呈抹胸式。面料看起来像细针织或罗纹材料，紧贴身体，一肩明显裸露，袖子遮住手腕。下身是浅水洗蓝色高腰牛仔裤，有可见的金属纽扣、皮带环、前袋、拉链门襟、牛仔缝线、水洗纹理、轻微的面料折痕。一只手将一件乳白色或象牙色的外套放在腹部前；柔软的厚外套面料聚集在右侧前景，形成明亮的视觉区块。

可见皮肤包括脸部侧面、耳朵、颈部、锁骨、双肩、上胸部边缘、腋下附近的小区域、手和手指。上衣和牛仔裤遮住腰部、臀部和腿部；背部和臀部皮肤不可见。她的肤色温暖白皙，在室内黄暖光下显得柔软而有奶油般的光泽。皮肤应该看起来细腻、光滑且柔和地扩散，暗示温暖、干净、柔软的触感，同时保持肩膀和锁骨周围的自然骨骼阴影和皮肤过渡，而不是塑料过度光滑的表面。

灯光来自上方偏右的温暖头顶室内光，照亮发顶、侧脸、肩膀、锁骨、手和白色外套。黑色上衣吸收光线，在下巴下方、胸部织物周围和衣服褶皱处形成柔和的阴影；白色的外套反射出一点柔和的补光。背景是一个简单温暖的米白色房间、试衣间，或者酒店式的走廊，有天花板、墙角、门框线条和干净素色的墙壁。保持真实的智能手机质感：轻微噪点、柔和的清晰度、室内曝光不均匀、低角度广角镜头比例偏移、自然的衣服褶皱、轻微倾斜和不完美的取景。避免镜子自拍、可见手机、镜面反射、水印、标志、文字、硬工作室灯光、塑料皮肤、动漫风格和夸张的身体曲线。

items.prompt: 一张 16:9 比例的极简主义编辑风格演示 Slides，采用暖浅灰色纸张背景，留白充裕，布局遵循精致的瑞士风格网格，具备高端 PPT/Keynote 设计美感。该 Slides 为关于“锁定”的对比页面，使用优雅的中文排版并混合微小的英文导航文本。左上角放置两行小型大写英文面包屑导航：“COMPARISON · LOCK-IN”及下方的“CLOSED VS OPEN”，使用字间距较宽的细体无衬线字体。右上角放置页码指示器“04 / 08”。在上半部分居中偏左处，添加一行超大号加粗黑色中文字体标题：“真正的锁定，不是模型，是记忆。”在标题下方的左侧区域，创建三行对比列表，行间以细横线分隔。第一行左侧为加粗中文标签“轻度风险”，右侧为解释说明“状态存在服务端，换模型后无法恢复线程。”，最右侧对齐一个微小的大写英文关键词：“STATE”。第二行左侧为加粗标签“中度风险”，右侧为说明“闭源 harness 的记忆形态不可见，难以迁移。”，最右侧关键词为“SHAPE”。第三行左侧为加粗标签“最高风险”，右侧为说明“整个 harness 和长期记忆都在 API 后面。”，最右侧关键词为“LOCK-IN”。在 Slides 右侧放置一张小型嵌入式对比图表卡片，背景为白色，带有细微边框，包含两个并排的系统架构面板。左侧面板代表封闭系统，采用深灰色和柔和的红色点缀；右侧面板代表开放系统，采用深蓝色点缀。每个面板顶部应有 5 个小型图标标签，中央有一个高亮的 harness 模块，下方堆叠多个圆角矩形模块，底部一行有 4 个带有简短中文标签的小型能力图标。保持嵌入图细节丰富但尺寸较小，使其作为辅助视觉元素而非视觉重心。左下角添加微小的浅灰色中文页脚文本：“布局测试 · 顶部标题 + 下方两段式内容”。右下角放置小型页码“04”。底部边缘居中处添加一个轮播指示器，包含 7 个小圆点，其中第 4 个圆点为短深色圆角胶囊状，表示当前页面，其余 6 个为浅灰色圆点。在右下角边缘添加微弱的导航提示：“← → 翻页 ESC 关闭”。使用清晰的矢量文本渲染、低调的对比度、优雅的间距，以及适合 AI 平台对比与 API 记忆锁定商业演示的冷静高端信息图表风格。

items.title: 写实海报宇宙工作室
items.promptZh: 将主底盘或结构平台完美居中作为核心脊柱，并单独定位主体外壳（左侧或顶部），平行对齐作为参考形式，同时保留真实车辆的精确比例、姿态和几何形状。￼ 设计一个多层分解系统，其中组件在深度（Z 轴）和平面间距上分离，使用清晰的层次结构：微硬件（螺栓、螺钉、垫圈）紧密分组，功能组件间隔适度，主要系统广泛分离。￼ 将零件组织成真实的子系统取决于{argument name="vehicle type" default="vehicle"}类型，包括前总成（悬架、转向、制动器）、后总成（悬架、动力传动系统、差速器）、底盘/结构（车架、硬壳式车身、副车架）、动力总成（具有轻微内部暴露的发动机或电机、变速箱、进气、排气、冷却）、电子设备（电池、ECU、具有干净布线的线束）和车轮系统（4个车轮与轮胎对称放置， ￼ 通过保留机械关系、对齐轴和旋转轴、保持左/右系统的对称性以及在精确的微网格排列中在其装配点附近对微组件进行逻辑分组来确保工程现实性。避免随意放置。使用精致、高端的美感：柔和的{参数名称=“背景渐变”默认=“中性渐变”}背景（白色到浅灰色或暖米色）、带有柔和顶部照明的工作室级产品照明、微妙的定向阴影和受控反射。应用真实的材料，例如拉丝金属、碳纤维、橡胶和玻璃，并具有轻微磨损，避免玩具般的饰面。保持强烈的水平对称性和受控的深度不对称性以实现视觉复杂性，并确保平衡的负空间以避免过度拥挤。以超逼真的质量进行渲染，具有锐利的边缘、宏观细节、微妙的环境光遮挡和光线追踪阴影。以 2K 或 4K 分辨率、4:5 宽高比输出。￼ ￼ 无文本、无标签、无箭头、无品牌覆盖、无风格化、无透视变形。风格关键词：F1工程分解图、豪华汽车技术海报、工业设计分解、苹果式产品可视化、超精密机械布局、博物馆级演示。￼
items.prompt: Place the primary chassis or structural platform perfectly centered as the core spine, and position the main body shell separately (left or top), aligned parallel as a reference form while preserving accurate proportions, stance, and geometry of the real vehicle.￼ Design a multi-layered exploded system with components separated across depth (Z-axis) as well as planar spacing, using clear hierarchy: micro hardware (bolts, screws, washers) tightly grouped, functional assemblies moderately spaced, and major systems widely separated.￼ Organize parts into realistic subsystems depending on the {argument name="vehicle type" default="vehicle"} type, including front assembly (suspension, steering, brakes), rear assembly (suspension, drivetrain, differential), chassis/structure (frame, monocoque, subframes), powertrain (engine or motor with slight internal exposure, transmission, intake, exhaust, cooling), electronics (battery, ECU, wiring harness with clean routing), and wheel systems (4 wheels symmetrically placed with tire, rim, and hub separation).￼ Ensure engineering realism by preserving mechanical relationships, aligning shafts and rotational axes, maintaining symmetry across left/right systems, and grouping micro components logically near their assembly points in precise micro-grid arrangements. Avoid random placement. Use a refined, high-end aesthetic: soft {argument name="background gradient" default="neutral gradient"} background (white to light grey or warm beige), studio-grade product lighting with soft top illumination, subtle directional shadows, and controlled reflections. Apply realistic materials such as brushed metal, carbon fiber, rubber, and glass with slight wear—avoid toy-like finishes. Maintain strong horizontal symmetry with controlled depth asymmetry for visual complexity, and ensure balanced negative space to avoid overcrowding. Render in ultra-realistic quality with razor-sharp edges, macro-level detail, subtle ambient occlusion, and ray-traced shadows. Output in 2K or 4K resolution, 4:5 aspect ratio.￼ ￼ No text, no labels, no arrows, no branding overlays, no stylization, no perspective distortion. Style keywords: F1 engineering exploded diagram, luxury automotive technical poster, industrial design breakdown, Apple-style product visualization, ultra-precision mechanical layout, museum-grade presentation.￼

items.title: 爆款小鸡炖蘑菇广告
items.prompt: 创作一张以纯黑为背景的竖版美食广告，风格类似于高端食材拆解海报，用于展示丰盛的中式小鸡炖蘑菇。采用简洁的自上而下爆炸式构图，将食材悬浮在成品菜肴上方，每组食材清晰分离，并使用光泽感十足的商业美食摄影灯光进行照明。顶部展示一簇混合的榛蘑及其他鲜美蘑菇。下方展示 2 组香料：一堆红枸杞，以及一小捆青葱和 2 片厚姜片。再下方展示 2 组主料：几块带皮生鸡块，以及一捆干粉条。接着展示 2 组蔬菜：去皮土豆块和厚胡萝卜片。在它们下方，放置 1 个装满浓郁金黄色鸡汤的透明玻璃碗，表面可见 4 个香菇、细碎香草、少量浮油和淡淡蒸汽。底部放置 1 个带有侧把手的深褐色陶瓷砂锅，锅内盛放着炖好的成品：鸡块、香菇、透明粉条、土豆块、胡萝卜片、散落的枸杞、葱花点缀，以及油亮的金黄色汤汁。在各层之间添加飘落的液滴、碎屑和细小的装饰颗粒，以强调动感和丰富度。成品炖菜上方加入淡淡的蒸汽，并在砂锅右侧边缘添加 1 个明亮的星形高光。在食材组周围添加 7 个中英文双语标注，每个标注均配有指向相关食材的细弯箭头。这 7 个标签分别为：“榛蘑&香菇 / Hazel Mushrooms & Shiitake”、“鲜美菌菇 / Savory Mushrooms”、“枸杞&葱姜 / Goji Berries & Aromatics”、“鸡肉&粉条 / Chicken & Vermicelli”、“土豆&胡萝卜 / Potatoes & Carrots”、“浓郁鸡汤 / Rich Chicken Broth”以及“成品 / Finished Stew”。在蔬菜或中部区域附近添加 1 条额外的双语文字说明：“丰富食材 / Rich Ingredients”。使图像呈现超写实、诱人、高对比度、极其锐利的效果，并带有电影级高光、深邃阴影、高端包装广告美学，以及适合海报或社交媒体广告的平衡居中布局。

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:
使用 Hasselblad X2D 100C 和 XCD 90mm f/2.5 镜头拍摄的高品质专业人像。一位美丽的年轻东亚女性站在明亮简约的艺术画廊里，她留着自然的深棕色长发，波浪形的柔软松散。她有着精致优雅的面部结构，白皙的皮肤，微妙而光泽的肤色，富有表现力的黑眼睛，以及精致的粉红色嘴唇。她穿着一件干净、简约的白色 T 恤，上面有大胆的黑色无衬线字体，上面写着“YOUR MINE”。她用一只手轻轻地触碰下巴，做出一种放松、深思熟虑的姿势——柔软的下巴托。背景是一幅大型抽象画，采用柔和的米色和奶油色色调，温暖的自然光穿过天窗。逼真的风格，敏锐的眼睛焦点，高度细致的皮肤纹理，可见的毛孔，微妙的自然水分，没有美颜滤镜。轻微胶片颗粒，边缘有细微色差。一条流浪猫的尾巴卷曲在左下角雕塑的底部附近。
荷兰角，流浪猫尾巴 --ar 9:16
items.prompt:
A high-quality, professional portrait captured on a Hasselblad X2D 100C with an XCD 90mm f/2.5 lens. A beautiful young East Asian woman with long, natural dark brown hair styled in soft, loose waves stands in a bright, minimalist art gallery. She has a refined and elegant facial structure, clear skin with a subtle, glowing complexion, large expressive dark eyes, and a delicate pink-tinted lip. She wears a clean, minimalist white t-shirt featuring bold, black sans-serif typography that reads "YOUR MINE". She poses with one hand gently touching her chin in a relaxed, thoughtful gesture—a soft Chin Rest. The background features a large abstract painting in muted beige and cream tones, with warm natural light streaming through a skylight. Photorealistic style, sharp focus on the eyes, highly detailed skin texture, visible pores, subtle natural moisture, no beauty filter. Slight film grain, subtle chromatic aberration at the edges. A stray cat tail curls near the base of a sculpture at the bottom left corner.
dutch angle, stray cat tail --ar 9:16

items.title: 主題：
items.prompt:
主題：
朝の急ぎ足

人物・表情：
20代女性。明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌に、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだ自然な肌理。淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンのアイシャドウ、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、透け感のあるピンクベージュのリップ。瞳には小さなキャッチライト。トーストを口にくわえ、少し慌てながらも明るい表情で階段を駆け下りている。

服装・ポーズ：
白い半袖のセーラー風ブラウス、上品なネイビーの襟と袖ライン、大きめで形のきれいなネイビーリボン。高めのウエストで整ったネイビーのプリーツスカート、白いソックス、黒のローファー。人物の右足は下の段へ踏み出し、左足は後ろへ軽く跳ね上がる。人物の左手でバッグのストラップを握り、右手は髪の近くで小さく上がっている。スカートと髪が走る勢いで自然に揺れる。

背景・光：
駅前にある歩道橋の階段。金属の手すり、屋根のある通路、奥にぼけた駅案内や街の看板。朝の強い日差しが画面右上から入り、顔、ブラウス、脚、階段の端を明るく照らす。階段には手すりの影が斜めに落ち、明るい部分と影の部分のコントラストをはっきり出す。空気に少しだけ白い光のにじみを入れる。

構図・カメラ：
縦長2:3、全身が入る構図。人物を中央やや右に配置し、階段と手すりの線で奥行きを作る。カメラはやや低め、正面から少し見上げる角度。人物にピントを合わせ、背景は自然にぼかす。走っている一瞬を止めたようなスナップ写真。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな日系ストリートフォト。明るい夏の朝、柔らかなハイライト、自然な肌の質感、髪一本一本の流れが見える繊細な描写。髪は明るいミルクティーアッシュブラウン、薄めのシースルーバング、顔まわりに沿うレイヤーカット、肩下のミディアムロング。毛先は内側にゆるくカールし、走る動きでふわっと広がる。バッグは濃いブラウンの日本風スクールバッグで、テディベア、小さな白いぬいぐるみ、リボン、ふわふわのキーホルダー、ビーズチャームを複数吊るす。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔や視線、余分または欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、浮いた足、重力に合わない髪やスカート、バッグの飾りの崩れ、道具との接触不良、光源と矛盾する影、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし、不要な人物。

items.title: 20岁东方成年女性cosplay模特，扮演角色守岸人（鸣潮）…
items.prompt:
20岁东方成年女性cosplay模特，扮演角色守岸人（鸣潮），近距离复古暗光人像，保留角色原本的发型、发色、瞳色、脸部特征、气质与核心识别点，将角色转化为夜晚暖光胶片写真风格。角色处于极暗环境中，背景几乎全黑，画面只由一束强烈的暖黄色橙色侧光照亮。光线从画面左侧或左前方直射，照亮角色的额头、发丝、半张脸、鼻梁、嘴唇、肩颈和锁骨，另一半脸自然隐入深黑阴影，形成高反差、半明半暗的电影感。

角色表情安静、迷离、脆弱、略带倦怠，眼神可以直视镜头或轻轻看向光源方向，嘴唇自然放松，整体情绪像夜晚独处时被光捕捉到的瞬间。发丝自然凌乱，额前有碎发，部分发丝被暖光照成金色边缘，带有被风吹起或随意拨开的动态感。人物肩颈放松，构图为竖屏近景或半身近景，脸部占据画面中心，肩膀与锁骨进入画面，镜头距离近，带有私密自拍感和旧照片抓拍感。

角色服装可保留原设，也可以替换为简洁吊带、细肩带上衣、轻薄睡衣、复古连衣裙或符合角色设定的日常化服装。服装材质偏柔软、哑光、自然贴身，颜色可以使用深绿色、墨绿色、黑色、白色、米色或角色主题色。

画面色彩以黑色暗部、暖橙高光、焦糖肤色、金棕发丝、低饱和服装色为主。整体有复古胶片、CCD 暗光自拍、低清数码摄影、柔焦、轻微过曝和暗部颗粒质感。画面允许保留适度胶片颗粒和暗光噪点来强化复古氛围，但主体脸部、眼睛、发丝边缘、肩颈轮廓保持稳定可读。光影自然，亮部柔和扩散，暗部深沉，背景简洁干净，没有复杂场景干扰。

整体画面干净清晰，减少无必要的脏乱感，粒子特效克制，避免大面积漂浮颗粒、碎光和杂质感；如果手部出现在画面中，手部结构自然准确，手指数量正确，比例正常，关节清晰，姿态合理。整体细节稳定，保留暗夜暖光、复古胶片、私密脆弱、迷离安静的情绪氛围。

items.title: 极简女性
items.prompt:
Create a clean vertical 2:3 animation model-sheet character card for [角色全名], redesigned as a clearly adult or age-neutral safe character profile sheet depending on the source. The page should look like a polished official anime design reference page, not a sexy poster.

AUTO-ADAPT FROM CHARACTER: infer source work, iconic hairstyle, face shape, expression, costume colors, emblem, accessories, props, and personality keywords. Preserve recognizability while simplifying details into a clean production-ready design.

PAGE LAYOUT: large clean title at top, small source subtitle, front close-up portrait, full-body front standing pose, full-body back-facing standing pose, side-view or three-quarter pose, small action pose, expression thumbnails, color palette swatches, close-up boxes for hair, collar, sleeve, shoes, emblem, weapon or prop, and concise handwritten annotation arrows. White grid-paper background, clear margins, thin blue-gray construction lines, organized labels.

POSE SET: front close-up, confident front stand, back-facing stand, side three-quarter stand, small seated hugging raised shins pose or relaxed prop-holding pose. Avoid low-angle sexualized framing.

STYLE: clean anime model sheet, crisp line art, flat-to-soft cel shading, readable silhouette, controlled colors, production reference quality, official artbook layout.

Safety: tasteful, fully clothed, non-explicit, no nudity, no body-part focus, no erotic framing. If the source character is underage, keep the design completely non-sexual and age-neutral.

items.title: 请生成一张竖版 2:3 高清图片，主题为《建筑微缩蓝图》。
items.prompt:
请生成一张竖版 2:3 高清图片，主题为《建筑微缩蓝图》。

建筑名称：[填写具体建筑]

画面是一张现代建筑设计手稿，上面布满中文平面图、剖面图、立面图、结构细节图、尺寸标注和施工说明。一座高度仿真的中国古建筑微缩模型，从图纸中立体“建”出来。

主建筑要占画面 65%–75%，更大、更高、更有视觉冲击力。使用低角度 3/4 俯视视角，突出模型高度、体积感和真实阴影。建筑要符合所选主题的真实特征，并呈现正在施工中的状态，完成度约 70%–85%。

加入微缩施工细节：施工小人、脚手架、木架、坡道、滑轮、木梁、石块、瓦片、材料堆、小推车、马车、半完成台阶、屋顶施工区等。细节要围绕建筑本身展开，形成一个仿真的微缩建造世界。

整体风格是现代建筑事务所概念提案板 + 博物馆级微缩模型。图纸干净高级，颜色以米白、浅灰、淡蓝、灰黑线稿为主。所有文字必须是中文，主标题写“[建筑名称]”，副标题写“建筑营造过程示意图”。

使用柔和中性光线，画面清晰、现代、克制、有高级感。避免复古黄、羊皮纸、古董感、杂乱工作室、书本、蜡烛、卷轴、尺子、指南针、桌面摆件、现代机械、现代车辆和无关背景。

最终效果：让一座中国古建筑像从现代设计图纸里真实建造出来，兼具建筑学专业感、微缩模型趣味和强烈视觉冲击力。

items.title: 电影感角色
items.promptZh:
创建时尚的“[产品名称]”社交媒体帖子集，其中包含上传的产品图片或[产品名称]的逼真的高质量渲染。根据产品名称或上传的参考图像自动调整所有产品细节、成分、颜色、配料、纹理、道具和视觉氛围。设计适合咖啡馆、餐厅、甜点、饮料或食品广告的多种动态促销布局。
设定及背景：
使用与[产品名称]相匹配的视觉丰富的背景，其颜色灵感来自于产品本身。添加抽象形状、平滑渐变、流动波浪图案、产品后面的圆形亮点、浮动成分元素、装饰箭头、有趣的图形强调以及干净的现代海报风格的布置。保持作品充满活力、优质且适合社交媒体。
照明：
柔和的商业工作室照明具有充满活力的亮点、逼真的反射、令人垂涎的纹理增强、光泽的产品细节、新鲜的原料光泽以及明亮的促销气氛，使产品看起来美味可口且令人向往。

风格：
Instagram 美食活动美学、现代咖啡馆品牌、极简奢华的广告设计、优质的促销图形、大胆的圆形标题排版、优雅的手写字幕文本、干净的间距、时尚的 Z 世代营销风格、超现实的产品渲染、精美的社交媒体邮包。
相机：
焦点集中的特写英雄产品构图、略微倾斜的产品角度以展现动态能量、宏观细节强调、浅景深、电影食品广告取景、高分辨率 4K 商业质量。
文本元素：
包括有吸引力的促销文字，例如：
“新鲜又美味”
“限时优惠”
“立即订购”
“免费送货上门”
“只需 4.00 美元”
尺寸：
4x5
重要：
自动更改颜色、水果、配料、成分、背景细节和装饰元素以匹配[产品名称]或上传的产品图片。除非产品是以草莓为基础的，否则不要保留草莓元素。
