items.title: 龙3D信息图山城市
items.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="country name" default="中国"} 创建一份简洁、现代的国家概况信息图，标题为“中国国家概况”，中心放置大型 3D 浮雕地图，周围环绕统计数据卡片。

画布：16:9 横向信息图，浅灰色背景，清晰的企业编辑风格，柔和的阴影，红/蓝/绿强调色，高分辨率矢量与 3D 结合的外观。

主地图：在中心放置一张大型 3D 地形浮雕地图，占据画布大部分空间。使用地形配色：西部为橙褐色山脉，中部为黄色高原，东部和沿海为绿色低地。添加白色省界和黑色省份标签。将台湾、海南和南海诸岛作为独立的浮雕部分包含在内。在中心处放置醒目的黑色大写字母“CHINA”。用红色星号标记北京并标注。地图标签应准确包含 28 个省/自治区/直辖市标签：新疆、西藏、青海、甘肃、内蒙古、宁夏、四川、云南、贵州、广西、广东、海南、福建、浙江、江苏、安徽、山东、湖北、湖南、陕西、山西、北京、天津、辽宁、吉林、黑龙江、台湾和中国。

左上角标题栏：醒目的红色大标题“中国”，深色副标题“国家概况”，一条细红分割线，以及一段简短文字：“中国，全称中华人民共和国，是位于东亚的国家。它是世界上人口最多的国家，人口超过 14 亿。”

左侧统计卡片：一张圆角白色长卡片，包含 5 行堆叠的事实数据，每行配有红色圆形图标和文字。5 行内容为：人口 — {argument name="population value" default="14.1 亿"} — 世界排名：第 1；GDP（名义） — 17.79 万亿美元 — 世界排名：第 2；人均 GDP — 12,614 美元 — 世界排名：第 63；首都 — {argument name="capital city" default="北京"}；官方语言 — {argument name="official language" default="中文（普通话）"}。行与行之间使用细分割线。

右上角概况卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为红色的“概况”。包含 4 行红色图标内容：政府 — 单一制社会主义共和国；成立日期 — 1949 年 10 月 1 日；土地面积 — 960 万平方公里，世界排名：第 3；人口密度 — 约 147 人/平方公里。

中右侧经济图表卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为“经济概览”，副标题为“(名义 GDP)”，并附有小标签“万亿美元”。包含 4 根垂直柱状图，分别代表 2020、2021、2022、2023 年，数值分别为 14.72、16.86、17.96、17.79。2020–2022 年使用蓝色柱状，2023 年使用红色柱状。

左下角产业卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为“产业构成 (按 GDP)”。包含 3 部分组成的环形图：蓝色代表工业 39.7%，红色代表服务业 53.2%，绿色代表农业 7.1%。添加带有相同 3 个标签和百分比的图例。

底部中心出口卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为“主要出口产品 (2023 年)”。包含 5 列出口数据，配有蓝色线条图标和红色数值：电子产品 — 1.02 万亿美元；机械设备 — 0.78 万亿美元；纺织服装 — 0.31 万亿美元；汽车产品 — 0.26 万亿美元；化学产品 — 0.23 万亿美元。

右下角贸易伙伴卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为“主要贸易伙伴 (按贸易总额)”。包含 5 条蓝色水平柱状图，配有小型旗帜图标和数值：美国 — 6640 亿美元；欧盟 — 6430 亿美元；东盟 — 5960 亿美元；中国香港 — 2650 亿美元；日本 — 2270 亿美元。

页脚：居中放置一行小字来源说明：“数据来源：世界银行、世界贸易组织、中国国家统计局。”

约束条件：所有卡片需围绕地图排列且互不重叠，使用统一的字体，红色标题，蓝色图表元素，柔和的投影，圆角卡片，且不得添加水印。

items.title: 电影感女性
items.prompt:
Create a vertical portrait in an approximately 3:4 aspect ratio with the visual character of a late-2000s or early-2010s direct-flash digital photograph. An adult woman around 22 to 30 years old stands in a dim, ornate classical interior, positioned near the center but slightly toward image-left. Frame her from the top of the head to the lower calf or mid-lower skirt, leaving the feet outside the image. She has a tall, slender, narrow-framed silhouette with an elongated neck and shoulders. Her weight rests mainly on one leg, her hip shifts toward image-right, and her shoulders tilt in the opposite direction, forming a natural elongated S-curve.

Her arm on image-left is lifted and bent, with the hand lightly touching the back of her head or her hair. Her arm on image-right follows the hip line downward, with gently curved fingers. The pose should feel elegant but not standardized or perfectly rehearsed. Preserve the accidental tension of a movement that has just paused, as though she will lower the raised hand in the next moment. This is not a mirror selfie; no phone is visible, and the left-right composition must not be flipped.

Preserve a small oval face, soft jawline, slender nose bridge, and naturally full lips. Her eyes are slightly widened and calmly focused near the lens, while the lips remain naturally closed or barely parted. She is not smiling deliberately. Her expression is quiet, alert, and subtly tired, carrying the emotional distance of a formal evening that is almost over.

Use refined makeup informed by East Asian formal-dinner and red-carpet aesthetics: warm-neutral fair skin, a thin semi-matte complexion base with real skin texture still visible, naturally dark brows, muted taupe and dusty mauve-pink eyeshadow, fine eyeliner, light mascara, softly placed low-saturation pink blush, and glossy nude-pink or rose-beige lips. Her long black or black-brown hair is brushed back from the face, leaving the ears visible, with a few natural flyaway strands near the temples. Add long silver-toned rhinestone or crystal tassel earrings that catch the flash beside the neck.

Dress her in a coordinated champagne-blush evening gown. The upper section is a high-neck sleeveless or halter-style semi-sheer mesh bodice in muted champagne pink, nude apricot, pale rose, and warm beige. Fine sequins cover the mesh and produce scattered silver-white sparkles and occasional clipped highlights under direct flash. The chest remains visibly covered by the semi-sheer textile; do not render it as bare or completely transparent. Include a small asymmetrical side opening at the waist on image-right, revealing only a limited strip of skin from the side waist toward the upper hip.

The lower garment is a high-waisted floor-length satin mermaid or fitted column skirt in soft blush pink, dusty rose, or pearlescent rose-beige. Add diagonal draping and naturally gathered folds around the waist and hips. The fabric follows the hips and thighs before narrowing downward beyond the frame. The satin should look soft, cool, slippery, and slightly weighty, with irregular vertical highlights produced by the flash.

Clearly show the face, neck, collarbones, both shoulders, both arms, the area near the underarm beneath the raised arm, the fingers, and the small exposed section of side waist and upper hip on image-right. The skin is warm-neutral and fair, becoming slightly porcelain under the cool-white flash while retaining soft peach blood tone in the shadows. It should appear fine, soft, gently warm, and faintly dewy to the touch. Preserve pores, subtle tonal differences, light joint texture, and realistic oily highlights on the forehead, nose bridge, cheekbones, collarbones, and upper arms. Avoid waxy smoothing or plastic skin.

Use a hard frontal on-camera flash positioned very close to the lens axis as the dominant light. It directly illuminates the face, shoulders, arms, sequined bodice, and center of the satin skirt, then falls off rapidly along the sides of the body. Create hard shadows behind the subject, deep near-black areas in the dark wood, and abrupt white highlights across the sequins. The background is illuminated only by weak amber tungsten or warm ambient light, creating a clear cool-versus-warm separation between the flash-lit skin and the peach-orange room. Reflections from several warm lamps appear in the glass covering the artwork, while lacquered furniture catches scattered highlights. Do not introduce softboxes, rim lighting, balanced fill light, or cinematic three-point illumination.

Place her in an ornate interior resembling an old hotel, private dining room, members' club, or classically decorated residence. Use a warm peach-orange textured wall with a gilded carved border near the ceiling. Include a large area of nearly black wooden paneling or a dark column on image-left. Behind the subject on image-right, hang a glass-fronted East Asian landscape or garden-style artwork with several warm reflected light points. Add a dark glossy lacquered table or cabinet behind her waist, a dark wooden chair with patterned upholstery in the lower-right background, and dark wainscoting or a fireplace-like structure across the lower wall.

The photographic treatment should resemble a compact consumer digital camera or early smartphone with built-in flash, plausibly using a 35–45mm full-frame equivalent focal length, around f/2.8–f/4, and roughly 1/60–1/100 second. Position the camera around chest-to-waist height, nearly level but with a slight upward perspective. Keep the framing subtly offset and allow the architectural verticals to remain imperfectly corrected. Preserve mild high-ISO grain, JPEG compression, slightly soft detail, crushed dark areas, clipped sequin highlights, and uneven exposure. The background remains recognizable but softer than the subject; avoid extreme shallow depth of field.

The room had already gone dim when the flash fired. She is lifting one hand to adjust her hair just before leaving the dinner, caught for a fraction of a second; in the next moment, the pose will loosen. The finished image should feel like a private old digital photograph rediscovered years later—glamorous, quiet, slightly intoxicated, and emotionally unresolved, with human imperfections valued above commercial perfection.

Negative mirror selfie, phone in hand, horizontal flip, studio softbox, cinematic rim light, daylight, modern white room, plastic skin, heavy skin smoothing, exaggerated curves, oversized breasts, tiny waist, overlong legs, fully transparent clothing, nudity, stiff symmetric pose, extreme bokeh, extra fingers, deformed hands, warped raised arm, duplicated earrings, over-sharpening, CGI, anime, text, watermark.

items.title: 电影感女性
items.prompt:
Create a photorealistic 2:3 vertical, full-body fashion portrait with a high-key white aesthetic and a subtle playful-comedy undertone. A clearly adult young woman, approximately 23 to 30 years old, stands inside a nearly pure-white seamless studio, white light-box environment, or in front of a floor-to-ceiling window completely washed out by strong backlight. Place her slightly low in the frame with extensive white negative space above her head, and include her entire body, shoes, handbag, and faint contact shadows on the floor.

She has a naturally soft facial structure, full straight bangs, and slim black rectangular glasses. Her very dark brown, nearly black hair is pulled back into a low ponytail, low bun, or loosely gathered style, with several small flyaways around the ears. Preserve her natural facial proportions, soft jawline, subtle asymmetry, and realistic eye size. Do not transform her into a celebrity or generic influencer. Use restrained urban office makeup: lightweight semi-matte foundation, softly straight brows, muted beige-brown eyeshadow, fine black eyeliner, natural lashes, an extremely subtle peach blush, and soft nude-pink lips. Retain mild under-eye shading, color variation beside the nose, and small areas of highlight bloom.

Her upper body leans clearly forward and bends toward image-left. Her head lowers, while her hips shift slightly toward image-right. The arm on image-left rises toward her forehead, with the wrist near the brow and the palm turned outward, as though she is tired after work or momentarily shielding herself from the strong light. The arm on image-right hangs downward, holding both a small black object and the two long straps of a cat-face handbag. The leg on image-left bends slightly near the bag, while the leg on image-right stretches widely toward the lower-right corner with a straighter knee. Let the shoulders, waist, and legs form a continuous S-curve and strong diagonal lines. The pose should feel intentionally styled but preserve casual imperfections such as a bent wrist, nonparallel bag straps, and different foot angles.

Her eyes are slightly narrowed behind the glasses, with the gaze directed downward or just below the lens. Her lips remain naturally parted, with a faint glimpse of the teeth, as though she had just sighed or murmured a tired complaint. The expression should feel exhausted, mildly dizzy, self-aware, and endearing rather than dramatically distressed.

Dress her in a fitted soft-white short-sleeve collared blouse with a broad collar, visible button placket, one chest patch pocket, and a tucked hem. Keep the chest fully covered with natural fabric tension and only restrained contour. The forward bend and side compression should create realistic diagonal pull lines, small folds, and light gathering around the waist. Pair the blouse with a high-waisted fitted black mini skirt ending on the upper thighs. The skirt should follow the waist and hips while retaining fabric thickness, slight tension, and minor creasing rather than looking like latex or seamless shapewear.

Place a black ID lanyard around her neck, ending in a rectangular black card holder that hangs over the white blouse. Add a small silver chain-style wristwatch on the wrist at image-right. In the lowered hand, include a large beige cat-face handbag with a horizontally rounded silhouette, dark-brown piping, small cat ears, circular eyes, a triangular nose, whiskers, and blush-like dot details. Two long thin handles descend from her hand, and the bag hangs in the lower-left part of the frame with its base nearly touching the floor.

Her legs are bare from the mini-skirt hem to the tops of the feet, and she wears nude-pink or beige pointed low-cut pumps. Visible skin includes the face, ears, neck, a small collar area, both arms, hands, and both complete legs. The chest, abdomen, waist, hips, and buttocks remain covered. Use a light neutral-to-warm ivory skin tone lifted by the high-key white illumination, while preserving a faint rosy undertone on the arms and legs. The skin should look as though it would feel soft, clean, finely textured, and slightly cool to the touch. Keep the arms and legs smooth but preserve realistic knees, ankles, finger joints, subtle pores, and minor tonal differences. Avoid plastic or waxy skin.

Illuminate the background with a very large white source pushed close to highlight clipping. Strong backlight should wrap around the hair, shoulders, arms, and outer edges of the legs, producing soft white bloom. Allow some thin hairs and portions of the white blouse edges to dissolve slightly into the background. Use weaker frontal fill from a reflector, large softbox, or computational-photography lift so that the face, clothing, and legs remain readable. Preserve only pale warm-gray shadows beneath the chin, along the inner arms, under the skirt hem, and between the separated legs. The floor should show little more than faint gray contact shadows and soft reflections. Do not use hard shadows, colorful neon, dark cinematic light, or an obvious professional rim-light setup.

Photograph the scene with the visual character of a smartphone main camera, lightweight mirrorless camera, or moderate portrait lens. Position the camera between waist and chest height, mostly level or with a very slight upward angle. Keep medium-to-deep focus so the glasses, blouse, ID lanyard, handbag design, wristwatch, and shoes remain recognizable. Add gentle digital diffusion, mild social-media compression, low contrast, highlight bloom, and slight loss of detail in the white blouse. Do not make the subject edges resemble a hard digital cutout. Preserve moderate background clipping and overexposure, since the white haze is part of the image identity.

She had just emerged from a long commute or an exhausting workday, and the cat-shaped bag was still hanging from her hand. A moment ago she had been rushing; now she pauses in the bright space and raises a hand to her forehead, wanting only one brief breath before continuing. The final feeling is tired, cute, lightly theatrical, and self-deprecating: a social-media fashion portrait combining office-uniform styling, glasses, a black mini skirt, a playful cat handbag, and an exaggerated but believable exhausted gesture.

Avoid: underage or school-aged appearance, mirror selfie, celebrity replacement, missing glasses, missing lanyard, missing cat handbag, trousers, long skirts, exaggerated breasts, extreme waist-to-hip proportions, unnaturally long legs, increased nudity, plastic skin, waxy skin, excessive smoothing, deformed fingers, broken wrists, twisted ankles, malformed heels, disconnected straps, hard cutout edges, detailed office interiors, colorful neon, hard shadows, dark cinematic grading, CGI, text, watermarks, and logos.

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh: 9:16 垂直 — 3x3 网格拼贴（九张图像）形成韩国偶像肖像摄影系列。每帧都是同一位年轻的韩国女偶像，九个镜头的面部特征、比例、发型和身份都保持 100% 的一致性。自然、超真实的皮肤纹理，无需修饰、无需平滑。干净的偶像式简约妆容，柔和的光泽，微妙的瑕疵。头发：长而浓密的深色头发，略微凌乱，所有框架一致（自然松散，轻微移动）。穿搭：有凝聚力的韩国偶像写真造型——白衬衫+短裤（或者简单的中性色调穿搭），青春干净，略显休闲但有型。所有镜框均配备相同的服装。环境：最小的工作室或简单的室内环境（朴素的墙壁、柔和的窗光、干净的背景）。专注于主题，而不是环境。灯光：柔和的漫射自然光、柔和的高光、低对比度、略显空灵的色调、微妙的胶片般的柔和度。相机风格：亲密的人像摄影，略微手持的感觉，微妙的缺陷（轻微颗粒，运动帧中的轻微模糊，不完美的取景）。画面分解（3x3网格）：顶行： - 左上：自然站立，稍稍远视，表情放松 - 上中：面对镜头，随意的中动（头发或身体轻微移动） - 右上：轻微侧角，柔和的目光，自然坦率的感觉中行： - 中左：稍微向上看，柔和深思的表情 - 中：特写肖像，直接目光接触，温柔的偶像微笑 - 中右：稍微转动身体，中动拍摄镜头下行： - 左下：坐着或倾斜随意、放松的姿势 - 下中：背部部分转动，越过肩膀看向相机 - 右下：靠近画面站立，略带俏皮或柔和的表情 心情：韩国偶像写真集/照片卡审美，亲密，柔和，自然，日常魅力。品质：超真实、8K 细节、微妙的模拟胶片颗粒、自然瑕疵、柔和梦幻的色调
items.prompt: 9:16 vertical — a 3x3 grid collage (nine images) forming a Korean idol portrait photoshoot series. Each frame features the same young Korean female idol, maintaining 100% consistency in facial features, proportions, hairstyle, and identity across all nine shots. Natural, ultra-realistic skin texture, no retouching, no smoothing. Clean idol-style minimal makeup, soft glow, subtle imperfections. Hair: long, voluminous dark hair, slightly tousled, consistent across all frames (natural loose flow, slight movement). Outfit: cohesive Korean idol photoshoot styling — white shirt + short bottoms (or simple neutral-toned outfit), youthful, clean, slightly casual but styled. Same outfit across all frames. Setting: minimal studio or simple indoor environment (plain wall, soft window light, clean background). Focus on subject, not environment. Lighting: soft diffused natural light, gentle highlights, low contrast, slightly airy tones, subtle film-like softness. Camera style: intimate portrait photography, slightly handheld feel, subtle imperfections (minor grain, slight blur in motion frames, imperfect framing). Frame breakdown (3x3 grid): Top row: - Top left: standing naturally, looking slightly away, relaxed expression - Top center: facing camera, casual mid-motion (hair or body slight movement) - Top right: slight side angle, soft gaze, natural candid feel Middle row: - Center left: looking slightly upward, soft thoughtful expression - Center: close-up portrait, direct eye contact, gentle idol smile - Center right: turning body slightly, mid-motion candid frame Bottom row: - Bottom left: seated or leaning casually, relaxed posture - Bottom center: back partially turned, looking over shoulder toward camera - Bottom right: standing close to frame, slightly playful or soft expression Mood: Korean idol photobook / photocard aesthetic, intimate, soft, natural, everyday charm. Quality: ultra-realistic, 8K detail, subtle analog film grain, natural imperfections, soft dreamy tone

items.title: 电影感女性
items.prompt:
Create a vertical 3:4 front-facing smartphone selfie of an adult-coded young woman, visually around 18 to 24 years old, wearing a black-and-white gothic nurse cosplay. She leans close to the lens while the unseen phone is held approximately 30 to 40 degrees above eye level and pointed downward. Use a very close 24 to 28 mm full-frame-equivalent smartphone perspective that makes the face and eyes visually prominent without producing extreme distortion.

Her head is lightly tilted and her face is raised toward the camera. She looks directly upward into the lens with a quiet, soft, slightly timid and faintly distant expression. Her lips remain naturally closed with relaxed, level corners and no obvious smile, preserving the feeling of a brief emotional pause. Preserve the original softly rounded, relatively short facial shape, natural jawline, eye spacing, narrow nose bridge, small nose tip and soft lip shape. Do not sharpen the chin or significantly reshape the facial proportions.

Her hair is dense, deep black and mostly straight, with thick blunt bangs covering the eyebrows. Long side sections fall naturally on both sides in a low twin-section or twin-tail arrangement, with the ends curving slightly inward. The hair should appear smooth, dense and semi-matte while retaining fine flyaways, minor irregularity and believable strand texture. Place a white nurse cap at the center of the crown with a prominent black cross symbol. Oversized fluffy white animal ears extend from both sides and are irregularly cropped by the top edge of the frame. Add black satin ribbon bows on both sides of the hair.

Use refined makeup inspired by Japanese jirai-kei, ryousangata and anime cosplay aesthetics without referencing a particular celebrity or assigning ethnicity. Apply a very fair neutral-cool complexion, rose-pink and pale mauve eye-shadow gradients, thin black eyeliner with subtly lowered outer corners, and gray-brown circle lenses. Add tiny silver-white glitter points at the inner corners, beneath the eyes and along the aegyo-sal area. Keep the lashes fine and separated. Apply soft pink blush beneath the eyes, across the cheeks and on the tip of the nose. Use a translucent, moist-looking pink gradient lip gloss with delicate reflective highlights.

The only visible skin should be the full face, tiny areas near the ears and a very narrow strip of upper neck above the high collar. The shoulders, arms, chest, waist, hips and legs must remain covered or outside the frame. The facial skin should appear finely textured, soft, slightly cool, smooth and gently hydrated, with mild smartphone beauty diffusion but subtle natural variation remaining beside the nose, beneath the eyes and around the lips. Avoid plastic or completely textureless skin.

Dress her in a white high-neck, long-sleeved cosplay top combining nurse-uniform and gothic-maid elements. Add black piping, a fine white ruffled collar, black sheer ruffles, narrow black lace details and several black cross appliqués. Around the neck, include a thin black band, black sheer ruffle trim and a hanging black cross-shaped ornament. The fabric should look soft, lightweight and matte, with small natural folds created by the close selfie posture. Do not make the garment tight or emphasize the chest. The lower garment, waist, hips and legs must not appear.

Keep the framing casual and imperfect. Her face fills most of the image but is not aligned with perfect symmetry. A white-sleeved arm enters from the lower-left foreground and reaches toward the unseen phone. The oversized ears are partially cropped along the top edge, and small edge obstructions remain. Do not turn the composition into a centered passport portrait.

Place her in a warm, slightly crowded corner of a private room or small studio. Behind her on the left, include a wooden shelf with stacked off-white ceramic bowls and vessels. Near the upper-left edge, show part of a green-toned artwork or print. Add a thin metal frame or furniture structure in the rear. Along the right edge, let an orange cartoon star and animal-shaped cutout intrude into the composition, with a soft white cushion or bedding behind the right shoulder. Keep the background lived-in and mildly cluttered rather than converting it into a plain studio, minimalist room or luxury bedroom.

Illuminate the scene with warm indoor ambient light combined with soft near-axis frontal fill positioned slightly above the face. Let the light illuminate the forehead, nose bridge, upper cheeks and chin while the bangs cast a faint soft shadow across the forehead. Retain gentle natural shadows around the nostrils and beneath the jaw. Let the under-eye glitter create tiny point reflections and the lip gloss produce a moist highlight. Do not add a strong rim light, dramatic backlight or polished cinematic studio setup.

Render the image with believable smartphone computational processing, mild beauty-filter softness, a subtle warm cast, restrained sharpening, slight sensor noise and light JPEG compression. Keep the face and front hair sections clear while allowing the shelving, ceramics and cartoon decoration to soften slightly but remain recognizable. items.prompt: 创作一张动态的竖版体育海报，以庆祝 {argument name="event name" default="J.League Day"}，采用高能量的日本平面设计风格。使用干净的灰白色画布，并结合爆炸性的抽象构图，包含锐利的对角线速度线、油漆飞溅、半调网点、精细的工程制图线条以及棱角分明的几何碎片，配色采用日本风格：深钴蓝色、鲜红色、黑色、白色以及少量的黄色点缀。画面中心为一名身穿深色 {argument name="team jersey" default="日本国家队风格黑色球衣，印有 10 号"} 的男性足球运动员，以对比强烈的黑白水墨插画风格呈现，展现凌乱的深色头发、健壮的体格以及向观众方向倾斜的强力踢球姿势。他的面部应模糊或不清晰，以保持动作的匿名感。在左下角前景处放置一个黑白足球，略微放大并带有运动模糊和速度轨迹，仿佛刚刚被踢出。在球员身后，创建一个巨大的粗体黑色大写字母 {argument name="main letter" default="J"}，带有厚实的白色轮廓和红色阴影，并与一个巨大的红色太阳圆盘重叠。在上方背景中添加一个蓝色的矩形区域，内含抽象的城市风格垂直线条细节。包含四个主要的颜色点缀组：红色圆形太阳和红色油漆爆发、蓝色对角条纹和碎片、黑色墨水飞溅和半调图案，以及黄色细线和小型多边形点缀。在右下角添加小型的印刷日期文字 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 5 月 15 日"}，下方附带一个随性的手写签名 {argument name="signature" default="Oyagi"}。整体视觉效果应呈现出快速、醒目、现代且适合社交媒体 AI 艺术的海报风格；无需额外标志，无需可辨认的赞助商名称，无需其他球员，无需人群，无需体育场背景。

items.prompt: 创作一张竖版黑板风格插画，描绘一只淘气的可爱小猫正在享受一场凌乱的鱼宴。采用类似 niji 的动漫绘本风格，在深色黑板背景上呈现粗糙的粉笔、蜡笔、彩色粉笔和刮痕漆面质感。主体为 {argument name="character name" default="一只三花小猫"}，拥有大大的三角形耳朵、半眯着的慵懒金色眼睛、小巧的粉色鼻子、伸出的舌头，以及一只向观众抬起、露出粉色肉垫的前爪。小猫佩戴着 {argument name="neck accessory" default="一条带有金色小铃铛的彩色三角方巾"}。前景桌面上杂乱地摆放着 5 样食物：右侧有一条巨大的蓝灰色全鱼，左侧有一个装满鱼肉碎的深色碗，底部中央有一副白色鱼骨架，左下角有一个三角形鱼头骨，右下角有一管红蓝相间的挤压式鱼酱，酱料从喷嘴中溢出。黑板背景包含 12 个粉笔涂鸦：左上角有一个爪印，一个红色卷曲箭头，右上角有一个大火箭，右上角附近有一个小鱼骨，右侧有一个站立的小猫剪影，左上角有一颗黄色星星，顶部中央附近有一颗爆炸星，火箭附近有一颗粉色星星，以及 2 个微型花朵涂鸦和 2 个小月牙。画面采用密集的手绘构图，带有充满活力的刮痕、可见的粉笔灰、涂抹的颜料、不均匀的轮廓、半色调斑点，以及层叠的米色、鲑鱼粉、海军蓝、紫色、橙色和白色笔触。保持小猫居中且占据主导地位，场景俏皮且略显混乱，画面中不包含可读文字、水印，且避免干净的数字矢量感。

items.title: 电影感女性
items.prompt:
[BRAND NAME]

Act as a Streetwear Creative Director and Graphic Designer creating a triptych of three distinct campaign images unified by subculture aesthetics — analog grain, collage layering, hand-drawn elements, and raw urban energy. The three panels are presented side by side as a single wide-format image. Each panel has a completely different visual treatment but they belong to the same campaign universe. The entire system is driven by [BRAND NAME]'s real brand identity, real products, real cultural positioning. References: hip-hop album artwork, streetwear zine culture, skate photography, graffiti editorial, risograph print aesthetics.

---

PHASE 0: BRAND INTELLIGENCE — AUTONOMOUS EXTRACTION

Perform a complete brand decode of [BRAND NAME] from training data before generating anything.

COLOR SYSTEM: identify [BRAND NAME]'s primary brand color — this becomes the dominant background color across all three panels. Each panel uses a variation of this color: Panel 1 uses the most saturated vivid version. Panel 2 uses a slightly darker or more complex version. Panel 3 uses a slightly desaturated or shifted version. Secondary accent color: identify [BRAND NAME]'s accent color — used for hand-drawn elements, graffiti tags, and accent marks across all three panels.

BRAND WORLD: identify [BRAND NAME]'s cultural positioning — music, skate, street, outdoor, sport, or other. All photographic content, environments, and cultural references across all three panels must authentically belong to this world.

HERO PRODUCT: identify [BRAND NAME]'s most iconic current product — footwear, apparel, or accessory. This product appears prominently in Panel 3 as the subject of close-up photography.

BRAND TYPOGRAPHY: identify [BRAND NAME]'s official wordmark style and the typeface character used in their campaigns. Apply to Panel 2's logo lockup.

CULTURAL LANGUAGE: identify real slogans, real product names, real cultural phrases associated with [BRAND NAME]'s community. These appear as handwritten text, editorial copy, and background writing across all three panels.

---

PHASE 1: TRIPTYCH STRUCTURE

Single wide-format image — aspect ratio approximately 3:1 landscape or three 1:1 squares side by side. The three panels are placed edge to edge with zero gap — they bleed directly into each other. Each panel is equal width. Together they form one unified campaign image read left to right. The three panels share: the brand color family, the analog grain treatment, the hand-drawn mark-making aesthetic, and the subculture visual language. They differ in: photographic treatment, typographic approach, and compositional structure.

---

PHASE 2: PANEL 1 — RISOGRAPH PORTRAIT (LEFT)

Visual language: album cover / risograph print / screenprint aesthetic. Two-color duotone treatment — [BRAND NAME]'s primary brand color as the background, black and off-white/cream for the photographic subject. The photograph is processed to look like a two-color risograph or screenprint: high contrast, visible halftone grain, ink texture, slightly misregistered color layers creating a subtle offset effect.

Photographic subject: a close-up portrait of a person relevant to [BRAND NAME]'s cultural world — a musician, skater, or street figure. The portrait is tightly cropped, the face filling 60 to 70% of the panel. The subject wears [BRAND NAME] products visibly.

Collage micro-elements layered over the portrait: two small human figures — tiny scale, approximately 3 to 5% of panel height — placed on a horizontal surface within the portrait (a hat brim, a shoulder) as if they are tiny people standing on the subject. A small cut-out photograph embedded within the portrait (on the chest or collar area) showing a lifestyle scene relevant to [BRAND NAME]'s world — this cutout has slightly torn or rough edges.

Hand-drawn elements scattered across the panel: a loose cursive script text — a real [BRAND NAME] phrase or cultural word — written in white brush pen style over the upper-center of the portrait. Small doodle marks: tiny stars, hearts, directional lines, quick sketches — scattered asymmetrically across the panel, drawn in thin black or white ink. These marks are casual and quick — like someone drew on the artwork with a ballpoint pen.

Bottom right corner: a small rectangular label element — brand name in small mono type, and a barcode graphic beneath it.

---

PHASE 3: PANEL 2 — STREETWEAR EDITORIAL (CENTER)

Visual language: streetwear magazine spread / brand editorial. A real photograph — not duotone — of a person wearing [BRAND NAME] products in an urban environment. Shot with a fisheye or ultra-wide lens from a low angle looking up — the subject is in the lower-center of the frame, the environment (buildings, sky, street) fills the upper portion in dramatic wide-angle perspective. The photograph retains its natural color but has a slight film grain overlay and a color grade consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s brand world.

Brand logo lockup: [BRAND NAME]'s official wordmark and logo symbol rendered large in white — positioned in the upper portion of the panel, over the sky/architectural zone of the photograph. The logo occupies approximately 40 to 50% of the panel width. The wordmark is in [BRAND NAME]'s correct official typography.

Graffiti tag overlay: a large aggressive wildstyle graffiti tag written in [BRAND NAME]'s accent color — bright, energetic, spanning approximately 60 to 70% of the panel width. Positioned in the middle zone of the panel, partially overlapping the figure and the logo. The tag style is authentic to street graffiti — fluid, confident, marker-thick strokes with sharp wild extensions. The tag spells a real [BRAND NAME] word, product name, or brand-relevant phrase.

Lower left editorial text block: a small structured text block with a bold headline in white — a real [BRAND NAME] campaign or cultural phrase as the title, followed by 2 to 3 lines of smaller body text describing the brand's cultural positioning or product. Set in a mix of bold and regular weight — some words in bold, some in regular, creating typographic rhythm. This text block mimics a magazine article header.

Lower right corner: care label / garment icons — a row of 4 to 5 small washing/care instruction icons in white, as found on clothing labels. Next to them: [BRAND NAME]'s logo in small form with a tagline. This references the brand's product language.

Corner micro-elements: top left — current year with ® symbol. Top center — a small descriptor ("Brand Meets Subculture" equivalent for [BRAND NAME]'s world). Top right — a social media handle or brand identifier in small type.

Bottom disclaimer strip: a small M-rating style box with small text — "This content is a creative concept" — positioned lower left. Lower right: "Never stop [brand-relevant verb]" + small [BRAND NAME] logo.

---

PHASE 4: PANEL 3 — ZINE COLLAGE (RIGHT)

Visual language: skate zine / analog collage / film photography. A flat-color or slightly textured background in [BRAND NAME]'s primary color — the background has visible film grain or paper texture, slightly desaturated, analog feel.

Multiple photographic layers: 3 to 4 photographs of different sizes placed across the panel at varying angles — some tilted 5 to 15° clockwise or counter-clockwise, some slightly overlapping. Each photograph looks like a real printed photo — slightly glossy, with a very thin white border like a developed photograph. Some photos have a transparent tape element or a colored paper backing visible at the corners — physical analog mounting effect. Photo subjects: close-up shots of [BRAND NAME]'s hero product — different angles, different colorways, shot in real environments (skate spot, street, nature). One photo includes a partial figure — a person sitting or standing in a real environment wearing [BRAND NAME] products.

Handwritten text scattered across the panel: multiple instances of handwritten text in different scales and styles — some large and gestural (song lyrics, personal thoughts, brand phrases relevant to [BRAND NAME]'s world), some small and intimate (diary-like notes, dates, place names). The text is written in thin ballpoint or marker style — white, black, or the brand accent color. The text content is authentic to [BRAND NAME]'s cultural community.

Quick sketch doodles: small hand-drawn illustrations scattered between the photos — gesture drawings of figures, objects relevant to the brand, abstract marks. These are quick and rough — 10 to 20 seconds per sketch quality.

Numerical identifier: a large painted or stenciled number on one of the environmental elements in the main photograph — a real-feeling street number, code, or reference number. Rendered as if spray-painted or stenciled.

---

PHASE 5: UNIFIED ANALOG TREATMENT

All three panels share these visual properties that unify them as one campaign: film grain — a consistent fine grain overlay across all three panels at 20 to 30% opacity. Color family — all three panels are dominated by variations of [BRAND NAME]'s primary brand color. Hand-drawn marks — all three panels contain freehand pen, marker, or brush marks of varying density. Layer depth — all three panels have multiple overlapping visual layers creating physical depth. Cultural authenticity — all three panels reference [BRAND NAME]'s real subculture world.

---

PHASE 6: TECH SPECS

Single wide-format image — three panels side by side, zero gap between them. Each panel: 1:1 square or 4:5 portrait — three equal widths. Film grain: real noise texture overlay on all panels — ISO 1600 to 3200 equivalent grain density. Risograph treatment on Panel 1: genuine two-color halftone simulation — not a filter, a real duotone with visible dot pattern at close inspection. Photography: editorial quality across all three panels — natural moments, not overly staged. Hand-drawn elements: authentic imperfect mark-making — not computer-generated perfect lines. Color palette: exclusively [BRAND NAME]'s documented brand colors across all three panels. Output feel: this triptych is published as a zine spread, pinned in a streetwear designer's studio, or posted as a campaign carousel on [BRAND NAME]'s Instagram.

The subjects should look like a tactical K-pop girl group concept: slim adult performers with confident, serious expressions, intense glossy eyes, slightly parted or relaxed lips, and strong camera-aware attitude. Preserve varied facial angles and expressions rather than making them identical. Use K-pop editorial makeup: smoky elongated eyeliner, cat-eye shape, shimmer on the eyelids, dramatic lashes, softly contoured cheeks, luminous clean base, and nude-pink lips.

Style the hair with strong idol-fashion variation: messy wet-textured black waves, long pink-magenta waves under a cap, platinum blonde braids, dark tousled hair, and face-framing strands. Hair should have deliberate flyaways, gloss, volume, and visible studio-light highlights.

Wardrobe should mix military streetwear and stage styling: olive green and black cropped tops, camouflage jackets, sleeveless tanks, tactical vests, straps, buckles, belts, cargo pants, fingerless gloves, hoop earrings, chains, rings, and caps. Several outfits should reveal skin in a fashion-stage way: faces, necks, collarbones, shoulders, upper arms, midriffs, waist, small hip-adjacent areas above low-rise pants, and one thigh area through sheer black tights. Skin should look fair to light with warm yellow bounce, smooth and satin-like as if lightly powdered under hot studio lamps, with bright highlights on cheekbones, collarbones, shoulders, and exposed midriff.

Use mixed framing: close-up portraits, half-body shots, cropped torso poses, one central standing figure, a crouched side pose, raised arms, hands near the face or cap, slight torso twists, and aggressive off-center crops. The composition should feel loud, asymmetrical, and poster-like, not like a clean studio portrait.

Photograph it as if shot with hard frontal studio flash and strong fill light, then composited into a glossy magazine-style fan poster. Keep deep focus, sharp faces, saturated color, hard graphic borders, slight compression texture, and a pasted-game-cover quality. The mood should feel bold, defiant, urban, playful, and fashionably dangerous, as if the characters had already stepped out of a chaotic city mission and are frozen on the cover before the next scene begins.

Avoid a single-subject portrait, plain background, pastel colors, natural outdoor lighting, overly smooth plastic AI skin, childlike faces, oversexualized posing, missing black panel borders, missing central typography, washed-out yellow, blurry text, deformed hands, extra limbs, and generic military cosplay.

items.title: 赛博朋克角色
items.prompt:
[BRAND NAME]

Act as a Social Media Art Director and Digital Collage Artist specializing in bold, youth-oriented brand content for Instagram and digital campaigns.

PHASE 1: CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK
Create a dynamic digital collage that merges fashion photography with graphic design chaos.

This is controlled rebellion — a composition that feels spontaneous, energetic, and expressive while maintaining strong brand coherence.

Aesthetic direction:
- Anti-polished
- Raw textures
- Layered imperfections
- Youth-driven visual noise
- High confidence, high movement energy

Visual language:
Torn edges, brush strokes, grain overlays, hand-drawn elements, and bold color blocking.

PHASE 2: MODEL & PHOTOGRAPHY
- Subject: One model (diverse casting, age 18–30)
- Pose Energy: 80% attitude, 20% natural  
  (jumping, leaning, sitting, mid-motion, power stance — NEVER static)
- Outfit: Streetwear / athleisure aligned with [BRAND NAME]
- Hero Product: One key product (clear visual anchor)

- Photography Style: Editorial fashion cutout
- Background Removal: Clean, sharp extraction
- Camera Angle: Slight low angle (hero perspective)
- Crop: Full body or 3/4 body (product clearly visible)

PHASE 3: COLOR BLOCKING FOUNDATION
- Primary Color Blob:
  Large organic shape (40–60% of frame)

- Color Selection:
  1 dominant brand color (auto-adapt from [BRAND NAME])

- Shape Style:
  Irregular, hand-painted / torn paper (NO perfect geometry)

- Texture:
  Brush grain / noise (15–25% opacity)

- Placement:
  Behind or wrapping around subject  
  (must frame, not hide product)

PHASE 4: GRAPHIC ELEMENTS LAYER
Add 3–5 abstract elements:

Element types (auto-select based on brand tone):
- Scribbles / hand-drawn marks
- Arrows / motion indicators
- Circles / blobs
- Texture overlays (dust, grain, fabric, noise)
- Doodles / symbolic icons

Rules:
- Colors: 2–3 total (primary + 1–2 accents)
- Placement: Asymmetric (top-left + bottom-right bias)
- Scale: Small (5%) + medium (15%)
- Avoid center clutter
- Keep imperfect, handmade feel

PHASE 5: TYPOGRAPHY INTEGRATION
- Logo:
  Upper-left or upper-right (10–15% width)

- Slogan/Headline:
  Use brand slogan OR create one aligned to brand tone

- Supporting Copy:
  Optional 1-line descriptor

- Type Style:
  Bold sans-serif / grotesk / geometric (brand dependent)

- Treatment:
  Mix straight + slight rotation (2–5°)

- Hierarchy:
  Logo → Headline → Supporting copy

PHASE 6: TEXTURE & BACKGROUND
- Base Layer:
  Off-white / light grey (NOT pure white)

- Color Range:
  RGB 245–250 (warm neutral)

- Texture Options:
  Paper grain / fabric texture / subtle noise

- Rule:
  Texture should be FELT, not dominant

PHASE 7: COMPOSITION RULES
- Layout:
  Asymmetric balance (model off-center)

- Breathing Room:
  15–20% negative space

- Layering Order:
  Background → Color blob → Graphics → Model → Typography

- Focal Point:
  Model + product = 60%  
  Graphics = 40% support

- Movement:
  Strong diagonal flow  
  (top-left → bottom-right OR reverse)

PHASE 8: BRAND INTELLIGENCE (AUTO-ADAPT)

Adapt energy based on brand type:

→ Streetwear / Sportswear  
Bold contrast, aggressive motion, louder graphics

→ Luxury Streetwear  
Minimal chaos, sharper spacing, refined typography

→ Outdoor / Utility  
Texture-heavy, grounded tones, functional realism

→ Beauty / Lifestyle  
Soft chaos, clean spacing, pastel or skin tones

→ Tech / Modern  
Minimal graphics, structured layout, sharp geometry

PHASE 9: SOCIAL MEDIA FOOTER (OPTIONAL)
- Bottom strip (8–10% height)
- Light neutral background
- Social handles / icons
- Clean grid layout
- Keep minimal (contrast to collage)

TECHNICAL SPECS:
- Aspect Ratio: 4:5 (primary) or 1:1
- Resolution: 2400x3000px+
- Color Mode: sRGB (Instagram optimized)
- Sharpness: High detail, slight grain allowed
- Output Style: Digital collage mimicking analog craft

- Photography Base (before cutout):
  85mm lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field

items.prompt:
生成一张高完成度的「角色世界观档案卡」。

【基础设定】
主题角色：【角色名称】 
所属作品：【作品名称】 
角色定位：【主角 / 反派 / 导师 / 战士 / 法师 / 忍者 / 调查兵团兵长 / 咒术师 / 精灵魔法使等】 
主标题文字：【必须准确显示角色中文全名，例如：漩涡鸣人】 
副标题文字：【可填写角色称号 / 短标语 / 角色定位】 
画幅比例：【3:4 竖版】 
主色调：【如黑橙、黑蓝、黑红、银蓝、黑白灰等】 
点缀色：【如火焰橙、电光蓝、猩红、金色、冷白光等】 
核心能力：【如螺旋丸、九尾之力、无量空处、立体机动装置、古代魔法等】 
标志元素：【如狐狸虚影、火焰、机械装置、星辉法阵、蓝色能量、废墟高塔等】 

【整体风格】
这不是普通人物插画，也不是简单角色卡，而是一张“高信息密度 + 强视觉冲击 + 角色设定感 + 海报级完成度”的动漫角色档案海报。 
整体风格融合：角色立像海报、视觉档案设计、中文排版海报、设定集封面、动漫周边收藏卡、高级杂志编排感。 
要求画面精致、清晰、酷、有冲击力，同时具备完整的信息结构与系列感。

【构图要求】
采用强烈的“斜对角分割构图”：
- 左上区域为浅色留白区 / 纸张质感区 / 档案信息区
- 右下区域为深色氛围区 / 能量区 / 世界观场景区
- 中间由一条明显的斜切边界分开，形成强烈的视觉张力
- 角色完整全身站在画面中央，略偏中间，正面向前走来或坚定站立
- 人物必须完整，不要裁掉头部、脚部，不要被文字遮挡
- 角色要有明确主角感、压迫感、登场感

【人物表现】
角色面部清晰，五官准确，符合该角色的典型气质与核心特征。 
服装、发型、武器、护具、装置、饰品等要具有高辨识度。 
姿态建议为：向前行走、坚定站立、正面出场、带有轻微动态。 
角色周围可加入与其能力相关的能量特效、烟雾、火焰、粒子、法阵、查克拉、电流、星辉等元素，增强画面冲击力。

【背景与世界观】
背景要与角色设定强关联：
- 浅色区：可带有旧纸、磨损纸张、档案纹理、墨痕、留白、印章感、细线框
- 深色区：可带有废墟、夜空、火焰、能量漩涡、机械装置、古城遗迹、战场、法阵、烟尘、远景建筑等
- 背景要有氛围，但不能喧宾夺主
- 角色后方可以加入半透明的巨大汉字底纹，增强设计感

【文字与排版系统】
所有主要信息统一改为中文排版，强调“中文角色档案海报”的视觉气质。 
主标题必须准确显示：【角色中文全名】。 
主标题建议用超大中文书法字 / 毛笔感字形 / 有冲击力的大字排版，放置在左上浅色区，允许竖排、断行、错位排版。 
可以加入一个较小的副标题标签，例如：
- 最强咒术师
- 忍者档案
- 调查兵团兵长
- 千年精灵魔法使
- 火焰之柱

【信息模块建议】
画面中加入完整但简洁的档案信息模块，建议包含以下内容中的 5–8 项：
- 身份
- 阵营
- 目标
- 武器 / 装置
- 核心术式 / 核心技能
- 评级
- 代号
- 信念
- 羁绊
- 作战风格
- 能力评估
- 档案记录
- 角色语录

例如可做成左侧横条信息栏、右侧小模块说明框、下方短段落档案备注等。

【图形与装饰系统】
加入现代中文视觉设计元素：
- 斜切信息条
- 细线边框
- 几何辅助线
- 小型数据标签
- 编号
- 坐标
- 评级条
- 小型说明框
- 红色印章 / 黑色印章
- 墨迹飞溅
- 断裂纹理
- 半透明大字底纹

注意图形元素是辅助，不要过多堆满，不要做成杂乱的PPT。

【画面气质】
整体要：
- 高级
- 清晰
- 有收藏感
- 有视觉冲击力
- 有动漫角色设定集气质
- 有中文海报的力量感
- 有强烈主视觉
- 有较高信息完成度

【特别要求】
1. 主标题必须准确显示：【角色中文全名】，不能缺字，不能错字。 
2. 角色必须全身完整呈现。 
3. 画面必须采用“斜对角切割”的版式，而不是普通左右平分。 
4. 所有文字以中文为主，可少量搭配英文编号，但不能喧宾夺主。 
5. 最终成品要像“动漫角色档案海报”，而不是普通宣传图。

items.prompt:
[BRAND NAME]

Act as a Senior Brand Art Director creating a horizontal triptych hero banner — three vertical panels side by side forming a single unified wide-format campaign image. The entire composition is driven by [BRAND NAME]'s real brand identity, real campaign information, and real cultural associations. References: Adidas FIFA World Cup campaign, Nike hero banners, Puma campaign triptychs, luxury brand editorial hero images.

---

PHASE 0: BRAND INTELLIGENCE — AUTONOMOUS RESEARCH

Perform a complete brand decode of [BRAND NAME] before generating anything.

COLOR SYSTEM: identify the exact two dominant colors [BRAND NAME] uses in hero campaign materials. Color 1: primary dark or neutral — the color used for portrait/product panels (black, deep navy, charcoal, or brand dark tone). Color 2: primary accent — the saturated vivid brand color used as the hero background for the central panel (hot pink for Adidas Argentina, signal orange for Nike, royal blue for Pepsi, etc). These two colors define the entire triptych — panels alternate or contrast between them. A brand designer must confirm these colors are correct.

TYPOGRAPHY CHARACTER: identify the typographic style [BRAND NAME] uses for campaign hero text. Describe its visual character precisely — script italic for fashion campaigns, bold condensed grotesque for sportswear, extended serif for luxury. The central panel typography must feel native to [BRAND NAME]'s visual language.

CAMPAIGN CONTENT: identify the most current or most iconic real campaign, product line, collaboration, or cultural moment associated with [BRAND NAME]. Extract: the campaign name, the hero product or collection name, a short product descriptor sentence (one real sentence used in [BRAND NAME] marketing), a CTA phrase consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s tone.

CULTURAL FIGURE: identify one real public figure — athlete, artist, musician, or cultural icon — who has a documented genuine relationship with [BRAND NAME] through sponsorship, collaboration, ambassadorship, or cultural association. This person appears in the left panel portrait.

---

PHASE 1: TRIPTYCH STRUCTURE

Single horizontal image — aspect ratio 3:1 or 16:5 ultrawide. Three equal-width vertical panels placed side by side with no gap between them — the panels bleed into each other creating a seamless wide composition. Each panel is a tall vertical rectangle, approximately 3:4 aspect ratio individually.

Panel 1 left: dark background (Color 1 from PHASE 0).
Panel 2 center: vivid accent background (Color 2 from PHASE 0).
Panel 3 right: same vivid accent background as center (Color 2) — or a slight variation.

The three panels read as one unified image — photography bleeds to frame edges on all sides, typography spans across panel boundaries where relevant.

---

PHASE 2: LEFT PANEL — PORTRAIT

The left panel is a dramatic close-up portrait of the cultural figure identified in PHASE 0. Shot tight — head and upper shoulders only, approximately 60 to 70% of the frame is the face and neck. The figure is in profile or 3/4 view — looking toward the center panel, not at camera. This directional gaze pulls the viewer's eye toward the center. The figure is wearing [BRAND NAME] product visibly. Lighting: dramatic, single source — strong side lighting creating deep shadows on the non-lit side of the face. The dark background (Color 1) envelopes the figure — no environmental context, pure portrait against dark. Upper left corner: the figure's name in small caps, light color, generous tracking — "LIONEL MESSI" style attribution. Lower left corner: a white or light-colored rectangular content block containing: campaign or product title in bold medium type, one sentence product descriptor in small regular type, a CTA button with arrow — "SHOP NOW →" style.

---

PHASE 3: CENTER PANEL — TYPOGRAPHIC HERO

The center panel is the most visually explosive element of the triptych. Background: Color 2 (vivid brand accent) at full saturation — pure flat color, no gradient. Two figures or one figure in a dynamic physical pose — movement, energy, action consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s brand world. The figures are wearing [BRAND NAME] products. The figures are positioned slightly off-center, overlapping with each other.

REPEATING TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM: a single key word from the campaign — a country name, collection name, product name, or brand word — is typeset in a large italic or script display typeface and repeated three times vertically across the full height of the panel. The three repetitions vary in size: top instance — medium, partially cropped by the top edge. Middle instance — largest, approximately 40 to 50% of panel height, sitting behind or over the figures. Bottom instance — medium-large, partially cropped by the bottom edge. All three instances are the same word. The typography color: a vivid contrasting color — white, hot pink, or a third brand accent — with high visibility against Color 2. The figures exist on a layer between the background color and the typography — they are behind some type instances and in front of others, creating depth.

Above the figures: a small campaign identifier in all-caps tracked text — campaign name and trademark symbol. Below the figures: same campaign identifier repeated.

---

PHASE 4: RIGHT PANEL — PRODUCT CLOSE-UP

The right panel is a tight editorial crop of [BRAND NAME]'s hero product from the campaign — apparel, footwear, or accessory. The crop is intimate and detailed — showing the product at close range, revealing material texture, construction details, branding elements. Background: Color 2 (same as center panel) creating visual continuity. The product is worn or held by a partial figure — only a torso, hands, or legs visible, no face. A large graphic number or letter — a jersey number, collection code, or brand identifier — is positioned in the frame as a typographic accent, consistent with the treatment in the center panel.

---

PHASE 5: TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM

All typography across the triptych uses the character identified in PHASE 0 — consistent visual language across all three panels. The repeating word in the center panel: italic, script, or bold display consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s campaign aesthetic. Attribution text, campaign identifiers, and CTA: clean sans-serif, all-caps, tracked — consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s informational typography. No decorative fonts outside the brand's documented visual language.

---

PHASE 6: LIGHTING & PHOTOGRAPHY

Left panel: dramatic portrait lighting — single strong side light, dark background, high contrast. Center panel: even bright studio lighting consistent with the flat vivid background — figures are cleanly lit, no heavy shadows. Right panel: product photography lighting — soft, revealing material texture and construction detail. All three panels feel like they were shot in the same campaign session — unified photographic language despite different lighting needs.

---

PHASE 7: COMPOSITION UNITY

The three panels must read as one image, not three separate images placed next to each other. Unity mechanisms: the typography from the center panel may bleed slightly into the edges of the left and right panels. The saturated Color 2 background of the center and right panels creates a visual block that anchors the right two-thirds of the composition. The dark Color 1 of the left panel creates contrast that makes the portrait pop. The figure's gaze in the left panel points toward the center. The overall reading direction: portrait left → typographic explosion center → product detail right.

---

PHASE 8: TECH SPECS

Aspect ratio: 3:1 or 16:5, single flat image — no separate panels, no borders between panels. Color palette: exactly Color 1 and Color 2 from PHASE 0, plus white or light neutral for typography. No additional colors. No gradients. No textures. Photography: editorial campaign quality — not stock photography. Typography: character consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s documented visual identity as described in PHASE 0. All campaign text, product names, and cultural figure attribution are real [BRAND NAME] data. Output feel: this image appears as the hero banner on [BRAND NAME]'s official website homepage or as a campaign outdoor billboard.

高端游戏角色宣传海报，竖向构图，超特写半身特拍。中心人物是一个严肃、神秘的年轻男性幻想人物，一头蓬松的银白色凌乱的头发，发丝细密，层次丰富，顶部有突出的白狼耳或兽耳，散发出一种冷酷、危险、内敛的气息。他的脸只露出一半，另一半则被巨大的未来派狙击枪或重型机械武器遮住，造成强烈的视觉压力。只有一只眼睛露出来，锐利、安静，带着猎人的压迫性目光。

该角色穿着高领战斗服和深蓝色、黑色和金属金色色调的轻甲，由皮革、金属、机械装甲结构和微弱发光的能量部件混合而成的优质材料制成。衣领高高地升起，包裹着颈部，肩膀上覆盖着坚硬的甲片，服装厚重、朴素，质地精确。这把武器隐约出现在镜头附近，以巨大的扫掠占据了画面的右侧——设计为未来派狙击步枪，具有黑金金属框架、复杂的雕刻、分段的机械装置、蓝色发光的能量室或瞄准模块，细节错综复杂，将高科技与《王者荣耀》的奇幻风格融为一体。

海报的左侧，融入了大片中国书法风格的标题文字，笔触犀利，泼墨粗犷，深蓝色的水墨质感；旁边是竖排的小罗马字母和布局注释，形成了游戏角色名称海报设计。下面，添加细长的小字标语和英文排版，风格就像顶级MOBA手游的英雄宣传海报。顶部可以有微妙的金色游戏品牌标志或抽象徽章，底部可以有居中的系列标语布局。

风格关键词：高端游戏海报、男主角色、半脸模糊构图、超特写特摄、银白色狼耳少年、未来狙击枪、冷色调电影感、王者荣耀风格、水墨标题、青黑金调色板、雪粒、奇幻战场背景、精致发丝、目光犀利、高细节材质、精品手游宣传片视觉效果、史诗般的范围、压抑的强度、酷炫、神秘、超高清细节。

使用清晰的结构，包括英雄区域、版式区域、呼吸空间、支持细节区域和平衡的图形流程。应用积极的负空间、模块化网格系统、分层视觉节奏、受控混乱、电影裁剪和优质品牌级构图。
版式必须感觉像一个设计元素——超大的标题、超小的元数据、裁剪的文本、垂直或旋转的版式、重叠的图层、边缘对齐的位置、破碎的网格布局和强烈的尺寸对比。创造张力、运动和视觉流动，而不是干净的可预测的对齐。
使用大胆的编辑裁剪、意想不到的取景、对象溢出和电影特写镜头。灵感来自奢华时尚活动。

日落时分，她站在热带海滩上，摆出时尚海报般的姿势。使用低角度的社论构图，让她占据大部分画面。一只手放在臀部附近，另一只手拿着时尚的太阳镜或冲浪板带。附近放置了一块冲浪板作为海滩活动道具。

她的服装是现代蒂法风格的奢华夏季造型：白色合身短款上衣、黑色低腰比基尼泳裤或超短沙滩短裤、黑色袖套、无指手套、微妙的红色点缀、精致的腰链和优质光泽泳衣面料。服装应该给人运动感、性感感、时尚感和品味。

背景：热带海滩、金色夕阳天空、棕榈树、海浪、海滩俱乐部氛围、柔和的镜头光晕、温暖的阳光、电影般的边缘照明、皮肤上的发光亮点、微妙的夏日身体光泽、细致的皮肤纹理、光泽杂志品质的表面。

使最终图像超细致、半写实的动漫到写实、电影化、锐利、时尚、奢华，适合作为高端夏季时尚广告。

屏幕中央是一部巨大的智能手机，直立在现实世界中，就像通往虚拟世界的门户。手机屏幕显示一个虚构的中文短视频/社交媒体资料页面，其结构参考了常见的社交媒体资料：顶部状态栏、头像、昵称、简介、点赞数、关注数、关注数、粉丝数、编辑资料按钮、作品/日常活动/推荐内容标签、九格作品缩略图和底部导航栏。整个简介内容围绕明日香和EVA Unit-02以及新世纪福音战士的主题重新设计；头像、背景图、作品封面、浮动卡片、推荐内容等都与人物性格、故事元素、视觉符号相关。
明日香这个角色正从手机屏幕中走出来，她的一半身体仍在屏幕内，而另一半则突破了屏幕的界限，进入了现实空间。她的一只手伸向镜头，手掌位于画面最前方，产生强烈的超广角透视畸变；一只脚或一条腿也走出手机屏幕，靠近观看者，产生强烈的3D深度感和视觉冲击力“打破维度障碍”。该角色必须看起来真正走出社交媒体页面，而不仅仅是站在手机前。

At the center of the screen is a giant smartphone, standing upright in the real world like a portal to a virtual world. The phone screen displays a fictional Chinese short video/social media profile page, its structure referencing common social media profiles: a top status bar, avatar, nickname, bio, number of likes, number of followers, number of following, number of fans, an edit profile button, tags for works/daily activities/recommended content, a nine-grid thumbnail of works, and a bottom navigation bar. The entire profile content is redesigned around the themes of Asuka and EVA Unit-02 and Neon Genesis Evangelion; the avatar, background image, work covers, floating cards, and recommended content are all related to the character's personality, story elements, and visual symbols.
The character Asuka is stepping out of the phone screen, half of her body still inside the screen, while the other half has broken through the screen's boundaries into real space. One of her hands reaches towards the camera, the palm positioned at the very front of the frame, creating a strong ultra-wide-angle perspective distortion; a foot or leg also steps out of the phone screen, approaching the viewer, generating a strong sense of 3D depth and a visually striking "breaking the dimensional barrier." The character must appear to truly step out of the social media page, not simply stand in front of the phone.

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh: 担任足球编辑艺术总监和比赛日活动设计师，为刚刚赢得 2025/2026 年英超联赛冠军的曼城队制作优质景观球队海报。使用从球场水平拍摄的极端虫眼英雄镜头，由 3-5 名曼城现役球员（如埃尔林·哈兰德、菲尔·福登、罗德里、贝尔纳多·席尔瓦、杰里米·多库、约科·格瓦迪奥尔或萨维尼奥）拍摄，其中中央队长/明星人物（如贝尔纳多·席尔瓦或哈兰德）占主导地位，并伸向镜头以获得深度和力量。用大气烟雾、冷蓝色光束和从左、右和底部前景进入的微妙体育场雾气包围球队，创造出一个受阿提哈德体育场启发的隧道状框架。使用精致的天蓝色-白色-海军蓝调色板：明亮的曼城天蓝色作为主要标识，深海军蓝和木炭阴影形成对比，柔和的白色高光和微妙的电蓝色强调。在背景中以非常低的不透明度添加微弱的阿提哈德体育场建筑图案或抽象的圆形徽章图案。保持灯光的电影感和高端感，在面部和躯干上使用干净的体育场泛光灯照明，冷蓝色调的柔和边缘照明，以及控制阴影深度以实现优质的编辑外观。塑造具有精英沉着和技术优势的球员——平静的表情、敏锐的注意力、最小的攻击性、强调控制和智力。球衣应该显得质朴而现代，具有可见的 PUMA 面料纹理和赞助商整合，具有微妙的汗水真实感。在整个过程中添加轻胶片颗粒和优质体育摄影纹理。版式布局：顶部中央有精致的曼城队徽或“MANCHESTER CITY”字标，左上方和右上方附近有最小间距的大写微缩文字（球员姓名/球队号码），一个大的中央标题采用大胆的现代显示字体，微妙的发光字“BLUE MOON”重叠在下躯干区域，然后在下半部分有干净的现代无衬线比赛日细节，并带有超大日期。保持优质的社论构图，具有强烈的负空间、受控的前景氛围以及干净、主导、精英的欧洲足球能量——精确、战术和沉着。他们所穿的球衣必须是所附的 2025/2026 赛季的球衣
items.prompt: Act as a football editorial art director and matchday campaign designer creating a premium landscape team poster for Manchester City that just won Premier League 2025/2026. Use an extreme worm’s-eye hero shot from pitch level featuring 3–5 current Manchester City players (such as Erling Haaland, Phil Foden, Rodri, Bernardo Silva, Jérémy Doku, Joško Gvardiol, or Savinho), with the central captain/star figure (e.g. Bernardo Silva or Haaland) dominant and reaching toward the camera for depth and power. Surround the squad with atmospheric smoke, cool blue light beams, and subtle stadium haze entering from the left, right, and bottom foreground, creating a tunnel-like frame inspired by the Etihad Stadium. Use a refined sky blue–white–navy palette: luminous Manchester City sky blue as the dominant identity, deep navy and charcoal shadows for contrast, soft white highlights, and subtle electric blue accents. Add faint Etihad Stadium architectural patterns or abstract circular crest motifs at very low opacity in the background. Keep the lighting cinematic and high-end, with clean stadium floodlight illumination on faces and torsos, soft rim lighting in cool blue tones, and controlled shadow depth for a premium editorial look. Style the players with elite composure and technical dominance — calm expressions, sharp focus, minimal aggression, emphasizing control and intelligence. Kits should appear pristine and modern with visible PUMA fabric textures and sponsor integration, with subtle sweat realism. Add light film grain and premium sports photography texture throughout. Typography layout: small refined Manchester City crest or “MANCHESTER CITY” wordmark at the top center, minimal spaced uppercase micro-copy near upper left and upper right (player names / squad numbers), one large central headline in a bold modern display font with subtle glow reading “BLUE MOON” overlapping the lower torso area, then clean modern sans serif matchday details in the bottom half with oversized date. Maintain a premium editorial composition with strong negative space, controlled foreground atmosphere, and a clean, dominant, elite European football energy — precise, tactical, and composed. The jerseys they're wearing MUST be the exact 2025/2026 season as attached

items.title: 复古风景
items.promptZh:
哈尔的移动城堡中哈尔和苏菲的浪漫奇幻插图，垂直海报布局。哈尔一头凌乱的金发，身穿红蓝绣花外套，内搭白色蕾丝衬衫，戴着蓝色吊坠项链，轻轻抚摸着苏菲的头，表情温柔又温柔。苏菲一头银色的长发编着紫色的丝带，穿着一件飘逸的蓝色泡泡袖复古连衣裙，系着围裙，扶着金属栏杆，抬头看着哈尔。 

他们站在移动的城堡上，天空微风习习，阳光明媚，金色时刻柔和的灯光，飘逸的织物，营造出梦幻般的氛围。背景显示机械城堡结构和云彩。 

左侧文本布局采用衬线字体：顶部为大红色字母“HOWL & SOPHIE”，下方小写字母为“HOWL'S MOVING CASTLE”，下方为红色小火恶魔 Calcifer 图标。引用文字：“即使风向改变，我也会找到通往你的路。”左下角的红色小三角形。柔和的绘画风格、温暖柔和的色调、吉卜力工作室风格的美学、高细节、2:3 的宽高比。
items.prompt:
Romantic fantasy illustration of Howl and Sophie from Howl's Moving Castle, vertical poster layout. Howl with messy blonde hair, wearing a red and blue embroidered coat over a white lace shirt and blue pendant necklace, gently touching Sophie's head with a soft, tender expression. Sophie with long silver-blonde braided hair tied with a purple ribbon, wearing a flowing blue vintage dress with puffed sleeves and apron, looking up at Howl while holding onto a metal railing. 

They are standing on the moving castle in a windy, sunlit sky with soft golden hour lighting, flowing fabric, and a dreamy atmosphere. Background shows the mechanical castle structure and clouds. 

Left side text layout in serif font: 'HOWL & SOPHIE' in large red letters at top, 'HOWL'S MOVING CASTLE' in small caps below, small red fire demon Calcifer icon underneath. Quote text: 'EVEN IF THE WIND CHANGES, I WILL FIND MY WAY TO YOU.' Small red triangle at bottom left. Soft painterly style, warm pastel tones, Studio Ghibli-inspired aesthetic, high detail, 2:3 aspect ratio.

items.title: 请根据用户输入的【主题】或上传的【参考图片】，创作一张横向 …
items.prompt:
请根据用户输入的【主题】或上传的【参考图片】，创作一张横向 4:3 的高完成度「AI美甲灵感方案 」。

【输入规则】
如果用户提供的是文字主题，请根据主题进行抽象提炼。
如果用户提供的是参考图片：
- Image A 是灵感参考图，是本次美甲方案的核心灵感来源；
- 如果用户还提供了手部照片，则 Image B 为手部参考图，用于辅助生成更贴近肤色与手型的实际上手效果；
- 如果没有手部照片，请生成一组自然、真实、审美在线的通用女性双手上手效果图。

--------------------------------------------------
【图片标题与副标题】
主标题请明确写：
AI美甲灵感方案

英文副标题可写：
AI Nail Inspiration Board

小标题可根据主题自动生成，例如：
Inspired by [主题名称]
或
Visual Translation of [主题名称]

如果是中文主题，也可以中英结合，例如：
灵感来源 / Inspired by [主题]
主题转译 / Concept Translation

--------------------------------------------------
【整体版式要求】
横向 4:3 版式，整体采用高端提案板排版。

画面建议分为以下几个模块，并保持层次清晰、留白舒服、结构有秩序：

一、顶部标题区
二、灵感来源区
三、视觉元素提取区
四、10指甲设计区（核心主视觉）
五、风格总结区
六、推荐甲型 / 工艺 / 场景区
七、实际上手效果区（非常重要）
八、底部总结区

背景保持干净克制，可使用暖白、奶油白、浅灰、浅米色、雾粉灰等高级底色，不要过度花哨。
整体设计感应偏向高端美甲品牌视觉、时尚杂志内页、设计提案板，而不是电商详情页或低质海报。

--------------------------------------------------
【各板块详细要求】

① 标题区 / Title Area
在画面上方清晰呈现：
- 主标题：AI美甲灵感方案
- 英文副标题：AI Nail Inspiration Board
- 主题名称：根据用户输入自动生成
- 一句简洁的风格描述，例如：
“从主题中提取色彩、符号与情绪，转译为一整套可上手的美甲方案。”

标题区要简洁有力，体现高级感和设计感。

--------------------------------------------------
② 灵感来源区 / Inspiration Source
如果用户上传了参考图，请在左上或上方区域展示参考图缩略图，并标注：
- 灵感来源 / Inspiration Source
- 主题名称
- 简短说明：这次设计从参考图中提取了哪些气质与方向

如果用户只输入文字主题，则在此区域以文字方式呈现：
- 主题名称
- 主题简介
- 核心氛围描述

此区不是大篇文字，而是简洁专业、像设计说明一样。

--------------------------------------------------
③ 视觉元素提取区 / Visual Extraction
请将灵感拆解成几个清晰的小模块，排版精致、信息明确：

A. 色彩系统 / Color Palette
请推荐：
- 主色 3 个
- 辅助色 2 个
- 点缀色 1 个

用小色卡形式展示，并标注色彩名称。
色彩命名可偏审美化，例如：
奶杏裸粉、冷调银灰、酒红莓果、墨绿、雾霾紫、香槟金、深海蓝、珍珠白等。

B. 关键词 / Style Keywords
提炼 4—6 个关键词，例如：
温柔、神秘、复古、冷艳、梦幻、浪漫、华丽、克制、轻甜、未来感、松弛、清冷、戏剧感等。

C. 图案与符号 / Motifs
提取 4—6 个可被转译进甲面的视觉元素，例如：
月亮、星轨、花瓣、水波、羽毛、火焰、丝带、蝴蝶、格纹、书页、音符、金线、藤蔓、金属边框、玻璃碎片感等。

D. 材质与工艺 / Texture & Finish
提炼适合本次主题的工艺方向，例如：
猫眼、珠光、金箔、渐变晕染、镜面、果冻透感、法式边、贝壳碎片、磨砂、立体水滴、微浮雕、细闪、丝绒感等。

这一整区要非常像“设计逻辑提取板”，清晰、专业、简洁。

--------------------------------------------------
④ 10指甲设计区 / 10-Nail Design Plan
这是整张图的绝对核心，请占据最大视觉权重。

请明确展示：
- 左手 5 枚
- 右手 5 枚

每一个指甲都要单独清晰呈现，并附简洁说明。
建议每枚指甲包含：
- 指位（Thumb / Index / Middle / Ring / Pinky）
- 设计名称
- 简短说明（1句话）
- 主要元素 / 工艺

整套 10 指甲必须形成统一风格，同时又有节奏变化，不可十个都一样，也不可毫无联系地乱做。
既要有完整系列感，又要有细节差异和层次感。

--------------------------------------------------
⑤ 风格总结区 / Concept Summary
请在右侧或中右区域做一个小型总结模块，包含：

- 风格主题 / Style Theme
例如：
暗夜玫瑰 / Midnight Rose
海风日落 / Sunset Coast
旧梦电影感 / Retro Cinema Mood
春日书页 / Spring Pages
深海星轨 / Ocean Starline

- 整体气质说明
用 1 段简洁说明总结整套方案的方向，例如：
“这套设计通过低饱和主色、细节金属线条与局部珠光工艺，将灵感中的浪漫与克制感转译为更适合日常佩戴的高级美甲方案。”

--------------------------------------------------
⑥ 甲型 / 工艺 / 适用场景区
请做成小而精致的模块，包含：

A. 推荐甲型 / Nail Shape
根据主题与风格自动推荐 1—2 种合适甲型，例如：
- 短圆甲
- 方圆甲
- 椭圆甲
- 杏仁甲
- 中长椭圆甲

并简短说明理由，如：
“更显精致”“更适合日常佩戴”“更能承载图案层次”“更显手部修长感”。

B. 推荐工艺 / Recommended Finishes
总结这套设计最重要的工艺重点，例如：
渐变晕染、微珠光、金线细节、猫眼流光、局部镜面等。

C. 场景建议 / Best For
说明适合的场景，例如：
通勤、约会、婚礼、度假、节日、演唱会、春夏、秋冬等。

这一块要像“实用落地建议”，增强方案可执行性。

--------------------------------------------------
⑦ 实际上手效果区 / On-Hand Preview
这一部分非常重要，必须精致、真实、有说服力。

请生成一组高完成度的双手上手效果图，展示这整套美甲真正做在手上的样子。
要求：
- 双手自然、真实、比例正常
- 手部姿态优雅，不夸张、不僵硬
- 指甲细节清晰可见
- 光线柔和高级，具有棚拍质感
- 可采用自然摆拍方式

如果用户提供了手部照片，请尽量匹配其手部肤色与基础手型特征；
如果没有手部照片，请生成一组大众审美友好、气质自然、适合展示美甲的女性双手效果。

重点：
这不是简单的小缩略图，而是整张图中非常关键的落地展示模块。
要让用户第一眼就觉得：“这套设计真的能做，而且做出来会很好看。”

--------------------------------------------------
⑧ 底部总结区 / Final Note
请在底部或右下角写一句清晰有力的总结语，例如：

“这套方案并非简单复制灵感来源，而是提取其色彩、情绪与符号语言，转译为更适合甲面表达、同时兼顾美感与佩戴性的完整美甲设计。”

这句总结要起到“收尾 + 提升专业感”的作用。

--------------------------------------------------

最终请输出一张横向 4:3 的高完成度「AI美甲灵感方案」专业提案图。
用户第一眼应被这套美甲方案吸引，第二眼能看懂整套设计逻辑，第三眼会觉得这套方案真实可做、而且做出来会很好看。

items.title: 情侣极简海报复古
items.prompt: 生成一个 {argument name="subject" default="背靠背阅读的情侣"}，采用清晰的版画美学风格，具有粗线条和自然的扭曲效果。包含 {argument name="color tone" default="柔和色调"}、复古印刷质感、轻微错位的墨层以及粗糙的纸张纹理。构图呈现宁静的海报风格，留有充足的负空间。道具和背景保持极简。配色方案：{argument name="color count" default="2–3 种颜色"}。

items.title: 复古京都旅行海报
items.prompt: 一张复古旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="destination name" default="KYOTO"}（日本），采用怀旧的 20 世纪中期旅游风格设计，带有褪色的纸张质感、轻微磨损的边缘以及温暖的岁月色调。使用带有圆角的竖版海报布局，并配以奶油色边框。顶部放置醒目的大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="KYOTO"}，采用超大号优雅红色衬线字体；下方居中放置深蓝色衬线字体的“JAPAN”，并配有细长的装饰分割线。下方添加斜体标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="Timeless Beauty. Endless Memories."}。主体画面应展示一个极具张力的低角度视角，呈现一座鲜艳朱红色的传统日本五重塔，配有深色木质屋檐和黑色栏杆，矗立在石基上，前景为木质走道。塔周围环绕着绿色的树木繁茂的山丘、明亮的蓝天和柔和的奶油色云朵。左侧包含一个垂直的红色标签，上面印有白色日文字符“京都、日本”。同时，从左侧伸入一枝盛开的樱花，带有簇簇淡粉色的花朵。在右上角，加入一枚邮票，上面有暗红色的塔影，部分被一个圆形的邮戳覆盖，邮戳上写着“KYOTO JAPAN”，中心为汉字“京都”，并向右延伸出几条波浪形的邮戳线。底部添加居中的复古页脚标语，采用衬线大写字母，内容为 {argument name="footer text" default="DISCOVER TRADITION. EMBRACE KYOTO."}。整体外观应呈现出浪漫、具有收藏价值、略带磨损感，如同 20 世纪 50 年代或 60 年代的经典日本旅游印刷品。

items.title: 棚拍产品
items.promptZh: 使用智能手机主摄像头或高品质紧凑型相机拍摄的可信的户外咖啡馆生活方式图像，具有有限的计算 HDR、温和的美颜处理和休闲社交媒体快照的感觉，而不是工作室制作
items.prompt: A believable outdoor café lifestyle image photographed with a smartphone main camera or high-quality compact camera, featuring restrained computational HDR, mild beauty processing, and a casual social-media snapshot feeling rather than studio production

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:
超现实的特写智能手机自拍肖像，是一位美丽的年轻东亚女性，具有柔和、年轻的审美，在自然窗户光下、干净的中性灰色背景下拍摄。她有一头丝般齐肩的乌黑长发，搭配轻盈的薄纱刘海，一侧扎着精致的侧辫子，光滑、白皙的皮肤散发着自然健康的光泽。她灰棕色的大眼睛，柔和的眼线，精致的睫毛，自然轮廓的眉毛，在与镜头直接目光接触时，表情平静，略带俏皮。

items.prompt:
Create a cinematic, film-production-grade character design sheet for a director, casting team, and costume department. Character name: [YOUR CHARACTER NAME HERE]. Must feel like a high-budget animated film pitch board, not a generic model sheet.

CORE DIRECTIVE (NON-NEGOTIABLE): No generic layouts. No evenly spaced grids. No symmetry for symmetry's sake. Composition must feel art-directed, intentional, slightly asymmetrical. Every section must feel placed, not auto-generated.

CHARACTER IDENTITY: Name: [Full name] | Alias: [Nickname or codename] | Age: [Real or stylized] | Height: [cm or ft] | Build: [Body type, proportions, posture tendencies] | Ethnicity / Design Language: [e.g. Pixar-esque, anime-inspired, culturally grounded]

FACE DESIGN: Structure: [Face shape, bone structure, exaggeration level] | Skin: [Tone, texture, imperfections] | Eyes: [Size, spacing, color, expressiveness] | Hair: [Style, texture, movement, imperfections] | Distinct Features: [Scars, dimples, moles, anything unique]

PSYCHOLOGICAL PROFILE: Core Traits: [3 to 5 dominant personality traits] | Internal Conflict: [What they want vs what holds them back] | Behavior Patterns: [3 habits that reveal their personality] | Emotional Baseline: [Default mood + how fast it shifts]

PERFORMANCE DIRECTION: Character must feel like a real actor caught mid-moment, NOT posing. Micro-expressions required (lip tension, eye flicker, brow shift). Avoid staged symmetry. Capture transitional emotion. Body Language: [Posture tendencies] | [Movement rhythm: stiff, sharp, bouncy, dragging] | [Idle behavior: fidgeting, stillness, tension]

WARDROBE: Garment 1: [fabric type, wear, imperfections] | Garment 2: [fit, distortion, stitching] | Layering logic | Footwear: [material, wear patterns] | Accessories: [items that reveal personality] | Props: [objects that reinforce who they are]

MATERIAL ACCURACY: Fabrics must show stretch, stitching, wrinkles, wear. No plastic look unless intentional. Skin must have soft light interaction. Include imperfections: dirt, smudges, aging, usage marks.

TURNAROUND (STRICT): Full-body front, 3/4, side, back, 3/4 back views. Identical proportions and design fidelity. No drift in face or costume across any angle.

HEAD STUDY: Front (neutral) | 3/4 (primary personality) | Profile (structure) | Looking Down | Looking Up | Dynamic Angle (intense state). All expressions mid-thought, not posed.

CINEMATIC PORTRAIT: Environment: [Location tied to character] | Lighting: [Practical sources, contrast level] | Color Tone: [Warm, cool, stylized] | Expression: [Specific narrative moment] | Camera: [50mm or 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, cinematic realism]

LAYOUT: Clean, art-directed sheet. Neutral gray background. Include: height scale, annotation callouts, wardrobe breakdown, production notes. Must feel like a premium studio board.

STYLE: [e.g. Pixar-style stylized realism / Semi-realistic cinematic design]. Must include: appealing exaggeration, soft geometry, cinematic lighting, high emotional readability.

CONSISTENCY RULE (STRICT): Face, proportions, costume, and details must remain IDENTICAL across all views. No reinterpretation between angles. Ever.

items.title: 电影感女性
items.promptZh:
以都市时尚编辑拼贴风格创建高分辨率 8K 肖像海报，将当代街头时尚美学与优质编辑杂志设计融为一体。整体构图应给人大胆、时尚、现代和视觉层次感，结合奢华时尚活动、城市文化和艺术拼贴实验的元素。融入强烈反映城市时尚编辑拼贴美学的动态海报装饰品和装饰元素，例如撕破的纸张纹理、分层的杂志剪纸、抽象的几何口音、富有表现力的笔触、排版片段、街头风格的图形叠加、半色调纹理、胶带效果、油漆飞溅、手写涂鸦和时尚的编辑布局组合。每个装饰元素都应该让人感觉有意、时尚、视觉平衡，而不是过度拥挤。人类确实看到了撕碎的纸张和涂鸦纹理，并决定，“是的，这现在很奢侈。”不知何故它有效。

拍摄对象的姿势不得与参考照片相似。以更加自然、富有表现力和情感活跃的方式创造完全不同的身体姿势和面部表情。避免僵硬、笨拙、扁平或过于对称的姿势。拍摄对象应散发出国际时装模特的自信优雅、流畅的肢体语言、微妙的动作和电影般的编辑态度。表情应该给人一种魅力、轻松、时尚和现代的感觉，就像在高端街头服饰杂志拍摄的照片而不是静态的工作室肖像中捕捉到的一样。通过姿势、衣服运动、手部放置、相机角度或注视方向添加轻微的运动能量，使构图感觉更加生动和动态。

服装必须以现代休闲时尚为特色，具有时尚潮流的都市审美。避免单调的服装设计、颜色或材料。结合时尚的层次、现代的剪裁、独特的纹理、时尚的配饰和各种调色板，与海报构图相得益彰。服装应该给人一种优质、年轻和时尚前卫的感觉，灵感来自于全球街头服饰和奢华休闲的编辑风格。自然地混合不同的面料材质、图案和色调，创造丰富的视觉效果，而不会让服装看起来混乱或过于夸张。

使用具有强烈对比度和深度的戏剧性编辑照明来增强时尚氛围。背景应与拼贴元素无缝融合，创造出充满层次感的城市能量和现代时尚特征的视觉沉浸式海报构图。在主题可见性和装饰复杂性之间保持清晰的平衡，使海报仍然感觉优质且具有专业的艺术指导。最终结果应该看起来像一张精致的国际时尚活动海报，具有强烈的城市编辑特征、超详细的纹理、清晰的焦点、电影级的色彩分级以及超详细的 8K 分辨率下高度抛光的视觉质量。
items.prompt:
Create a high-resolution 8K portrait poster in an Urban Fashion Editorial Collage style, blending contemporary street-fashion aesthetics with premium editorial magazine design. The overall composition should feel bold, stylish, modern, and visually layered, combining elements of luxury fashion campaigns, urban culture, and artistic collage experimentation. Incorporate dynamic poster ornaments and decorative elements that strongly reflect the Urban Fashion Editorial Collage aesthetic, such as ripped paper textures, layered magazine cutouts, abstract geometric accents, expressive brush strokes, typography fragments, street-style graphic overlays, halftone textures, tape effects, paint splashes, handwritten scribbles, and fashionable editorial layout compositions. Every decorative element should feel intentional, stylish, and visually balanced rather than overcrowded. Humanity really looked at torn paper and graffiti textures and decided, “yes, this is luxury now.” Somehow it works.

The subject’s pose must not resemble the reference photo. Create a completely different body posture and facial expression with a more natural, expressive, and emotionally alive presence. Avoid stiff, awkward, flat, or overly symmetrical posing. The subject should radiate the confident elegance of an international fashion model, with fluid body language, subtle movement, and a cinematic editorial attitude. The expression should feel charismatic, effortless, fashionable, and modern, as if captured during a high-end streetwear magazine photoshoot rather than a static studio portrait. Add slight motion energy through posture, clothing movement, hand placement, camera angle, or gaze direction to make the composition feel more alive and dynamic.

The outfit must feature modern casual fashion with a stylish and trendy urban aesthetic. Avoid monotonous clothing design, colors, or materials. Combine fashionable layers, contemporary cuts, unique textures, stylish accessories, and varied color palettes that complement the poster composition. The clothing should feel premium, youthful, and fashion-forward, inspired by global streetwear and luxury casual editorial styling. Mix different fabric materials, patterns, and tones naturally to create visual richness without making the outfit look chaotic or overly exaggerated.

Use dramatic editorial lighting with strong contrast and depth to enhance the fashion atmosphere. The background should integrate seamlessly with the collage elements, creating a visually immersive poster composition filled with layered urban energy and modern fashion identity. Maintain a clean balance between subject visibility and decorative complexity so the poster still feels premium and professionally art-directed. The final result should look like a sophisticated international fashion campaign poster with a strong urban editorial character, ultra-detailed textures, crisp focus, cinematic color grading, and highly polished visual quality in ultra-detailed 8K resolution.

items.prompt:
Use the attached reference photo only for identity reference. Create an ultra-realistic collectible Mega games store photography scene featuring the exact person from the reference image cosplaying as Boa Hancock from One Piece.

IMPORTANT: Preserve the person’s exact facial identity, facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, and overall recognizable appearance. The person must remain instantly recognizable as the same individual from the reference photo. Adapt the hairstyle to match Boa Hancock’s long, flowing black hair with signature snake motif and golden snake ornament while keeping the face 100% identical to the reference.

The person is dressed in a high-quality, accurate cosplay of Boa Hancock: signature red cheongsam-style dress with gold trim and dramatic high side slit, snake-themed accessories and jewelry, elegant yet seductive presentation that perfectly suits the character’s personality and the reference person’s appearance.

The person is standing inside a large, authentic collectible game store during daytime. The store is filled with shelves displaying hundreds of collectible PVC figures, PS5 consoles, Xbox, controllers, DVDs, designer toys, anime figures, character statues, and premium collectibles. Many figures with similar proportions and styles are visible throughout the background, creating the feeling of a specialty figure shop and collector’s paradise. The environment feels authentic, busy, and visually rich, with rows of display cases, toy boxes, figurines, and colorful merchandise.

Several identical “KOKIE” figurines can be seen displayed on shelves behind the person, including versions resembling popular characters like Hancock, as if the character has become a popular collectible toy line.

The person is holding a highly detailed collectible PVC figurine of themselves as Boa Hancock. The figurine is approximately 50 cm tall and is held naturally in both hands. The figurine depicts the same person in the exact same Hancock cosplay outfit, hairstyle, and identity. The figurine is designed as a premium collectible character figure with a realistic sculpt and high-quality PVC finish, but with humorous 3-head-tall proportion, oversized head, compact body, and intentionally exaggerated proportions. The figurine stands in a confident arms-at-sides heroic stance. A small collectible product tag attached to the figurine clearly reads: “KOKIE”

The figurine is making an intentionally ridiculous, awkward, exaggerated, ugly-cute facial expression. The expression includes:
- unnaturally wide eyes
- uneven eyebrows
- distorted cheeks
- awkward mouth shape
- exaggerated lips
- strange facial tension
- asymmetrical facial expression
- intentionally goofy facial pose

CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: The real person’s facial expression MUST be identical to the figurine’s facial expression. The real person (in Boa Hancock cosplay) is actively recreating every distorted facial feature shown on the figurine with perfect accuracy. Every facial detail aligns precisely: eyes, eyebrows, mouth shape, cheek position, facial tension, head tilt, and overall facial asymmetry. The figurine should look like a miniature version of the real person brought to life. The viewer should immediately notice that the person is perfectly copying the ridiculous expression from the figurine. If the real person’s expression does not perfectly match the figurine, the image is incorrect. Expression matching is the single highest priority of the entire image. It is more important than beauty, attractiveness, fashion, photographic glamour, or portrait aesthetics.

The humor comes entirely from the contrast between the realistic high-quality Boa Hancock cosplay and their absurd collectible figure. Cute chaotic energy, wholesome humor, meme-worthy composition, viral social media aesthetic, authentic candid moment.

Overlay handwritten-style doodles and annotations across the image: arrows, hearts, stars, sparkles, icons, and playful captions connected to elements in the scene (especially pointing out the matching ridiculous expressions and the “KOKIE” tag).

Authentic collectible toy shop atmosphere, figure collector culture, premium hobby store interior, shelves packed with designer toys and PVC figures, realistic retail displays, toy store photography aesthetic.

Realistic skin texture, realistic hands, shallow depth of field, highly detailed face, highly detailed PVC figurine, photorealistic quality. Social-media-viral composition, highly shareable visual storytelling, humorous personality-driven photography, trending meme aesthetic.

Beauty is secondary. Expression accuracy is mandatory. The figurine’s expression should be even more absurd and embarrassing than would normally be acceptable in a professional portrait.

items.title: 请根据以下设定，创作一套高完成度、具有统一视觉系统的「原创鲜…
items.prompt:
请根据以下设定，创作一套高完成度、具有统一视觉系统的「原创鲜果电商品牌商品化提案 / 4-Board Fresh Fruit Brand Commercialization Proposal」。

注意：这不是四宫格，也不是把4张内容合成在一张图里，而是同一个品牌系统下的4张独立图片，需要依次分别生成。每次只生成当前这一张，并自动延续前面已经建立好的品牌视觉DNA，直到4张全部完成。画幅比例统一为竖版 3:4。

【品牌设定】
品牌名：枝上初红
英文辅助名：FIRST RED ON THE BRANCH
品牌类型：高端鲜杨梅电商品牌 / 夏日鲜果品牌 / 轻礼赠鲜果品牌
一句话定位：把山里的第一口夏天，送到你手里。
核心关键词：杨梅季、当季现摘、产地直发、冷链保鲜、酸甜爆汁、山野感、夏日果礼、电商商品化
目标人群：城市家庭、年轻白领、注重品质和时令感的消费者、轻礼赠用户、电商水果消费人群
整体风格：夏日鲜果电商美学 × 高级写实商品摄影 × 轻果礼品牌提案
主色：杨梅深红、鲜果红紫
辅助色：叶片绿、奶白、冰白、浅灰蓝
点缀色：露珠银灰、少量微金属浅金
视觉元素：杨梅果粒纹理、枝叶、果梗、山形线描、晨露、水滴、冰感、果园气息、冷链保鲜符号、夏日清爽氛围
品牌口号：把山里的第一口夏天，送到你手里。

【IP设定】
需要轻IP，不要只有Logo。IP名为「枝枝灵 / ZHI ZHI SPIRIT」。
它不是大眼睛卡通杨梅人，而是一个克制、可爱、轻拟人化的品牌果灵识别物，可以表现为小徽章、小吊牌、小挂件、小贴纸、小印章、小摆件或包装守护灵。它应有杨梅、叶片、枝头的气质，轻可爱但不低幼，不廉价，不喧宾夺主，应自然融入品牌系统与商品系统中。

【产品线 / SKU】
1. 尝鲜装：250g
2. 轻享装：500g
3. 家庭装：1kg
4. 精选礼盒装：2kg
5. 高端果礼装：精品礼盒版
配套内容：果盒内托、吸水垫、冰袋、冷链保温袋、快递外箱、手提礼袋、品牌卡片、果园介绍卡、食用建议卡、封签、贴纸、吊牌、等级标签

【整体要求】
1. 四张图必须明显属于同一个品牌系统，品牌名、色彩、字体气质、图形语言、IP形象、包装逻辑、商品调性全部统一。
2. 不是普通水果海报，也不是廉价促销图，而是一套可销售、可传播、可复用的鲜果电商品牌系统提案。
3. 画面必须非常写实，要有真实鲜果质感、真实包装材质感、真实商品摄影感、真实冷链与电商场景感。
4. 文字尽量准确，品牌名“枝上初红”、英文“FIRST RED ON THE BRANCH”、IP名“枝枝灵”尽量清晰正确，不要乱码，不要大段无意义小字。
5. IP要存在，但要轻，不要低幼卡通，不要像儿童零食包装。
6. 整体要通透、清亮、新鲜、有果汁感、有夏日感，同时具备品牌提案感和商业感。

【第1张：品牌主视觉封面图 / Brand Hero Board】
这张图负责定调，是第一视觉记忆点。
重点展示：
- 品牌名“枝上初红”
- 英文辅助名“FIRST RED ON THE BRANCH”
- 品牌口号
- 高端鲜杨梅主包装或礼盒主视觉
- 饱满、新鲜、深红、带颗粒、带露珠的真实杨梅特写
- 枝叶、果梗、山野清晨、微雾、水滴等氛围元素
- 轻IP“枝枝灵”以徽章、吊牌、小摆件或品牌识别物的方式出现
- 核心卖点：当季现摘、产地直发、冷链保鲜、酸甜爆汁
要求：更偏封面图 / Hero Image，而不是说明书；有种草感、新鲜感、高级感和第一眼食欲感。

【第2张：品牌识别与IP系统图 / Identity & IP System Board】
这张图负责解释品牌视觉系统和IP语言如何构成。
重点展示：
- 品牌字标 / Logo
- 品牌配色系统
- 杨梅果粒纹理、枝叶、果梗、山形线描、水滴、冰感图形等辅助视觉语言
- 轻IP“枝枝灵”系统：IP形象、小徽章、小挂件、贴纸、吊牌、印章、封签、简化图标
- 规格标签系统
- 甜度 / 果径 / 新鲜度 / 冷链图标系统
- 小型应用系统：标签、贴纸、封签、吊牌、卡片
要求：像高端品牌识别提案板，但不要僵硬，不要低幼；模块清晰，信息完整，有设计感和统一性。

【第3张：商品与包装系统图 / Product & Packaging System Board】
这张图负责展示品牌如何落到真实商品与包装系统上。
重点展示：
- 250g、500g、1kg、2kg、精品果礼装的商品矩阵
- 鲜果包装盒、礼盒、内托、吸水垫、冰袋、保温袋、手提礼袋、冷链外箱
- 品牌卡片、果园介绍卡、食用建议卡
- 封签、标签、吊牌、等级贴
- 鲜果近景、果径分级或品质表达
- 轻IP“枝枝灵”自然融入包装系统
要求：像真实可以上架销售的鲜果电商品牌商品系统，不要只摆一堆盒子；要看得出规格层级、包装逻辑和品牌统一性。

【第4张：电商传播与销售场景图 / Campaign & Sales Scenario Board】
这张图负责展示品牌进入真实电商与传播场景后的效果。
重点展示：
- 手机端电商首页 / 商品详情页主视觉
- 社交媒体种草图 / feed 风格传播图
- 开箱场景：打开鲜果盒，看到杨梅、冰袋、卡片等
- 冷链配送场景：外箱、配送、到家开箱
- 送礼场景 / 家庭分享场景 / 夏日下午茶场景
- 可选门店快闪 / 柜台 / 展示台小场景
- 品牌色、包装、IP符号、商品系统在不同场景中保持统一
要求：比第3张更强调真实销售与传播场景，不是简单包装展示，而是完整电商链路和品牌应用效果。

【负面要求】
不要四宫格，不要把4张图拼在一张里。
不要廉价水果促销海报感。
不要低质电商模板感。
不要拼贴素材感。
不要过度传统土特产感。
不要把IP做成大眼睛卡通杨梅人。
不要幼稚、低龄、廉价。
不要虚假的CG摆拍感。
不要照搬任何现成品牌或已有IP。

【执行方式】
请先统一“枝上初红”的品牌视觉DNA，再按顺序生成：
第1张：品牌主视觉封面图
第2张：品牌识别与IP系统图
第3张：商品与包装系统图
第4张：电商传播与销售场景图
每次只生成当前这一张独立图片，并自动延续前面已经建立好的品牌系统，直到4张全部完成。
